rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « Afrorum Domina » praecipua Patrona totius archidioecesis Algeriensis declaratur.
incipit_latin: Praefervidum erga intaminatam Dei Genetricem amorem etiam in repositis terris inter omnes constat vigere. Iam inde antiquitus in regione Algeriensi
notes: Patron declaration stating 'Anno MDCCCLXXVI Decessor Noster ven. mem. Pius Pp. IX ecclesiam ... ad Basilicae Minoris honorem et dignitatem evexit, et statuam Beatae Mariae Virginis aurea corona, suo nomine et auctoritate, redimiri iussit'. OCR renders the year as 'm d c c c l x x v ï' = MDCCCLXXVI (1876). The bronze statue was given by the Children of Mary of Lyons and blessed by the first bishop of Algiers in 1840 ('anno MDCCCXXXX'). Pius XII/John XXIII text also records that John XXIII himself visited the shrine on 19 March 1950.

rubric_latin: Imago beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Nostra Seynora de Canòlich » invocatae, quae pie colitur in Andorrae Principatus oppido « Sant Julia de Loria » intra fines Urgellensis dioecesis posito, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: In antiquo oppido Andorrae Principatus « Sant Julia de Loria » intra fines dioecesis Urgellensis posito, iam a saeculo XIII a fidelibus loci finitimarumque regionum peculiari veneratione colitur decora imago beatae Mariae Virginis
notes: Coronation granted 'Nostro nomine et auctoritate' but no date of the crowning given. Petition of Bishop Ioannes Martí Alanis, letters of 15 October [1998]. OCR gives the vernacular title as « Nostra Seynora de Canòlich » (Catalan 'Senyora'); the oppidum is printed « Sant Julia de Loria » (Sant Julià de Lòria). Country explicit in the text ('Andorrae Principatus').

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. BARNABAM PIEDRABUENA, EPISCOPUM CATAMARCENSIUM, DE SOLLEMNIBUS GRATULATUR, QUAE B. M. V. « DEL VALLE » APPARANTUR.
incipit_latin: Litteris tuis officio functus es grato admodum Nobis. Nuntiasti enim Catamarcensium catholicorum in almam Dei Matrem adeo studia exardescere
notes: The batch passage is the volume index (printed p. 500), whose entry ('Litteris tuis. - Ad R. P. D. Barnabam Piedrabuena, episcopum Catamarciensium, de sollemnibus gratulatur, quae B. M. V. « dei Valle » apparantur') does not itself mention a crowning; the crowning is attested in the act it points to, read in txt/AAS-08-1916-ocr.txt at printed p. 144: 'iidem, labente vicesimo quinto anno ex quo Virginis simulacrum, sollemni Ecclesiae ritu, aureo donatum est diademate, velint huius eventus faustitatem iteranda pietatis significatione commemorare'. `page` therefore set to 144, not to the index page 500. coronation_date 1891 is arithmetic: the 25th year was running in 1916 ('labente vicesimo quinto anno'); the act itself states no year, so verify. The act names no authority for the original coronation beyond 'sollemni Ecclesiae ritu'. Country inferred from the see of Catamarca (the act speaks of an Apostolic Legate 'apud istam Rempublicam'). The Legate named in the act (Achilles, titular archbishop of Thessalonica) is deputed for the 1916 anniversary solemnities, not for the coronation, so `legate` is left null.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA CATHEDRALIS CAIAMARCENSIS, TITULO B. MARIAE VIRG. «A VALLE», BASILICAE MINORIS PRIVILEGIIS HONORIBUSQUE AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Postulat a Nobis Venerabilis Frater Catamarcensium Episcopus, intra fines Reipublicae Argentinae, quinquagesimi anni occasione ab imposita corona aurea, qua statua Beatae Mariae Virginis a Valle ... redimita fuit
notes: Basilica Minor grant made on the fiftieth anniversary of the crowning: 'quinquagesimi anni occasione ab imposita corona aurea, qua statua Beatae Mariae Virginis a Valle, in templo Cathedrali suo servata, redimita fuit'. coronation_date 1891 is computed from that fifty-year interval (act dated 1941), not stated explicitly - please verify. Rubric OCR 'CAIAMARCENSIS' for 'CATAMARCENSIS'; the body reads 'Catamarcensium Episcopus'. Datum reads 'die u m. Iulii' (= II, 2 July). No act numeral: the section heading is a bare 'LITTERAE APOSTOLICAE'.

rubric_latin: Sanctuario Dominae Nostrae del Valle Catamarcensis dioecesis Rosa aurea tribuitur.
incipit_latin: Ab incohato iam saeculo XVII Beatam Mariam Virginem del Valle colere coeperunt fideles, cuius signum Decessor Noster Leo XIII, insignis memoriae, coronavit.
notes: Golden Rose grant ('Ad futuram rei memoriam') which attests in passing that Leo XIII crowned the image. No coronation year is given in the act — left null rather than supplied. Country not stated; inferred from the diocese of Catamarca (Argentina). The Golden Rose was to be presented by Card. Franciscus Xaverius Errázuriz Ossa.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA S. DOMINICI CONFESSORIS, CORDUBAE IN REPUBLICA ARGENTINA, ERIGITUR IN BASILICAM MINOREM.
incipit_latin: Praestantiora Catholici Orbis Sanctuaria, quae antiqua Christiani populi religione celebria, tum molis amplitudine tum liberalium artium ornamento
notes: 'Comperimus similiter eodem illo anno [MDCCCXCII] Leonis PP. XIII re. me. Decessoris Nostri nomine et auctoritate aureo diademate redimitam fuisse vetustissimam ac thaumaturgam Virginis Deiparae Imaginem'. OCR prints the year as 'MDCCcxcii' = 1892. The image is said to have come ashore at Callao in Peru and thence been taken to Córdoba.

rubric_latin: SANCTUS NICOLAUS BARENSIS, EP. ET CONF., CIVITATIS AC DIOECESIS RIOIENSIS, IN REPUBLICA ARGENTINA, PRIMUS AC PRAECIPUUS PATRONUS CAELESTIS CONSTITUITUR.
incipit_latin: Perennem esse Religionem a Christo Domino revelatam, hoc et de fide est, et a saeculari Ecclesiae historia comprobatum
notes: Patron-declaration act attesting the crowning: '...usque ad Decessorem Nostrum Pius Pp. X, fel. rec., qui, anno MCMXIII, aureum diadema, a semetipso benedictum, donavit, ut Eiusdem Simulacro imponeretur; quod tamen serius factum est, anno MCMXX, Decessore Nostro Benedicto Pp. XV ... feliciter regnante.' Crowned image is of a saint, not of the Virgin. Letter dated 1946 but printed in AAS vol. 40 (1948); the act carries no roman numeral (single Litterae Apostolicae in that issue). Passage printed_page 291; act opens on p. 290.

image_title_vernacular: La Pura y Limpia Concepción del Río Luján (Nuestra Señora de Luján)
rubric_latin: A SUMMO PONTIFICE CHRISTIFIDELIBUS DATUS OB CONVENTUM MARIALEM E TOTA ARGENTINA IN URBE LUJAN COADUNATIS.
notes: The passage recalls marble tablets in the sanctuary commemorating 'la solemne coronación de 1887 — la primera en América' and the 1930 recognition of her Patrocinio over the lands of the Plata. Only the year 1887 is given. Act begins on printed page 627 (rubric visible in context); the passage's own printed_page is 628. Body in Spanish, no Latin incipit.

rubric_latin: TITULUS ET HONORES BASILICAE MINORIS CONCEDUNTUR ECCLESIAE S. FRANCISCI ASS. CIVITATIS MENDOZA, IN DIOECESI SANCTI IOANNIS DE CUJO.
incipit_latin: Sacra aedes intra limites dioecesis Sancti Ioannis de Cujo in civitate Mendoza in honorem divi Francisci Asisiensis, licet recens erecta
notes: Coronation attested in passing: 'rec. mem. Pius PP. X aureo eandem diademate augendam curavit'. No coronation year stated. Country explicit ('Reipublicae Argentinae').

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris cathedrali ecclesiae Moronensi conferuntur.
incipit_latin: Terrena in peregrinatione constituti cives Moronenses honori Beatae Mariae Virginis, a prima labe immunis, quam a « felici itinere » vulgo appellant ac ducem habent ad caelestem, quo contendimus, patriam, monumentum praeclarum atque spectabile in urbe sua erexerunt
notes: Basilica Minor act recording John XXIII's own earlier grant: 'id simulacrum aureo diademate sivimus, Nostra auctoritate, redimiri, Apostolicis Litteris die xix mensis Decembris anno MCMLX sub Piscatoris anulo datis' — i.e. the faculty was granted by Apostolic Letters of 1960-12-19; the date of the coronation ceremony itself is not stated, so coronation_date left null. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the see of Morón (Bishop Michael/Miguel Raspanti) - please verify.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V. A SACRATISSIMO ROSARIO IN PRAECIPUAM CAELESTEM PATRONAM CIVITATIS ET DIOECESIS ROSARIENSIS, IN REPUBLICA ARGENTINA, ELIGITUR.
incipit_latin: Quae nobis rettulit Dilectus Filius Noster Antonius S. R. E. Presbyter Cardinalis Caggiano, Episcopus Rosariensis, in Republica Argentina, maximo Nos gaudio affecerunt.
notes: Patron-declaration act; attests 'anno MCMXLI Ven. Canonicorum Collegium Patriarchalis Basilicae Nostrae S. Petri in Vaticano ... sacram Imaginem ... aureo gemmisque ornato diademate redimiendam decreverit' - i.e. the Vatican Chapter DECREED the crowning in 1941; the date of the crowning itself is not given, so coronation_date left null. The image venerated is the 1773 replacement of the older statue. Country explicit ('in Republica Argentina'). Act begins on printed page 119.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris ecclesiae metropolitanae Rosariensi tribuuntur.
incipit_latin: Marialis nomine ac pietate merito praedicatur urbs perfrequens et industria, utpote quae, « Rosarium » appellata, Beatam Mariam Virginem a Rosario conditricem suam habeat atque patronam.
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation attested of the second (substitute) image: 'Pro qua effigie post aliquid temporis altera fuit substituta, quae, magis in dies fidelium obsequiis ornata, anno MCMXLI aureo diademate est redimita' (1941); no crowning authority named. Country inferred (the act mentions the image was originally brought 'ex urbe Sanctae Fidei' = Santa Fe, and Pius XII declared her Patron of city and diocese in 1954); not stated. Vernacular title supplied from the Latin.

legate: Andreas Card. Fruehwirth
rubric_latin: AD EM.UM P. D. ANDREAM TIT. SS. COSMAE ET DAMIANI S. R. E. PRESB. CARD. FRUEHWIRTH, QUEM LINCIAM LEGATUM SUUM MITTIT OCCASIONE DEDICATIONIS NOVI TEMPLI CATHEDRALIS.
incipit_latin: Linciae, in urbe episcopali illius in Austria dioecesis quae, ob singularem Deiparae amorem cultumque, Marialis merito nuncupatur
notes: Act III begins on printed p. 228 (verified in txt/AAS-16-1924-ocr.txt); the coronation reference falls on p. 229, the passage page, which is used here. The OCR of this page interleaves two columns: 'cuius signum, venerationi Linciensium in sacello novi templi propositum, ... Leo XIII aurea corona, a se pie liberaliterque muneri data, anno MDCCCCII redimiri iusserat'. The legation itself is for the cathedral dedication, not for a coronation.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AC DIGNITATE AFFICITUR ECCLESIA B. MARIAE V. IN CAELUM ASSUMPTAE, IN MONTE « PLAIN » INTRA ARCHIDIOECESIS SALISBURGENSIS FINES.
incipit_latin: Gementium Solatrix eademque ad caelestem gloriam Assumpta, Beata Maria Virgo in Templo, supra amoenum montem « Plain », quem vocant, prope Salisburgum posito, religiosis ornatur obsequiis
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; attests the image was 'Benedicti Pp. XIV, Decessoris Nostri, fel. rec., nomine et auctoritate, aureo diademate redimita'. The year is only indicated relatively: the image was restored in 1732 and crowned 'sex fere lustris expletis' (after nearly six lustra, i.e. c. 30 years), which would give c. 1762 — inconsistent with Benedict XIV (d. 1758); coronation_date left null for human check. Country Austria inferred from 'prope Salisburgum' / Archdiocese of Salzburg (not stated in the passage).

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Virginis servata in ecclesia Exaltationi Sanctae Crucis dicata loco vulgo dicto Brzesc in dioecesi Pinskensi Latinorum, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis.
incipit_latin: Beata Virgo Maria divinae maternitatis dono et munere, quo cum Filio Redemptore unitur, suisque singularibus gratiis et muneribus, etiam cum Ecclesia intime coniungitur
notes: Country Belarus inferred from the Latin diocese of Pinsk and the place Brzesc (Brest); not stated in the act. Cardinal Kazimierz Świątek, Apostolic Administrator of Pinsk, deputed to impose the crown. No title given for the image.

rubric_latin: Imago Mariae Sanctissimae quae in ecclesia oppidi v.d. Budslaw colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Purissima Virgo Maria « imago Ecclesiae est, forma et anticipatio humani generis gratia renovati, exemplar spesque certa iis omnibus qui caelestem ad Hierosolymitanam civitatem procedunt » (Orientale lumen, 6).
notes: Country Belarus inferred from the archdiocese of Minsk-Mohilev; not stated in the act. Cardinal Kazimierz Świątek (OCR: « &wiatek ») deputed to impose the crown solemnly. Cf. AAS 88 (1996) 695, which states the crowning took place in 1995.

rubric_latin: Sancta Dei Genetrix Maria, cuius imago recolitur in pago Budslaw, Patrona caelestis archidioecesis Minscensis Latinorum-Mohiloviensis Latinorum confirmatur.
incipit_latin: Sanctam Dei Matrem, cuius gratiosa imago servata in sanctuario Budslaviensi superiore anno Nostro nomine et auctoritate pretioso diademate est redimita
notes: Patron-confirmation act that states in passing that the Budslaw image was crowned « superiore anno » in the Pope's name and authority, i.e. in 1995 (the concession is AAS 87 [1995] 833, dated 7 June 1995). Country Belarus inferred from the archdiocese; not stated in the act.

rubric_latin: Imago Mariae Sanctissimae quae in ecclesia paroeciali Sanctorum Apostolorum Petri et Pauli oppidi v. d. Lahiszyn colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Spei signum inter nova rerum adiuncta apparet Immaculata Virgo Maria, « spiritalis Mater quae pro Christi discipulis intercedit et pro cuncta humanitate » (Ut unum sint, 79)
notes: Country Belarus inferred from the Latin diocese of Pinsk; not stated in the act. Cardinal Kazimierz Świątek, Apostolic Administrator of Pinsk, deputed to impose the crown; his letters of 29 April 1995.

legate: Petrus Lambertus S. R. E. Presb. Card. Goossens, Archiepiscopus Mechliniensis
rubric_latin: Facultas conceditur Archiepiscopo Mechliniensi solemniter coronandi imaginem SSmi. Cordis Iesu in Basilica loci Berchem.
incipit_latin: Aedes Deo Sacras, arte non minus quam cultu ac fidelium concursu celebratas, praecipuis honoribus ex more institutoque Romanorum Pontificum ditare libenti quidem animo solemus
notes: Second act in the same passage (rubric and act body on printed p. 401, continued p. 402). Leo XIII commits to Cardinal Goossens the faculty to crown the image 'die per te eligendo sollemni ritu ... Nostro nomine et auctoritate', on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of the church's building; the day is left to the Archbishop, so coronation_date is null. Country not named in the act; derived from 'suburbio Antverpiae civitatis' and 'dioecesi Mechliniensi'.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA PAROCHIALIS PAGI VULGO " BONSECOURS ", DIOECESIS TORNACENSIS, TITULO BASILICAE MINORIS DECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Conspicua templa Dei, quae tum vetustate, tum insignibus Sanctorum simulacris, tum etiam summa fidelium religione celebrantur
notes: Pius X states that he himself had decreed the image to be solemnly crowned with a golden diadem by earlier Letters dated 24 March 1905: 'illud per similes Nostras litteras, die quarto et vigesimo Martii anno MCMV datas, aureo diademate sollemni ritu coronandum decrevimus'. The passage gives the date of the decree, not of the crowning itself, so coronation_date is left null. OCR 'tempia' repaired to 'templa'. Belgium is explicit in the text ('e Belgicis ... regionibus', 'in Belgico regno').

rubric_latin: TITULUS ET HONORES BASILICAE MINORIS TRIBUUNTUR SANCTUARIO CAPRIMONTENSI BEATAE MARIAE GRATIARUM, ORDINIS CARMELITARUM EXCALCEATORUM, INTRA FINES DIOECESIS LEODIENSIS.
incipit_latin: Leodiensis dioecesis intra fines Carmelitarum Discalceatorum exstat, e religiosa provincia Brabantina, conventus Caprimontensis, cui annexum est templum
notes: Basilica Minor act; small statue of the BVM holding the Infant Jesus, placed by the Jesuits on the hill of Chèvremont, 'quam, nomine ac mandato Nostro, anno MCMXXIII Leodiensium Episcopus pretioso diademate sollemniter redimivit'. Country inferred from diocese of Liège and the Archbishop of Mechelen named as commender. Act begins on printed p. 183; coronation clause falls on p. 184.

image_title_vernacular: Notre-Dame de Hal / Onze-Lieve-Vrouw van Halle
rubric_latin: AD DIGNITATEM ET HONOREM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR ECCLESIA PAROECIALIS DEO IN HONOREM S. MARTINI DICATA ET IN CIVITATE POSITA, CUI NOMEN VULGO « HAL », INTRA FINES ARCHIDIOECESIS MECHLINIENSIS.
incipit_latin: Paroecialis Ecclesiae, Deo in honorem Sancti Martini dicatae, intra fines Archidioecesis Mechliniensis, in civitate cui nomen Hallae, vulgo « Hal » exstantis
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'Inclyta Imago diademate redimita fuit, nomine Pii Pp. IX, ab Archiepiscopo Mechliniensi die iv mensis Octobris anno MDCCCLXXIV'. The crowning Archbishop of Mechelen is not named, so legate left null. Country explicit ('in Belgio'). Passage printed_page was 449; act begins on printed p. 448. Vernacular forms supplied from the act's own 'Notre Dame de Hai' (OCR for 'Hal') and the town name.

image_title_vernacular: Onze-Lieve-Vrouw van Hanswijk / Notre-Dame de Hanswijk
rubric_latin: Templum vulgo nuncupatum « Notre-Dame de Hanswijk », in archiepiscopali urbe Mechliniensi extans, ad Basilicae Minoris dignitatem evehitur.
incipit_latin: Mechliniae, in Belgarum clarissima urbe, insigne exstat templum vulgo nuncupatum « Notre-Dame de Hanswijk »
notes: Basilica Minor elevation act stating the image was solemnly crowned by Cardinal Victor-Auguste Dechamps, Archbishop of Mechelen, on 30 July 1876 'nomine et auctoritate Pii PP. IX'. OCR 'tempulm' repaired to 'templum' in the incipit.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V. VULGO « NOTRE-DAME DU REMPART » INVOCATA, TOTIUS CIVITATIS NAMURCENSIS PATRONA CAELESTIS AEQUE PRINCIPALIS CUM SANCTO ALBANO RENUNTIATUR.
incipit_latin: Vetus est apud Namurcenses Beatae Mariae Virginis cultus et religio, quandoquidem primum in eorum oppido exstructum Templum Deiparae nomine fuit dedicatum
notes: Patron declaration; attests 'Quam insignem Effigiem, superiore bello, quod per orbem flagraverat, confecto, Namurcensium tum Antistes, rec. mem. Pii Pp. XI, Decessoris Nostri, nomine et auctoritate, aurea corona, inter populi plaudentis vota, redimivit'. The crowning was done by the then Bishop of Namur (unnamed) in the name and by the authority of Pius XI, after the end of the (first) world war — so between 1922 and 1939; no year given. Country Belgium inferred from Namur/Namurcensis (not stated in the passage). Statue described as 'Beatae Mariae Virginis ab origine Immaculatae'.

rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM B. M. V. IN OPPIDO ASPRICOLLIS, ARCHIDIOECESIS MECHLINIENSIS, TITULO ET PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Penes oppidulum Aspricollis vulgo Scherpenheuvel, haud longe a civitate Lovaniensi, archidioecesis Mechliniensis intra fines, priscis a temporibus
notes: Basilica Minor act granted on the fiftieth anniversary of the coronation; states 'ab Archiepiscopo Mechliniensi postea Cardinali Dechamps, nomine et auctoritate Praedecessoris Nostri rec. mem. Pii PP. IX, anno MDCCCLXXII solemni ritu aureo diademate redimitum effulsit' - crowned in 1872 by Abp (later Cardinal) Dechamps in the name and by the authority of Pius IX; day and month not given. Rubric OCR 'MECHLINIEN-SI^' repaired.

legate: Iosephus Ernestus Card. Van Roey, Archiepiscopus Mechliniensis
rubric_latin: AD EM.UM P. D. IOSEPHUM ERNESTUM TIT. S. MARIAE DE ARACOELI S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM VAN ROEY, ARCHIEPISCOPUM MECHLINIENSEM, QUEM LEGATUM SUUM MITTIT AD SOLEMNIA QUINQUIES SAECULARIA UNIVERSITATIS STUDIORUM LOVANIENSIS CELEBRANDA.
incipit_latin: Quinto feliciter exeunte saeculo ex quo Lovaniensis ista Studiorum Universitas condita est, iuste quidem Rector eius magnificus Paulinus Ladeuze
notes: Act I begins on printed p. 307 (verified in txt/AAS-19-1927-ocr.txt); rubric and incipit taken from there; the coronation reference is on the passage page 308: 'auspice Virgine Matre, quam ab ipso iam initio veluti Sedem Sapientiae venerari consueverunt Lovanienses, cuiusque augusta effigies, Nostro quidem nomine, corona aurea mox redimietur'. The legation is primarily for the university's fifth-centenary solemnities; the crowning is to be done in the Pope's name ('Nostro nomine'), presumably by the same Legate, but the letter does not say so expressly. Coronation year 1927 inferred from 'mox' and the date of the act. Diocese given as that of the Legate's see (Louvain lay in the archdiocese of Mechelen); country inferred.

legate: Bishop of Tournai (unnamed), acting in the name of Leo XIII
rubric_latin: PAROECIALE TEMPLUM LOCI « TONGRE-NOTRE-DAME » DIOECESIS TORNACENSIS TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS DITATUR.
incipit_latin: Almam Dei hominumque Matrem Mariam Christifideles pagi « Tongre-Notre-Dame » vulgo appellati et continentis quoque regionis accepimus religiosis venerari obsequiis.
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing on printed p. 363: crowned 8 September 1881 in the name of Leo XIII by the Bishop of Tournai (« a Tornacensi Antistite aurea redimitum est corona »); the crown having later been sacrilegiously removed, the image was crowned again on 1 June 1949 by Abp. Ferdinando Cento, Apostolic Nuncio in Belgium (« diademate impie sublato ... regio eiusmodi insigni die i mensis Iunii, anno MCMXLIX, iterum revinxit »). The vernacular title is the place-name form given in the act rubric; verify.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA SANCTI MATERNI, IN OPPIDO « WALCOURT » DIOECESIS NAMURCENSIS EXSTANS, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS COHONESTATUR.
incipit_latin: Excultioribus Templis magisque religiosis ac frequentibus nullo non tempore Sedes Apostolica decus addere solebat, quo Christifidelium pietatem impensius exacueret et amplificaret.
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing on printed p. 269: « expleto LXXV anno a quo hoc signum auctoritate Pii PP. IX, fel. mem., Decessoris Nostri, aurea redimitum est corona ». The year is not stated outright: 1875 is derived from the 75 years said to have elapsed as of this act (Datum 13 May 1950) — verify. The candidate passage is keyed to printed p. 269; the act begins on p. 268, which is cited here. `pope` is the pope of the act (Pius XII); the crowning itself was by authority of Pius IX.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS DECORATUR TEMPLUM-SANCTUARIUM BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS DE « COPACABANA », INTRA FINES DIOECESIS PACENSIS IN BOLIVIA.
incipit_latin: Bolivianae ditionis intra fines, in dioecesi Pacensi, exstat antiquum templum-sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis de « Copacabana »
notes: Coronation mentioned only in passing and without date or agent: 'Deiparae Virginis statua in eodem honorifice servatur, quam recentiori tempore sollemniter etiam aureo diademate redimitam, boliviani christifideles peculiari cultu venerantur'. Papal authority for the crowning is not explicitly stated, hence medium confidence.

legate: Caietanus S. R. E. Cardinalis Cicognani (then Nuncio in Bolivia, acting as Legatus extraordinarius)
rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. CAIETANUM TIT. SANCTAE CAECILIAE S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM CICOGNANI, S. CONGREGATIONIS SACRORUM RITUUM PRAEFECTUM, AB INITO SACERDOTIO QUINQUAGESIMUM ANNUM IMPLENTEM.
incipit_latin: Celebranti feliciter tibi, quattuor abhinc annos, quinque ab inito episcopatu lustra, existimationem ac benevolentiam Nostram palam significavimus, praecipua tua erga Ecclesiam merita
notes: Jubilee letter to Card. Gaetano Cicognani; the coronation is mentioned only retrospectively on printed p. 528: « In Bolivia autem, ubi Nuntius nominatus fuisti, dum saeculum celebrabatur, ex quo res publica in libertatem vindicata erat, Sanctae Sedis Legatum extraordinarium egisti et insigni Virginis simulacro de Copacabana ... auream coronam imposuisti ». The year is not stated; the act places it during the centenary of Bolivian independence (i.e. 1925) — left null rather than computed. Locality 'Copacabana' is taken from the image's title and the description of the lakeside sanctuary; vernacular title is a normalisation. Country is explicit ('In Bolivia').

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, « Nuestra Señora de Copacabana » vulgo appellata, principalis Patrona totius Bolivianae Classis declaratur.
incipit_latin: Maria, mater Ecclesiae sollemni more in Concilio Oecumenico Vaticano II pronuntiata est, quippe quae ad gignendam augendamque vitam divinam in singulis hominum animis, materno opere continuo intendit
notes: Patronage act (patron of the Bolivian Navy); coronation attested in passing: 'iam Praedecessores Nostri Pius XI effigiem ipsam aureo diademate redimiri et Pius XII templum titulo ac dignitate Basilicae Minoris decorari censuerunt' - no year for the crowning. Country explicit ('intra fines Bolivianae ditionis').

rubric_latin: B. M. V. IMMACULATA SUB TITULO « APPARECIDA » PRINCIPALIS PATRONA BRASILIAE CONSTITUITUR.
incipit_latin: Ab Archiepiscopo Sancti Sebastiani Fluminis Ianuarii ceterisque Archiepiscopis, Episcopis, Praelatis atque Apostolicis Praefectis Brasiliae rogati sumus
notes: Patron-declaration act; states the simulacrum was crowned 'decreto Capituli sacrosanctae Patriarchalis Vaticanae Basilicae, anno quinquagesimo recurrente a definitione dogmatica de Immaculato Virginis Conceptu, aurea corona' — i.e. 1854+50 = 1904, corroborated by the act's own reference to the 25th year since that solemn coronation. Coronation year is computed, not printed. OCR of the vernacular title is corrupt ('Fossa Berihora de Gonceigao Apparecida'). No locality or diocese named in the act.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. ADEODATUM IOANNEM EPISCOPUM SABINEN. ET MANDELEN. S. R. E. CARDINALEM PIAZZA, SACRAE CONGREGATIONIS CONSISTORIALIS A SECRETIS, QUEM LEGATUM MITTIT AD CONVENTUM MARIALEM E TOTA BRASILIA IN URBE SANCTI PAULI INDICTUM.
incipit_latin: Quarto volvente saeculo a nobilissima Sancti Pauli in Brasilia civitate condita, consilium initum est pro collatis beneficiis sollemnes Deo reddendi gratiarum actiones
notes: Legate letter for the Brazilian national Marian Congress at São Paulo; the Legate (Card. Piazza) is deputed to preside at the Congress, not to crown, so this is a retrospective attestation: 'simulque quinquaginta implentur anni, ex quo augustum simulacrum aurea corona redimitum est Nostrae Dominae « da Conceiçâo Aparecida », Brasiliae Patronae'. Coronation year 1904 computed from 'quinquaginta implentur anni' relative to the act year 1954; not stated verbatim. The shrine's own locality/diocese is not named — only that the cult had its cradle in the Archdiocese of São Paulo. OCR 'Conceiçâo' for 'Conceição'.

rubric_latin: Rosa aurea Apparitiopolitanae Basilicae B. Mariae Virg. Immaculatae, quae vulgo « Aparecida » vocatur, tribuitur.
incipit_latin: Celsissima Virgo Maria, quemadmodum pluribus locis per orbem terrarum evenisse cognoscitur, in amplissima quoque regione Brasiliensi veluti posuit pedem, ut singularis pietatis excitaret sedem
notes: Golden Rose act addressed to Card. Carlos de Vasconcellos Motta; coronation attested in passing: after mentioning the Basilica Minor title granted by St Pius X, 'Eiusdem vero Summi Pontificis auctoritate effigies illa paulo ante aureo diademate erat redimita' - year not stated. The small terracotta statue was found in the Paraíba river in 1717. Country explicit (regio Brasiliensis).

legate: Augustus Alvarus Cardinalis da Silva, Archiepiscopus Sancti Salvatoris in Brasilia (Legatus a Latere)
rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. AUGUSTUM ALVARUM TIT. SANCTI ANGELI IN FORO PISCARIO S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM DA SILVA, ARCHIEPISCOPUM SANCTI SALVATORIS IN BRASILIA, QUEM LEGATUM DELIGIT AD CONVENTUM EUCHARISTICUM E TOTA NATIONE BRASILIANA INDICTUM ATQUE AD SIMULACRO NOSTRAE DOMINAE DE NAZARETH IN BASILICA URBIS BELEMENSIS DE PARA CORONAM IMPONENDAM.
incipit_latin: Comperimus sane perlibenter, in urbe Belemensi de Para, Conventum Eucharisticum e tota natione Brasiliana, proximo Augusto mense, sollemniter celebratum iri
notes: Explicit faculty: 'tibi facultatem damus, ut Nostram gerens personam, simulacro Nostrae Dominae de Nazareth, quod in Basilica eiusdem nominis piissime colitur, veluti manibus Nostris coronam sollemniter imponas'. Coronation to take place during the national Eucharistic Congress in August 1953. The Datum year is OCR-mangled as 'MDCCCCVIII'; 'Pontificatus Nostri quinto decimo' and the volume year fix it as MDCCCCLIII = 1953. Vernacular title (Nossa Senhora de Nazaré) not given in the Latin text. The volume index (p. 912) repeats this: 'Corona aurea redimatur simulacrum Nostrae Dominae de Nazaret, in Basilica Belemensi de Para, 545'.

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris cathedralis ecclesia Marianensis decoratur.
incipit_latin: Erga almam Deiparam pietatis sedes inclita esse perhibetur cathedralis ecclesia Marianensis, quippe ubi vetus nobilisque imago eius, quae est « decor Carmeli », impensis populi excolatur obsequiis.
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation attested: 'ac paulo post effigies ipsa, nomine et auctoritate eiusdem Summi Pontificis [Ioannis Pp. XXIII], inter potestatum, cleri, fidelium vota et plausus, aureo diademate redimita' — crowned in the name and by the authority of John XXIII, shortly after he declared her Patron of the city; no date and no Legate named. Vernacular title not given (Latin only, « decor Carmeli »). Country inferred from 'Civitatis, cui nomen « Minas Gerais »', not stated.

legate: Marcolinus de Souza Dantas, Archbishop of Natal (commissioned to impose the crown in the Pope's name)
rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V. « A PRAESENTATIONE » URBIS ET ARCHIDIOECESIS NATALENSIS PRAECIPUA PATRONA CONFIRMATUR.
incipit_latin: Quae mortalibus, huius iactatis saeculi fluctibus, constituta est amplissimum praesidium, Beatam Mariam Virginem, ad Templum deductam, sacrorum administri et Christifideles
notes: Patron-confirmation act that also grants the coronation: « ... confirmaremus simulque simulacrum Deiparae aureo sineremus diademate redimiri », and then « Natalensi Archiepiscopo, quem diximus, eas partes committimus ut, die per se ipsum statuendo, memoratae imagini ... auream coronam, Nostro nomine atque auctoritate, imponat ». The date of the crowning is left to the Archbishop, hence coronation_date null. The wooden image is said to have been found by fishermen about two hundred years earlier. Vernacular title is a rendering of 'a Praesentatione'; country inferred from the archdiocese of Natal — verify.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM CARMELITARUM, BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINI DE MONTE CARMELO SACRUM, IN URBE RECIFENSI, E STATU PERNAMBUCI, IN BRASILIA, TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS DECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Quod inclitus Carmelitarum antiquae observantiae Ordo templum habet suae custodiae curaeque commissum in urbe Recifensi, e Statu Pernambuci
notes: Basilica minor act stating: « cum eiusdem simulacro Ordo Canonicorum Patriarchalis Basilicae Vaticanae Nostrae, pro instituto suo, aureum diadema decrevisset, sacer ritus, die 21 mensis septembris anni 1919 ... sollemniter peractus est ». Coronation decreed by the Vatican Chapter; the same image had been declared Patroness of Recife in 1908.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris cathedrali ecclesiae dioecesis Sancti Ioannis a Rege tribuuntur.
incipit_latin: Religione almae Deiparae Virginis teneri perhibentur cives urbis Sancti Ioannis a Rege, quae episcopalis sedis honore a Ioanne PP. XXIII, Decessore Nostro rec. mem., anno MCMLX est donata.
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation attested: '... nomine et auctoritate Pii PP. XII, item Decessoris Nostri, est aureo diademate redimita' — crowned in the name and by the authority of Pius XII (r. 1939-1958); no date and no Legate named. Country and the Portuguese form of the title inferred (bishop Delphinus Ribeiro Guedes, see of São João del-Rei, Minas Gerais); not stated in the act.

legate: Valerius Cardinalis Valeri, Praefectus S. Congregationis de Religiosis
rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. VALERIUM TIT. S. SILVESTRI IN CAPITE S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM VALERI, PRAEFECTUM S. CONGREGATIONIS DE RELIGIOSIS, QUEM LEGATUM MITTIT AD CONVENTUM MARIALEM E TOTA CANADENSI REGIONE AD SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE V. INDICTUM, « CAP-DE-LA-MADELEINE » NUNCUPATUM, IN TRIFLUVIANENSI DIOECESI.
incipit_latin: Permagnus profecto exstat amor in catholica Canadensium natione studiumque vehemens divinae religionis, quam maiores eorum primum et maxime ex Gallia, tum ex Hibernia, mox denique aliunde auspicato advecti sunt
notes: Explicit mandate: 'ut in sanctuario Nostrae Dominae de Cap, in Trifluvianensi dioecesi de Canada sito, perinsigne Virginis simulacrum nomine Nostro Nostraque auctoritate aurea corona exornes'. The crowning was to take place at the Canadian national Marian Congress in August 1954 ('proximo mense Augusto ... et simulacrum Mariae Virginis, quod in eo religiosissime colitur, sollemni ritu coronabitur' — OCR 'coronantur'). Vernacular form 'Notre-Dame du Cap' rendered from the Latin 'Nostrae Dominae de Cap'. This same letter also appears at the end of passage AAS-46-1954-ocr#479.

legate: Valerius S. R. E. Presbyter Cardinalis Valeri (Valerio Valeri) — for the 1954 coronation only
rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris tribuuntur ecclesiae Beatae Mariae Virginis a Rosario (v. « Notre-Dame-du-Cap »), in Trifluvianensi dioecesi in Canadia.
incipit_latin: Evangelicum illud effatum « Oportet semper orare » (Lc. 18, 1) a Sancto Dominico etiam Mariali Rosario aptatum esse videtur
notes: Basilica Minor act attesting TWO coronations of the same image: 'Duabus insuper praedicti Simulacri coronationibus, anno MCMIV, quinquagesimo ab edicto dogmate, nec non, per manus desideratissimi Dilecti Filii Nostri Valerii S. R. E. Presbyteri Cardinalis Valeri, anno MCMLIV, centesimo eiusdem promulgati mysterii, rite peractis' — 1904 (50th anniversary of the definition of the Immaculate Conception) and 1954 (centenary), the latter performed by Cardinal Valerio Valeri. coronation_date holds the first (1904); the second (1954) is recorded here in the notes and in the legate field. Church entrusted to the Missionary Oblates of Mary Immaculate. Country explicit ('in dicione Canadensi').

legate: Paulus Aemilius S. R. E. Presb. Cardinalis Léger, Archiepiscopus Marianopolitanus
rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. PAULUM AEMILIUM TIT. SANCTAE MARIAE ANGELORUM S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM LÉGER, ARCHIEPISCOPUM MARIANOPOLITANUM QUEM LEGATUM DELIGIT AD CORONAM AUREAM IMPONENDAM SIMULACRO S. IOSEPH, SPONSI B. M. V.
incipit_latin: Praeterito quidem anno, praeclarum templum Sancto Ioseph dicatum, quod in nobilissima exstat sede Marianopolitana, tuis precibus libenter indulgentes, ad Basilicae Minoris honorem ac dignitatem evehere benigne decrevimus.
notes: Papal letter deputing Card. Léger as Legate to impose the golden diadem 'Nostris veluti manibus'; occasioned by the 50th anniversary of the church's foundation. Coronation date not stated in the act. The same act is indexed at AAS 47 (1955) 600 in passages AAS-47-1955-ocr#874 and #906 (index entries, not separately recorded).

rubric_latin: NUNTIUS TELEVISIFICAS. Episcopis et christifidelibus Cilensis Nationis datus occasione dedicationis templi nationalis votivi B. M. V. a Carmelo, loco vulgo Maipu, exeunte Anno Sancto in locali Ecclesia celebrato.
notes: Televised message of Paul VI to Chile for the dedication of the national votive temple of Our Lady of Mount Carmel at Maipú. The source never says 'image': it names the devotion/title and says the Pope gave it a mantle and a crown — 'Depositamos estos votos nuestros ante la Virgen del Carmen de Maipú, a la que hemos querido también rendir nuestro homenaje con la donación de un manto y una corona, símbolos de confianza filial en su poderosa protección.' This is a papal DONATION of a crown, not a liturgical coronation rite, and the Pope was not present in person (message sent from Rome); classified papal_personal_coronation per the gap-spec rule for papal gifts of a crown, but a checker should verify whether a coronation ceremony followed. No coronation date is given. Act begins on printed page 727 (rubric there); the passage window is anchored at 729, where the crown sentence stands. Act date from the footnote '* Die 28 mensis novembris a. 1974.' Rubric printed 'NUNTIUS TELEVISIFICAS' (OCR/typo for TELEVISIFICUS). Body is in Spanish, so no Latin incipit.

legate: Benedictus Aloisi Masella, Archiepiscopus tit. Caesariensis, Nuntius Apostolicus in Chile
rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. BENEDICTUM ALOISI MASELLA, ARCHIEPISCOPUM TIT. CAESARIENSEM, EUNDEMQUE APUD CHILENSEM REMPUBLICAM NUNTIUM APOSTOLICUM, QUEM LEGATUM MITTIT AD SOLEMNIA CORONATIONE B. M. V. DE MONTE CARMELO IN URBE SANCTI IACOBI.
incipit_latin: Deiparam Virginem de Monte Carmelo proxime in urbe ista Chilensis Reipublicae principe, aurea corona sollemniter redimitum iri
notes: 'te ... hisce litteris Legatum Nostrum deligimus ac renuntiamus, qui ... coronam auream pretiosisque gemmis ornatam simulacro Virginis de Monte Carmelo, Nostris veluti manibus, imponas'. The rubric as printed reads 'AD SOLEMNIA CORONATIONE' (for 'CORONATIONIS'). The crowning is said to be 'proxime' at the date of the letter (29 Nov 1926) but no date is given, so coronation_date is null. The church/sanctuary is not named; the act refers only to the capital of Chile. The Virgin of Carmel had earlier been acclaimed patron of the republic.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM SSMI CORDIS IESU ET B. MARIAE V. DE MONTE CARMELO IN ARCHIDIOECESI ET CIVITATE S. IACOBI DE CHILE ERECTUM, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS HONESTATUR.
incipit_latin: Edocet Nos Venerabilis Frater Sancti Iacobi de Chile Archiepiscopus in archiepiscopali sua civitate perinsigne templum exstare sub titulo Sanctissimi Salvatoris
notes: Coronation attested: 'ita ut Imaginem eandem pretioso etiam diademate, vota omnium exsolvens, Legatus Noster anno millesimo nongentesimo vicesimo sexto redimierit'. The papal Legate who crowned the image is not named.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM B. M. V. DE MERCEDE, IN URBE SANCTI IACOBI DE CILE, AD TITULUM ET DIGNITATEM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR.
incipit_latin: Inter sacras aedes quibus Cilena regio nobilitatur, templum Beatae Mariae Virgini de Mercede dicatum in urbe Sancti Iacobi
notes: Basilica minor act attesting: « devotissima asservatur lignea imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede aureo gemmatoque diademate Sanctae huius Sedis auctoritate redimita ». No coronation date given in the act.

legate: Alonsus Arteaga Yepes, Episcopus Ipialensis (granted the faculty to crown 'nomine atque auctoritate Nostra')
rubric_latin: Sinitur Episcopus Ipialensis Imaginem B.M.V. a Visitatione coronare, quae est in urbe Ancuya, in Columbia.
incipit_latin: Tanta est Nostra erga beatissimam Virginem Mariam pietas et religio (est enim eadem Christi, Filii Dei adorandi mater; et patrona christianorum sollicita; et exemplar omnium virtutum in quod intueamur)
notes: 'in Columbia' explicit in the rubric. No church named, only the town of Ancuya. Datum reads 'anno MDCCCCLXXXI' = 1981; the volume's chronological index (p. 757) confirms 29 Jan. 1981. Coronation day left to the bishop's choice.

rubric_latin: Beatissimus Pater imaginem B. M. V. a Mercede, in archidioecesi Calí, quae est in Columbia, veneratam Ipse coronat.
incipit_latin: Quanta animi inclinatione feramur in Virginem Mariam, omnes quidem noverunt, cum per occasionem publice privatim, iterum iterumque ostendamus
notes: The Pope crowned the image himself on 4 July 1986 during his journey to Colombia ('rem die quarto mensis Iulii, hoc hanno, sollemnissime gessimus'). Petitioner: Petrus Rubiano Sáenz, Archbishop of Cali. Church/sanctuary not named. Datum 'anno MDCCCCLXXXVI' = 1986.

image_title_vernacular: Virgen de la Candelaria (Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria del Cerro de la Popa)
rubric_latin: Summus Pontifex imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis, sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria » in sanctuario « La Popa » veneratam, Ipse coronat.
incipit_latin: Quantum Beatissima Virgo Maria universo populo catholico cara sit qualique ab eo pietate colatur nemini ignotum, maxime cum Christi Mater et nostra alicuius gentis historiam suis interventibus manifesto signat
notes: Act begins on printed page 16 (passage printed_page is 15). The Pope crowned the image with his own hands on 6 July 1986 ('imaginem illam die sexto mensis Iulii hoc anno Nostris manibus sollemniter pretioso diademate redimiimus'). Petitioner: Carolus Iosephus Ruiseco, Archbishop of Cartagena.

image_title_vernacular: Virgen de la Candelaria (Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria del Cerro de la Popa)
rubric_latin: Cartagenae, V expleto saeculo ab Evangelio D. N. Iesu Christi in Columbia nuntiato habita.
notes: Spanish-language papal address, 6 July 1986 (footnote 'Die 6 m. Iulii a. 1986'): 'la Virgen de la Candelaria, cuya venerada imagen vamos a coronar solemnemente'. The crowning is announced as imminent but no date is stated for it, hence coronation_date null; it presumably took place at that celebration. Diocese name supplied in Latin form as 'Carthaginensis in Columbia' - a checker should verify.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Episcopus Garagoënsis Imaginem B. M. V. « del Amparo de Chinavita » pretioso diademate coronare.
incipit_latin: Semper quidem, ab usque Ecclesiae primordiis, consuevit populus christianus, suorum ductu Pastorum, sanctos caelites honorare et invocare
notes: Faculty granted to Ioannes Mojica Oliveros, Bishop of Garagoa, to crown the image in the Pope's name on a day of his choosing, in person or through a delegate in ecclesiastical dignity; no coronation date given. Country explicit ('in finibus Columbiae'). Church/sanctuary not named. Datum 'anno MDCCCCLXXXVI' = 1986.

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Chiquinquirá
rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM N. D. A ROSARIO, O. P., OPPIDI CHINQUINQUIRA, INTRA FINES DIOECESIS TUNQUENSIS, AD HONORES BASILICAE MINORIS EXTOLLITUR.
incipit_latin: Exstat in Columbia, in loco cui vulgo nomen de Chinquinquira, dioecesis Tunquensis intra fines, Nostrae Dominae a Rosario celeberrimum sanctuarium
notes: Act II begins on printed p. 18 (the passage page marker is 19). 'nuperque anno MDCCCCXIX per Capituli Vaticani decretum ipsa imago Virginis sollemni pompa aureo diademate redimita affulsit.' The act spells the place 'Chinquinquira' (modern Chiquinquirá) and calls the Virgin 'Virginis Columbiae Reginae'. Printed in AAS vol. 20 (1928); the act itself is dated 18 August 1927.

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Iles
rubric_latin: Summi Pontificis nomine auctoritateque ut imagini B. M. V. a Rosario « Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Iles » diadema imponat Episcopo permittitur Ipialensi.
incipit_latin: Quantum praeteriti spatium temporis repetere potest hominum memoria, ex quo videlicet tempore plus quadringentos abhinc annos nomen est Christianum ibi conditum
notes: Faculty to Bishop Alfonso Arteaga Yepes of Ipiales to impose 'pretiosam coronam Nostro ipsorum nomine et auctoritate'. Cedar statue ('sub cedrina ipsa forma'). Country explicit ('illius regionis Columbiae'). Also indexed in the volume's Index rerum analyticus, p. 1219.

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora del Rosario de las Lajas
rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, « Nuestra Señora del Rosario de las Lajas » vulgo appellata, principalis Patrona dioecesis Ipialensis eligitur.
incipit_latin: Tutela caelestis virtutis sacras iuvat diciones firmari, quae quasi arbores novellae in feraci catholicae Ecclesiae agro conseruntur.
notes: Patronage act; coronation attested in passing: 'ut enim praeclara imago anno MCMLII, auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii, pretioso diademate est redimita, ita duos post annos aedes ipsa ad dignitatem Basilicae Minoris ... est evecta'. The image is painted on rock ('marialis imago in saxo depicta'); the church is not named in the act. Country explicit ('intra fines Columbianae Civitatis').

rubric_latin: AD TITULUM ET DIGNITATEM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR ECCLESIA B. MARIAE V. DE RUPE, SEU « DE LAS LAJAS » INTRA FINES DIOECESIS PASTOPOLITANAE.
incipit_latin: Templum perdecorum loci amoenitate atque structurae genere conspicuum, in quo Imago Beatae Virginis in saxo depicta, ideoque « de Rupe » appellata, pie excolitur
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; attests 'praeclara Eius Imago, anno millesimo nongentesimo quinquagesimo secundo ... auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii, aureo diademate fuit redimita' - crowned 1952 by authority of the Vatican Chapter. Country explicit ('Reipublicae Columbianae'). The act rubric and opening are on printed page 68 (per the volume index); passage page marker is 69.

rubric_latin: Simulacrum B. M. V. in caelum Assumptae, quod intra fines dioecesis Sonsonensis-Rivi Nigri pie colitur ibique in templo oppidi « Marinilla » asservatur, diademate redimitur pretioso.
incipit_latin: Ut memoriae proditum est, haud licet de praecipuo venerationis cultu dubitare, quo intra fines Ecclesiae Sonsonensis-Rivi Nigri
notes: Retrieved from txt for the AAS 80 index entry 'Marinilla ... 1742'. Bishop: Alfonso Uribe Jaramillo. Country inferred from the see of Sonsón-Rionegro (act does not name Colombia).

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris paroecialis ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virginis « de Mongui », dioecesis Duitamensis, decoratur.
incipit_latin: Sedes religionis ínclita et illustris praedicatur paroeciale templum augustae Virgini Deiparae sacrum, quod in oppidi « Mongui » vulgo appellati ac dioecesis Duitamensis non modicum vertit ornamentum.
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'simulacrum illud, anno MCMXXIX, aureo diademate redimiretur', and the Virgin was made diocesan patron in 1955. The image is said to have been given by Philip II of Spain. Country explicit ('e tota Columbiana Dicione'). The same act's opening also appears in passage AAS-58-1966-ocr#795.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Episcopus S. Rosae de Osos, in Columbia, Imaginem B. M. V. a Misericordiis, nomine atque auctoritate Summi Pontificis coronare.
incipit_latin: Qui divino consilio et voluntate iam in id universo christianorum populo praepositi sumus, ut patris amore per huius procellosi maris undas
notes: Bishop: Joaquín García Ordóñez. Country explicit ('in Columbia').

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM DEI GENITRICI, ANGELORUM REGINAE, IN URBE CARTAGO, INTRA FINES ARCHIDIOECESIS S. IOSEPHI DE COSTARICA DICATUM, TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS DECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Constat ex pluribus praeclaris documentis Rempublicam Costaricensem summa religione colere Beatissimam Virginem Mariam eamque peculiari honore prosequi.
notes: Basilica Minor grant; the coronation is stated in passing: 'anno MCMXXIV, saeculo primo exeunte ab hac solemni renuntiatione, eiusdem Virginis Imago a Ven. Capitulo Patriarchalis Vaticanae Basilicae S. Petri aureo diademate redimita est' - i.e. crowned by the Vatican Chapter, not by a papal legate. Incipit has OCR noise ('Constat ex pluribus JU... ~*.e prae-claris documentis'); noise silently dropped. Vernacular title (Nuestra Senora de los Angeles) is not in the text.

image_title_vernacular: Madonna di Tersatto (Vera Effigie della Madre di Dio dipinta da S. Luca)
citation: BAV, ACSP, Madonne coronate, tomo IV, ff. 205r–214r
act_type: Chapter dossier: conto argentiere, instrumentum donationis, lettera, other, stampa
legate: Gio. Francesco Barbarigo, bishop of Verona (later of Brescia), deputed 17 June 1713; unable to go (plague suspicion) he subdelegated (Venice 14 Sept 1714; Brescia 24 July 1715) the bishop of Segna and Modruš, who being ill was replaced by Georgius Franciscus Xaverius de Marotti, bishop of Dardania, coadjutor of Pedena (Petina), who performed the crowning
deputy: Gio. Francesco Barbarigo, bishop of Verona (later of Brescia), deputed 17 June 1713; unable to go (plague suspicion) he subdelegated (Venice 14 Sept 1714; Brescia 24 July 1715) the bishop of Segna and Modruš, who being ill was replaced by Georgius Franciscus Xaverius de Marotti, bishop of Dardania, coadjutor of Pedena (Petina), who performed the crowning
rubric_latin: Concessa Facultas Coronandi Sacras Imagines Jesù, et Beatæ Mariæ Virginis Existentes in Ecclesia F. F. C. C. Reformatorum S. Francisci Loci Tarsacti in Dalmatia
notes: Crowns: two (Virgin and Child) — 'duas nempe Coronas aureas imponens, unam Iconi Beatissimae Virginis MARIAE, alteram JESU'. Petitioner: Fr. Petrus Francetich (Francievich) à Flumine, Guardian, and the whole Reformed Franciscan convent of Tersatto ('ad instantiam R.di Patris Petri Francetich Guardiani et totius Conventus') — the original petition to the Chapter is not in this range. Contents: silversmith's account of 18 June 1713 ('Iomaso Vanni e Comp.') for two gold crowns 'per la Madonna SS.ma e Suo Bambino nella Chiesa in una Città di Dalmatia', f. 205r (margin 'Nº 230', 'loco detto [Tersatto]'); letter of the bishop of Verona, Verona 3 Aug 1713, acknowledging receipt of the crowns via the bishop of Traù and the faculty to substitute another bishop (ff. 206r–v; OCR 'Teramo' = Tersatto); notarial instrument, Tersatto 14 Sept 1715 (second copy reads 24 Sept), notary Franciscus Laurentius Fracassa, embedding the Chapter's letter of Rome 17 June 1713 (secretary Giacinto Sacripante; second copy OCR '1717'), the Chapter's rite instructions, the subdelegation of Venice 14 Sept 1714 (notary Laurentius Rosetti/Bosetti, nuncio Alexander Aldobrandini) and of Brescia 24 July 1715, and the convent's obligation to keep the crowns (ff. 207r–209v), authenticated by the judges of Fiume 4 Oct 1715 (f. 210r); wrapper f. 211v ('Mons.r Vesc.o di Verona circa la coronazione della B. V. Bambino Giesù esistente nella chiesa de PP. Riformati di S. Fra. in Farsado 1713', margin 'N. 512'); printed 'Vera Effigie della Madre di Dio dipinta da S. Luca e mandata da Urbano V l'anno 1362 a Tersatto' (f. 212r — mentions indulgences of Pius VII and Leo XII, so a 19th-c. print inserted later); letter of the crowning bishop ('Il Ves.co De Menti' = de Marotti), Fiume 14/19 Sept 1715, stating he crowned 'a 8. del corrente' the miraculous image painted by St Luke (ff. 213r–214r). Also at f. 212v a heading 'Conto dell'Ill.mo e Rev.mo Capitolo di S. Pietro delle Corone d'oro — Pro informat.e 1706 7 Octobris — Gio. Giardini Argentiere', a general silversmith account naming no image (not emitted). Country: documents say 'in Dalmatia' and 'Provincie Austriache'; Tersatto/Fiume is modern Trsat/Rijeka, Croatia (inference from the unambiguous place). The wrapper f. 211v also names Leuca — see separate low-confidence record.

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum II die uno et vicesimo mensis Maii anno MCMXCV, occasione data visitationis Apostolicae in urbe Olomucensi, imaginem coronavisse Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae sub titulo Matris Dei in sacra aede Visitationis loco vulgo dicto « Svaty Kopecek » archidioecesis Olomucensis veneratur.
incipit_latin: Gaudio exsultamus cum occasio Nobis datur ut Nostram pietatem in Beatissimam Virginem Mariam significemus

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis imago, quae in Sanctuario mariali loci « Zarosice » intra fines Brunensis dioecesis pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum II per Apostolicam Visitationem in Republica Cecha die XXI mensis Maii anno MCMXCV coronavisse imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae pie colitur in Sanctuario mariali loci « Zarosice » intra fines Brunensis dioecesis.

The Pope himself crowned the image of the Virgin with the Child Jesus (kept by the Canons Regular of the Holy Cross with the Red Star) during his visit, at the Svatý Kopeček sanctuary near Olomouc; requested by Bp Vojtěch (Adalbertus) Cikrle of Brno. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Nulla deinceps intermissa mora, Missam una cum omnibus Reipublicae Dominicanae Episcopis celebravit in Platea, quae ab Independentia nuncupatur, fidelium populo refertissima; postque lectum Evangelium hanc Summus Pontifex homiliam habuit
notes: THE RECORD THIS GAP PASS EXISTS FOR. Homily of John Paul II at the Mass in the Plaza de la Independencia, Santo Domingo, 25 January 1979, first stop of the Iter Apostolicum in Mexicum (AAS 71, 149 ff.; the day is headed 'Die 25 m. Ianuarii', p. 150). Spanish sentence, verbatim: 'Amad a Cristo, amad al hombre por El y vivid la devoción a nuestra querida Madre del cielo, a quien invocáis con el hermoso nombre de Nuestra Señora de la Altagracia, a la que el Papa quiere dejar como homenaje de devoción una diadema.' No word for image appears anywhere near it — the devotion is named by its title only, which is why the mechanical filter dropped it. What the source states is that the Pope wishes to LEAVE a diadem as a homage of devotion; it is not described as a formal liturgical coronation. The homily begins on printed page 155 ('postque lectum Evangelium hanc Summus Pontifex homiliam habuit'); page set to 158, where the diadem sentence stands, as cited by the coordinator. AAS does not name the sanctuary of Higüey; earlier the same day, in the cathedral of Santo Domingo, the Pope prayed 'por intercesión de Nuestra Señora de la Altagracia, cuya imagen está aquí presente' (p. 155) — the only mention of an image. Locality 'Santo Domingo' is the place of the homily, not necessarily the home of the image. Body is in Spanish, so no Latin incipit; rubric_latin is the Latin editorial narrative introducing the homily on p. 155.

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris Sanctuarium B. Mariae Virg. ab Elevatione, dioecesis Ambatensis, exornatur.
incipit_latin: Fide invicta administri sacrorum populusque regionis, quae Ambatensi nunc dioecesi continetur, sacrarium Beatae Mariae Virgini ab Elevatione dicatum aedificarunt
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating that the image, after the Virgin was made patroness of the diocese by Pius XII in 1952 ('anno MCMLII'), was crowned 'auctoritate Petriani Canonicorum Collegii, duobus annis post' — i.e. 1954. The Datum line is OCR'd 'die xxvim mensis Aprilis, anno MCMLXI'; the day is illegible (most likely XXVIII = 28 April 1961), so act_date left null. Country Ecuador explicit ('Apostolici in Aequatoriana Republica Nuntii'; Archbishop of Quito). Previous church collapsed in the 1949 earthquake ('anno MCMXLIX').

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Agua Santa de Baños
legate: Carolus Maria S. R. E. Cardinalis de la Torre, Archiepiscopus Quitensis (in person or through a bishop delegated by him)
rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO, VULGO APPELLATA « NUESTRA SEÑORA DE AGUA SANTA DE BAÑOS », PRAECIPUA PATRONA SACRARUM MISSIONUM AD ETHNICOS REGIONUM ORIENTALIUM REIPUBLICAE AEQUATORIANAE ELIGITUR EIUSQUE SIMULACRUM CORONA REDIMITUR.
incipit_latin: Salutari fonti Alma Deipara non perperam comparatur, quippe quae, submisse invocata, ex inexhausto misericordiae suae penu munera in mortales, aerumnis pressos, dilargiatur
notes: Grant of coronation: « eidem Purpurato Patri, Quitensi Archiepiscopo, eas partes committimus, ut Imagini ... auream coronam ipse vel per sacrorum Antistitem a se ad hoc delegatum, Nostro nomine et auctoritate imponat ». Act date and page confirmed by the volume's chronological index (incipit « Salutari fonti », 1957 Mart. 3, p. 464 — same batch, AAS-50-1958-ocr#1035). The diocese of the shrine is not named (only the Archbishop of Quito as petitioner/executor). The crowning was actually carried out on 13 Dec 1959 — see AAS 52 (1960) 52.

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Agua Santa de Baños

rubric_latin: CHRISTIFIDELIBUS AEQUATORIANAE REIPUBLICAE, B. MARIA VIRG. A ROSARIO V. « DE AGUA SANTA DE BAÑOS » CORONA REDIMITA ET MISSIONUM IN ORIENTALI AEQUATORIANI TERRITORII PLAGA REGINA RENUNTIATA.
incipit_latin: Como el niño al regazo de su madre, así habéis acudido, amadísimos fieles del Ecuador, a las plantas de Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Agua Santa de Baños
notes: Papal radio message delivered on the day of the crowning itself (footnote « Die 13 Decembris mensis a. 1959 »; listed in the volume index under NUNTII RADIOPHONICI, 1959 Dec. 13, p. 52). Text in Spanish: « habéis subido hoy a su trono para poner en las sienes de María Santísima una corona real ». Executes the grant of Pius XII, Litt. Ap. « Salutari fonti » of 3 March 1957, AAS 50 (1958) 464. The Cardinal Legate is not named in the message; the 1957 grant had committed the crowning to Card. Carlos María de la Torre, Abp of Quito. rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AC DIGNITATE DECORATUR ECCLESIA B. MARIAE V. « DEL QUINCHE » IN PAGO VULGO APPELLATO « DEL QUINCHE », ARCHIDIOECESIS QUITENSIS.

Act date and page confirmed by the volume's chronological index (incipit « Mariani cultus », 1959 Maii 2, p. 694 — same batch, AAS-51-1959-ocr#940).

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris paroeciali ecclesiae Beatae Mariae Virginis a Mercede, in urbe Guayaquilensi, conferuntur.

notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating 'Pius Pp. XII, Decessor Noster rec. mem., eandem imaginem sua auctoritate aureo diademate redimiri, datis Apostolicis sub anulo Piscatoris Litteris die VIII mensis Septembris anno MCMXLVII, concessit'. The date 1947-09-08 is that of the Apostolic Letters granting the coronation, not necessarily of the ceremony. Act begins on printed page 87 (passage page-marker is 88). rubric_latin: CHRISTIFIDELIBUS AEQUATORIS NATIONIS, OB SOLEMNEM CORONAE INDUCTIONEM SIMULACRO B. MARIAE VIRGINIS PERDOLENTIS, IN URBE QUITENSI COADUNATIS.
incipit_latin: Amadísimos hijos, — católicos ecuatorianos y, más en especial, católicos quiteños — que con suma devoción y entusiasmo colocáis hoy una corona sobre las sienes de vuestra « Dolorosa del Colegio »

The rubric itself records the solemn imposition of the crown. Cross-listed in the volume's analytic index s.v. « Coronatio ... B. M. V. Perdolentis, in urbe Quitensi, 292 » (p. 897). The message does not name the church or state a papal grant.

rubric_latin: Ecclesia Beatae Mariae V. de Guadalupe, loci « La Ceiba de Guadalupe », in archidioecesi et urbe S. Salvatoris in America, privilegiis Basilicae Minoris honestatur.

notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating 'anno MCMLIII Petriani Canonicorum Collegii concessu et auctoritate aureo diademate redimita'. Act begins on printed page 87 (passage page-marker is 88). Shrine served by the Clerics Regular of Somascha.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Domina Nostra a Pace seu « Nuestra Señora de la Paz » principalis Patrona totius Salvatorianae Reipublicae eligitur.
