notes: Crowns: two (Virgin and Child). Only a goldsmith's account (dated 'a di 24 Febrajo 1696', total 176.20 scudi, 61.20 remaining) with the payment order signed by 'M. Patriarca d'Antiochia Can.co Deputato' and the outer docket (f.161v) 'Conto ... delle Corone di Oro' signed Giardini (Gio. Giardini orefice). The docket margin 'Decreta 3 9bris 1696' (3 Nov 1696) is taken as the concession year, but it post-dates the account's own date, so the association is uncertain (OCR of one of the dates may be wrong). No other document for this image in the range.

citation: BAV, ACSP, Madonne coronate, tomo IV, ff. 162r–169r
act_type: Chapter dossier: conto argentiere, decretum, lettera, other, supplica
register_refs: ['Caps. 1. fasc. 2.', 'To. XVIII p. 13', 'ex decr. caplanibus To. XVIII p. 13', 'ex libr. XVIII. Decr. Cap. p. 6']
rubric_latin: Decreta fuit 17. Xbris 1696 corona redimita in die Assumptionis 1697 ex decr. caplanibus To. XVIII p. 13.
notes: Crowns: one new gold crown for the Child ('una Corona d'oro lavorata con fiori e cartelle per il Bambino'); the existing crowns of the Virgin and Child recoloured and burnished. Petitioner: Capitolo e Canonici della Basilica di S. Pietro (the Chapter itself). Contents: decree 2 March 1697 deputing the Sacrista Maggiore and Fabretti to oversee restoration of the sacristy chapel where the image stands (100 scudi from the Fabbrica); account of 25 June 1697 for the Child's crown (39.45 scudi, signed Tomaso Vannini camerlengo), docket 'Gio: Giardini Orefice'; supplica to the Pope for a plenary indulgence for the crowning 'alli 14 del corrente mese d'Agosto', granted 7 Aug 1697 by Card. Albani 'pro unica vice'; a note (f.168r, dated 3 Jan 1695 by 'Parruccini Vic.o') that Innocent XII conceded the indulgence for the crowning after the Vespers of the Assumption, with f.168v recording an indulgence brief of 11 Aug 1695 (Caps. 1 fasc. 2), suggesting the crowning was first planned for 1695 and carried out in 1697; f.169r gives the inscription on the Child's crown 'Cap.lum S. Petri de urbe hanc cor. au. ex legato Ill.mi Com. Alex. Sfortiae An. 1697'. Coronation date: docket says 'in die Assumptionis 1697', supplica says 14 August (eve/after Vespers) — 15 Aug 1697 adopted, 14 Aug possible. f.167r is a later letter to Mons. Guerrieri asking that the image, 'la prima ad esser decorata della corona d'oro' in Sforza's lifetime, be crowned anew. OCR gives 'Madonna della Pieve' at f.168r for 'della Febre'. | f.168r (OCR) calls the image 'Madonna s:ma della Pieve ... nella Sagrestia della Basilica di S. Pietro' - almost certainly 'della Febre' as f.169r reads. f.168r: letter of the Vicar (Parruccini Vic.o) on the plenary indulgence granted by Innocent XII for the day of the coronation, 'Dati li 3. Gen. 1695'; f.168v: note on the Brief 'Dat. 11. Aug. 1695 = Caps. 1. fasc. 2.' and 'Decreta fuit 17. Xbris 1696 corona redimita in die Assumptionis 1697 ex decr. caplanibus To. XVIII p. 13'; f.169r: text of the inscription on the crown ('Cap.lum S. Petri de urbe hanc cor. au. ex legato Ill.mi Com. Alex. Sfortiae An. 1697'). Years 1695 vs 1696/97 may be OCR noise. This is the first leaf of the range; earlier documents of this dossier may lie in the preceding batch (not visible).

rubric_latin: Summus Pontifex, die primo Novembris mensis a. MCMLIV in Basilica Vaticana, adstantibus Emis Patribus Cardinalibus atque plurimis Excmis PP. Sacrorum Antistitibus, coram christifidelium multitudine, antequam imaginem B. M. V., quae « Salus Populi Romani » appellatur, aurea corona redimiret, sollemniter proclamans novum festum liturgicum Beatae Mariae Virginis Caeli terraeque Reginae, haec verba fecit:
incipit_latin: Le testimonianze di omaggio e di devozione verso la Madre di Dio, che l'Universo cattolico ha moltiplicate nei mesi trascorsi
notes: Pius XII crowned the icon 'Salus Populi Romani' with a golden crown himself, in the Vatican Basilica, on 1 November 1954, immediately after proclaiming the new feast of the BVM Queen of heaven and earth. The heading, printed as an editorial rubric in italics, is the source of all details; the body of the address is in Italian, so incipit_latin is in fact Italian. The passage does not say where the image is normally kept (S. Maria Maggiore), so church_or_sanctuary is left null. OCR 'MGMLIV'/'Etfhis' corrected to 'MCMLIV'/'Emis'. Filed under ALLOCUTIONES, item II.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. CLEMENTEM S. R. E. CARDINALEM MICARA, EPISCOPUM VELITERNUM EUNDEMQUE SUMMI PONTIFICIS IN URBE VICARIUM: OB FELICEM AC SALUTAREM EXITUM ANNI MARIALIS.
incipit_latin: Cum Marialis Annus proxime exeat, quem Encyclicis datis Litteris indiximus (« Fulgens Corona » ; A. A. S. 1953 pag. 577 sq.)
notes: Pius XII states he himself crowned the image: « cum priscam Deiparae Virginis imaginem, quae ‹salus populi Romani› dicitur ... Nobis licuit aurea redimire corona ». The coronation clause falls on printed page 709; the act (Epistula VII to Card. Micara) begins on printed page 708, which is cited here as aas_page. The church is not named in the coronation clause itself but the same letter twice names the Basilica Liberiana as the site of the Marian Year opening/closing.

rubric_latin: Sacra aedes in dioecesi S. Marci Argentanensis Beatae Mariae Virginis Nativitati dicata, quae vulgari sermone « Maria Santissima del Pettoruto » cognominatur, ad gradum et dignitatem Basilicae Minoris evehitur.
incipit_latin: Innumera fere sunt templa a populo Christiano toto terrarum orbe per labentem saeculorum cursum ad praecelsae Dei Genetricis honorem dicata.
notes: Basilica Minor elevation act that states in passing the image was crowned in 1903 'de Petriani Canonicorum Collegii sententia, praestanti est diademate redimitum'. Passage printed_page is 976 but the act begins on p. 975 (rubric V there); aas_page set to the act's start page. Country from 'regionis Calabriae' in the text.

image_title_vernacular: Madonna delle Grazie della Terra di S. Giovanni (Valdarno)
citation: BAV, ACSP, Madonne coronate, tomo IV, ff. 90r–97v
act_type: Chapter dossier: conto argentiere, instrumentum donationis, relazione, stampa
legate: Scipione de' Ricci, Patrizio Fiorentino, Referendary of both Signatures, Canon of St Peter's
deputy: Scipione de' Ricci, Patrizio Fiorentino, Referendary of both Signatures, Canon of St Peter's
rubric_latin: RELAZIONE DEL PRINCIPIO, E CAUSE DELLA VENERAZIONE DELL'IMMAGINE DELLA SANTISSIMA VERGINE DETTA DELLE GRAZIE DELLA TERRA DI S. GIOVANNI Da Coronarsi solennemente il dì 8. di Settembre 1704
notes: Crowns: two (Virgin and Child), weight 59 scudi d'oro meno 9 grani per conto. Petitioner: Operai of the Oratory (Giovanni Michele Santini, Alessandro de' Bessi, Vittorio de' Rossi, Antonio Camillo de' Giovini, Andrea del Bello) / Deputati sopra la Solennità. Instrument (two copies, ff.91r-92r) actum 8 Sept 1704 at S. Giovanni under Cosimo III, notary Ottaviano de' Pasquini(?) da Lastra/Camerina; crowning performed in the Oratory at pontifical Mass of Orazio 'de Lanciarichis' (Panciatichi), Bishop of Fiesole. Concession date from endorsement f.92v.01 'Romæ sub die 15 maii 1704' (reading as the decree date is an inference, medium). Second endorsement f.92v.02 is badly garbled ('B. M. V. de Rupe, sive nuncupatæ Tra:tarn ... Actum die 27 Aug. 1707') — likely OCR damage on the same instrument, not a separate event. Register ref 'Caps. 39. fasc. 38g' probably = 'Caps. 39. fasc. 3'. Conto on f.90r names the image as 'esistente nella cità di Fiesole in Toschana' (i.e. diocese). f.93v: a mostly unread conto by 'Gio. Giustini/Giardini Argentiere' with margin 'conceditur die 6 Octobr' (no year) and '5 Octobr' on f.94r — placement suggests it belongs to this dossier but it could concern another image. Printed Relazione (Firenze, Michele Nestenus, 1704) ff.94r-97v narrates the 1479 miracle of Mona Tancia and the 1596 fire. | Tail end of a printed historical relazione (long-s typography) that begins in the previous batch; the page opens mid-text ('E Fabio Segni col seguente'). The image's title is not given in this range: it is described as the miraculous painted image of the Virgin and Child at the Porta di S. Lorenzo of the Terra of S. Giovanni in Tuscany / Valdarno ('Beatus Aegidius in Valle Arnensi in Tuscia'; Florentine dominion), with the 1479 Mona Tancia milk miracle, the 1596 fire, privileges of Sixtus IV and Innocent VIII. The relazione closes 'si porta da Noi Deputati sopra la mentovata Incoronazione', so a coronation had been performed, but no date, deputy or concession appears here. The modern designation (Madonna delle Grazie, San Giovanni Valdarno) is an inference, not in the text. Country inferred from Tuscany/Firenze.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, a Septem Doloribus appellata, totius regionis Ciminiae principalis Patrona renuntiatur.
incipit_latin: Quae regio monte silva ac lacu distinguitur, Ciminia commune quoddam marialis religionis domicilium habet constitutum sacris illis iurisdictionibus quae circa sunt.
notes: Patronage act attesting the crowning: 'Siquidem anno MCMXXXVIII effigies illa fuit aureo diademate redimita', and 'quinto et vicesimo exeunte anno postquam praedicta imago est coronata' (25th anniversary, consistent with 1938 + 25 = 1963). No crowning authority named. Country inferred from the sees named (Viterbo, Civita Castellana, Nepi/Sutri), not stated.

image_title_vernacular: Madonna Nicopeja (Santa Maria della Vittoria), San Vito dei Normanni
rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum PP. II occasione data pastoralis visitationis archidioecesis Brundusinae-Ostunensis die XXVI mensis Octobris anno MCMXCVI coronavisse imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nicopeia », quae religiose colitur in ecclesia paroeciali Sanctae Mariae a Victoria in oppido v.d. « San Vito dei Normanni ».
incipit_latin: Ubi victoria de malo subest et de peccato ipsaque de morte ea quidem est tribuenda Christi sacrificio, qui homo est factus.
notes: The Pope crowned the image himself during Mass on his pastoral visit, at the request of Abp Settimio Todisco. Letters signed 'De speciali mandato Sanctissimi' by Abp Giovanni Battista Re, Substitute. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

image_title_vernacular: Madonna Nicopeja (Santa Maria della Vittoria), San Vito dei Normanni
rubric_latin: Templum paroeciale Sanctae Mariae a Victoria, quod in urbe « San Vito dei Normanni » intra fines archiepiscopalis sedis Brundusinae-Ostunensis exstat, ad Basilicae minoris gradum dignitatemque evehitur.
incipit_latin: Inter sacras aedes antiquae et insignis archiepiscopalis sedis Brundusinae-Ostunensis merito celebratur paroeciale templum Sanctae Mariae a Victoria in urbe « S. Vito dei Normanni »
notes: Basilica minor elevation act which states in passing that John Paul II himself crowned the image: 'ubi impensa pietate colitur imago Dei Genetricis « Nicopeia » nuncupatae, quam Nos Ipsi in Petriano huiusce almae Urbis foro anno MCMXCVI coronavimus'. Could equally be classed papal_personal_coronation, but the act's own object is the basilica title. Only the year (1996) of the crowning is given, in St Peter's Square. Country (Italy) inferred from San Vito dei Normanni / Brindisi-Ostuni, not stated. Act begins on printed page 346; passage printed_page was 345.

legate: Federicus Tedeschini, S.R.E. Cardinalis, Archipresbyter of the Vatican Basilica
rubric_latin: ECCLESIA DEO IN HONOREM SANCTI SYRI, IN CIVITATE « SANREMO », VENTIMILIENSIS DIOECESIS DICATA, HONORIBUS BASILICAE MINORIS INSIGNITUR.
incipit_latin: « Vere non est hic aliud, nisi domus Dei et porta Caeli ». Quod recte dicitur de qualibet aede sacra, etiam in angusto vico remota
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'quamque, superiore anno, mense Octobri, Dilectus Filius Noster Fridericus S.R.E. Presbyter Cardinalis Tedeschini ... aurea corona sollemniter redimivit'. 'superiore anno' relative to the act date (7 Oct 1947) gives October 1946; the year is not printed, hence medium confidence. Image is the 'Effigies Beatae Mariae Virginis de Rosario, Urbis Patronae'; vernacular title supplied as the Italian form of the Latin.

rubric_latin: CATHEDRALIS ECCLESIA DEO IN HONOREM SANCTI MICHAELIS ARCHANGELI DICATA IN CIVITATE AC DIOECESI SANCTI ANGELI IN VADO TITULO AC DIGNITATE BASILICAE MINORIS DECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Arridet in caelis Beatissima Deipara Virgo Maria « quasi aurora consurgens », « pulchra ut luna, electa ut sol »
notes: Pius XII crowned the image with his own hand at Castel Gandolfo: 'Simulacrum Virginis Mariae « a Planctu » aureo diademate ipsa manu Nostra redimire voluimus in Arce Gandulphi die xi huius mensis Augusti'; the act is 'Datum ex Arce Gandulphi ... die xii mensis Augusti, anno MCMXXXXVII', so the coronation date is 11 Aug 1947. Passage printed_page was 103; act begins on printed p. 102.

rubric_latin: AD DIGNITATEM ET HONOREM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR PAROECIALIS ECCLESIA S. MARGARITAE, V. ET M., IN CIVITATE « SANTA MARGHERITA LIGURE », INTRA FINES CLAVARENSIS DIOECESIS EXSTANS.
incipit_latin: « Quasi plantatio rosae » exaltata in populo christiano, cui dat « suavitatem odoris », Beatissima Virgo Maria, divino testante praeconio, semper habita est
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; attests in passing 'ex quo Dei Genetricis Imago « a Rosa » appellata, est aurea corona redimita' on the occasion of the 175th anniversary ('faustam septuagesimi quinti anni, supra centesimum, opportunitatem nactus'). Coronation year 1776 is computed by subtracting 175 from the act date 1951 — not stated verbatim; a checker should verify. Passage begins mid-rubric; rubric restored from txt/AAS-43-1951-ocr.txt. Act begins on printed page 669 (passage was indexed at 670).

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS AC PRIVILEGIIS AFFICITUR ECCLESIA PAROECIALIS B. M. V. IN CAELUM ASSUMPTAE IN OPPIDO V. « SANTA MARIA IN VICO », ACERRARUM DIOECESIS.
incipit_latin: Haud raro accidit ut sacrum quoddam Simulacrum, praesertim si vetustum, si ex oriente adductum, novae pietatis initium fiat atque religionis
notes: « laudatum Mariale Simulacrum, aurea corona anno MCMXHI [MCMXIII] Sancti Pii Pp. X nomine et auctoritate sollemniter redimitum ». OCR of the year reads MCMXHI = MCMXIII (1913). Town spelled « Santa Maria in Vico » in the rubric, « Santa Maria a Vico » in the body.

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. IOSEPHUM SCATTI, EPISCOPUM SAVONENSEM ET NAULENSEM, DE SACRIS SOLLEMNIBUS ANNO PROXIMO SAVONAE CELEBRANDIS QUOD CENTUM ANNIS ANTE PIUS VII P. M. IMAGINEM " MATRIS MISERICORDIAE " CORONA REDIMIERAT.
incipit_latin: Si unquam recentioribus aetatibus Petri navicula turbulentissimis est iactata fluctibus, id certe tum evenit
notes: Pius VII crowned the image in person: 'post annum, promissa exsecutus, istic miserentissimae Matris imaginem pretiosa corona redimiit'. The year 1815 is derived from the rubric ('centum annis ante') read against the centenary solemnities announced for 7-13 May 1915 - not printed as a numeral, so treat the year as reconstructed. Same act indexed at AAS 6 (1914) 733-734 and 762.

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. IOSEPHUM SCATTI, EPISCOPUM SAVONENSEM ET NAULENSEM, OB SOLLEMNIA SAECULARIA IN HONOREM DOMINAE NOSTRAE A MISERICORDIA.

legate: Marius Aloisius S. R. E. Cardinalis Ciappi, O.P.
rubric_latin: Fit potestas Romani Pontificis nomine auctoritateque redimiendi serto pretioso signum Beatae Virginis Mariae a Rosario sive a Flagello in Sancti Dominici sanctuario apud « Soriano Calabro » dioecesis Miletensis.

rubric_latin: I Deputati della Madonna ss.ma di Tirano in Valtellina Dioc. di Como ... / margin f.26v: '10 Apr. 1690 Decreta fuit'
notes: Crowns: two (Virgin and Child) — 'duas Coronas Auri', 18 ounces, value 200 scudi auri de Camera (instrument); 'doi Corone di Oro ... de la Madonna e del suo Bambino' (silversmith's account). Petitioner: Deputati della Madonna SS.ma di Tirano (Deputati et Rectores of the sanctuary: Antonio Meriti, Orazio Francesco Lucino, Domenico Mattio, Giacomo Liazzi), through a supplica to Pope Alexander VIII; the commemorative inscription says the honour was procured by Francesco Saverio Guicciardi, Bishop of Narni. Only the undated petition to the Pope (f.24r-v) and an inserted printed sheet with Latin captions listing the Virgin's miracles ('Præsentissima Virginis Tiranensis ope', 'Vbi steterunt pedes Mariæ', 'cum privil.') fall within this range; no decree, instrument or coronation date is visible here. The dossier runs to the end of the batch (f.25v blank) and is shared with the next batch, so any concession/coronation documents would lie past this range. Image subject not specified in these pages (whether with Child unknown). 'Levmaria' in the OCR is unclear (perhaps 'Lombardia'/'Germania'). | Whole range is one dossier. Contents: supplica of the Deputati to Alexander VIII (ff.24r-24v, docket f.26v with margin note '10 Apr. 1690 Decreta fuit' = concession date); printed devotional sheets inserted at f.25r ('Praesentissima Virginis Tiranensis ope', 'Ubi steterunt pedes Mariae') and ff.36r-37v ('Raptus Angelorum', 'Virgo Tiranensis'; one sheet marked 'Rinouato dal Bianchi 1780', a later insertion); silversmith's account f.27r (two gold crowns for Madonna and Bambino, total 239.20 scudi after tare; silversmith named in margin f.32v as 'Gio: Giardini Arg.o'; ff.31r-32v otherwise only page numerals); notarial instrument ff.28r-30r drawn by Paolo Francesco Bononi, notary of Como, dated Friday 29 Sept 1690 (weekday verified), crowns placed on the heads of the images of the Virgin and Child in the church, hymn Ave Maris Stella sung; vicar-general's attestation dated Como 7 Oct 1690; authenticated copy (f.33r) of the inscription on a large commemorative 'Quadro' hung in the sanctuary, signed by canon G. B. Robustelli; Mugiasca's relazione ff.34r-35r (left Como 1 Sept 1690, crowning on the feast of St Michael with ~20,000 people, Mass sung by the archpriest, Capuchin panegyric); f.35v is a stray unrelated fragment of Chapter business; ff.38r-48v a printed book 'Breve Istoria della miracolosissima Madonna di Tirano' by Gio. Antonio Cornacchi (1621; reprint Parma/Milano 1747), which runs on past f.48v. The place is called 'Tivano' in parts of the instrument (OCR/scribal variant of Tirano). The relazione (f.34v) has the panegyric 'in Lode della Beata Vergine del Lago' — likely OCR garbling, since every other document names Tirano. The instrument locates Tirano in the 'Statuum Ill.mor D.norum Rhetorum' (under the Grisons in 1690); country given as Italy on the basis of the place itself (the supplica calls it 'uno dei più famosi Santuarii d'Italia'). The crowned object is described as 'la Statua in mezzo la Chiesa' in the relazione, while the book describes the altar ancona with the effigy of Our Lady standing; the instrument speaks of two 'Sacrae Imagines' (Virgin and Child). No 'Lib.'/'Caps.' register cross-references occur in this range; the marginal numerals (30-46) are foliation/page counts only. Supplica begins with its heading at f.24r, so the dossier appears to start here, but folios before 24r were not visible. | Only a printed booklet (chapters IV to the end, with 'Addizioni', twelve Latin 'Elogia' on the Venerable Mario Omodei, and a closing protestation signed 'Homodaeus Anonymus') is in range; it begins mid-way (printed p. 45 at f. 46r), so chapters I-III and any supplica/decree/instrument for this image lie before pb 113. No coronation document, concession date or deputy is visible in the range. Diocese taken from the booklet itself ('Archivio del Vescovato di Como', 'Vescovo di Como'). Which image was crowned (the 'Ancona ... con l'effigie di Nostra Signora Santissima in piedi' over the privileged altar, or the facade statue with the Child) is not stated. OCR damage: many pages have marginal columns of broken word-fragments (pb 115, 117, 124-125, 129, 131, 133, 135, 137, 141, 143, 145, 147, 149, 151, 153).

legate: Augustinus S. R. E. Presbyter Cardinalis Richelmy, Archiepiscopus Taurinensis
rubric_latin: BREVE quo Archiepiscopo Taurinensi committitur facultas solemniter coronandi, nomine et auctoritate Apostolica, Imaginem Mariae SS. Auxiliatricis.
incipit_latin: Omnium sane templorum quae bo. me. Ioannes Bosco Salesianae Sodalitatis pater legifer ad maiorem Dei gloriam
notes: Rubric OCR reads 'nomine et tauctoritate Apostolica' -> 'auctoritate'; addressee line OCR spaced as 'R i c h e l m y'. The Brief commits to the Archbishop of Turin the faculty to crown the image 'solemni ritu Nostro nomine et auctoritate', with a diadem to be imposed on both heads ('sacro utrique capiti tum Virginis tum Pueri Iesu diadema pro dignitate imponatur') - so the Infant Jesus is crowned as well. Petitioner: Michael Rua, Rector Major of the Salesians. Classified as papal_coronation_act because this is the granting act itself, though it simultaneously deputes Card. Richelmy to crown in the Pope's name (papal_legate_deputation is a defensible alternative). Exact coronation date not stated: only 'huius anni die per te eligendo', i.e. a day of 1903 to be chosen by the Archbishop. Datum 'die XIII Februarii MCMIII' = 1903, the second year of ASS vol. 35 (1902-03). Text of the act runs on to printed p. 581.

rubric_latin: EPISTOLA SS.mi D. N. Leonis PP. XIII ad Moderatorem Generalem Salesianorum, occasione eorumdem conventus.
incipit_latin: Cogendum proxime significabas Salesianorum ex omni terrarum orbe conventum, eumque, Deiparae Adiutricis ope suffultum
notes: Incidental mention inside a letter to Michael Rua: the forthcoming international Salesian congress is to close with the solemn crowning of the image - 'solemniis iri conclusum declarabas eiusdem magnae Dei Matris insigni corona induendae'. Same image as ASS 35, 580 (Maria Auxiliatrix, Turin); dedup expected. The letter itself names no church or town, but the address line reads 'Dilecto filio Michaeli Rua Moderatori Generali Sodalitatis Salesianae Augustae Taurinorum', hence Turin; locality/diocese/country inferred from that address line, so confidence lowered to medium. Datum OCR 'die x n Maii MGMIII' read as die XII Maii MCMIII = 1903-05-12 (Pontificatus anno vigesimo sexto confirms 1903). Coronation year 1903 inferred from the imminence of the congress relative to the letter's date.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA AUGUSTAE TAURINORUM IN HONOREM VIRGINIS CHRISTIANORUM ADIUTRICIS ERIGITUR IN BASILICAM MINOREM.
incipit_latin: Anno reparatae salutis MDCCCLXXXVI pietate ac religione insignis vir, venerabilis Dei famulus Ioannes Bosco, Salesianae familiae pater ac legifer, Augustae Taurinorum ab imis fundamentis splendidum in honorem Deiparae Virginis Christianorum Adiutricis templum excitandum curavit
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; states that Leo XIII gave the Cardinal Archbishop of Turin the faculty to impose a golden diadem in his name and by his authority 'sexto Kalendas Iunias anno millesimo nongentesimo tertio' = 27 May 1903. The crowner is not named at that point ('Cardinali Antistiti Taurinensium'); the same act later names Augustinus S. R. E. Card. Richelmy as Archbishop of Turin, so legate left null. Passage printed_page was 411; the act begins on printed page 410 (rubric and incipit verified in the volume text), used as aas_page. Country Italy inferred from Turin - unambiguous.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM B. M. V. MATRIS GRATIARUM, UTINI, TITULO AC DIGNITATE BASILICAE MINORIS CONDECORATUR.

notes: Basilica minor elevation; states the image was 'aureo diademate anno MDCCCLXX auctoritate Apostolica redimitam'. OCR of rubric read 'CONDE COR ATUR'; foundation year printed 'anno MXXXX' (likely OCR corruption). No vernacular title given in the act.

rubric_latin: AD R. P. D. IOANNEM GAMBERONI, ARCHIEPISCOPUM VERCELLENSIUM: DE SACRO SOLEMNI RITU QUO DIADEMATE ORNABATUR THAUMATURGA B. M. V. IMAGO IN METROPOLITANA AEDE.
incipit_latin: Maximus ille venerationis cultus erga sanctissimam Dei Parentem, qui a prima aetate amoris flammam in Nobis accendit semperque aluit
notes: The passage itself is the volume index (printed p. 706); the act is Benedict XV's Epistola I at printed p. 38 of AAS 14 (1922), consulted in txt/AAS-14-1922-ocr.txt and used for rubric, incipit and date. The letter congratulates on the forthcoming solemn rite in which the image will be crowned ('proximis diebus ... thaumaturga Imago diademate ornabitur ... quae sub nomine Madonna degli infermi tribus abhinc saeculis mirifica pietate colitur'); it is not itself the grant of coronation. Coronation year 1921 inferred from 'proximis diebus' plus the letter's date. Volume-text rubric OCR reads 'ORNARATUR'.

image_title_vernacular: Beata Vergine della Giara (Madonna di Loreto) dei PP. Teatini, Verona
citation: BAV, ACSP, Madonne coronate, tomo IV, ff. 235r–241v
act_type: Chapter dossier: conto argentiere, instrumentum donationis, other, relazione, stampa
legate: Gio. Francesco Barbarigo, Bishop of Verona (margin note: '30 9bris 1708 R. D. Barbarigo ad imponend. coronam deputatus')
deputy: Gio. Francesco Barbarigo, Bishop of Verona (margin note: '30 9bris 1708 R. D. Barbarigo ad imponend. coronam deputatus')
rubric_latin: Breue notizia dell' Incoronazione della B. Vergine della Giara, da farſi nella Chieſa di S. Nicolò d[e' Chierici Regolari] ... Verona li 3. Nou. 1709
notes: Crowns: two (Virgin and Child). Petitioner: PP. Chierici Regolari Teatini of the Giara, Verona ('porgere umile istanza all'istesso Reverendissimo Capitolo di S. Pietro'). Contents: (a) conto of the silversmith (f. 235r; signed 'Gio: Giardini Arg.ro' on the wrapper f. 238v) for two crowns 'all'Imperiale' of 15 December [1708] 'p.a La Madonna di Loreto e Bambino da PP. Teatini della Ghiara di Verona', 166 sc. 97½, final payment ordered 17 May 1709; (b) notarial act by Bernardo Ronchi, episcopal vice-chancellor, of the coronation performed in S. Nicolò by Bishop Barbarigo as delegate of the Chapter 'ex Epistola sub Dat. Romae die prima 8bris 1708', with chancery authentication (two copies, ff. 236r–237v; one copy's authentication reads 11 Aug. 1709, the other 11 9bris 1709); (c) printed 'Breve notizia' of the coronation, Verona 3 Nov. 1709 (ff. 239r, two OCR passes, text cut off at end of range). Coronation date: the OCR reads 'Die vero Dominica 19.a M[ensis] 8bris' 1709, but 19 Oct. 1709 was a Saturday, the stampa of 3 Nov. 1709 still calls the coronation 'da farsi', and the authentication is dated 11 Nov.; Sunday 10 Nov. 1709 fits all of these, so 1709-11-10 is a reconstruction (hence confidence medium; year 1709 is certain). Concession year 1708 inferred from the delegation letter of 1 Oct. 1708 and the margin note '30 9bris 1708 R. D. Barbarigo ad imponend. coronam deputatus' (f. 238v); no decree text is present. Crowns weighed 'Unciarum septem, unius quarti, et denariorum septem cum dimidio'. The Theatine provost was P. Pietro Paolo Masperoni. | Range opens mid-document: the closing formulae of the notarial act (notary Bernardo Ronchi, 'Veronae in Templo S. Nicolai Congregationis RR. PP. Teatinorum'), with episcopal authentication dated 11 Aug/11 Nov 1709 (OCR variants). Documents in range: notarial act close (237v inserts), Giardini's 'Conto 2 ... delle Corone d'Oro' cover with deputation note 30 Nov 1708 (238v), printed 'Breue notizia' (Verona, Fratelli Merli 1709; several copies, 239r-239v inserts), archivist label 'Relazione del origin. e promozione ... nella Chiesa de RR Teatini di Verona 1709' (239v.05), and printed programme 'Il Trionfo di Maria' fireworks for the coronation of the 'Madonna della Chiesa della Giara delli Chierici Regolari in Verona' dedicated to Bishop Barbarigo (240r-241v). The image is a statue of the Madonna of Loreto with Child made in Loreto and installed 25 Mar 1648. The programme says the bishop was deputed 'fin da principio' to avoid sending a Roman prelate; one garbled OCR copy (pb 567) mentions 'Monsignor Marchese Casali Canonico' as deputed, but this passage does not appear in the other copies and looks like OCR confabulation. Concession date not given in range (only the deputation date 30 Nov 1708).

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris ecclesiae paroeciali Sancti Andreae Apostoli in urbe « Viareggio » conferuntur.
incipit_latin: Quae hodie quasi ocellus Tyrrhenae orae vulgo praedicatur, urbs « Viareggio » fuit antea propugnaculum barbarorum incursionibus oppositum, ac vicus quem humiles incolebant piscatores.
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation stated: 'Virginis simulacrum, Petriani Canonicorum collegii auctoritate coronatum' (Vatican Chapter), with no year given. Diocese taken from 'attenta commendatione Ordinarii Lucensis'. The act begins on printed p. 913 (the coronation sentence is on p. 914); passage printed_page is 912. Country inferred, not stated.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris Sanctuario Mariali, quod a « Sacro Monte di Viggiano » appellatur et intra Potentinae-Marsicensis dioecesis fines est situm, deferuntur.
incipit_latin: Lucanae genti universae carissimum constat esse sacrarium, quod in finibus Potentinae et Marsicensis dioecesis exsurgit
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation attested in passing: 'hunc ipsum in annum, quindecim revolutis lustris, coronati Leonis Pp. XIII auctoritate simulacri memoria incidet sollemniterque agetur' — the image was crowned by the authority of Leo XIII, and the 75th anniversary (quindecim lustra) falls in the year of the act. No explicit coronation year is given; c. 1890-1891 is implied by the arithmetic (act dated Dec 1965, anniversary 'hunc ipsum in annum') — left null deliberately, a checker should confirm. The image is a statue of the Virgin holding the Infant Jesus ('simulacrum Augustae Virginis Puerum Iesum sustinentis'). Country inferred from Lucania/Basilicata; not stated. The act opens on printed page 566; the coronation clause falls on page 567.

rubric_latin: Sanctuarium vulgo nuncupatum « Madonna Consolatrice del Carpinelle », quod in oppido « Visciano » intra fines Ecclesiae Nolanae exstat, ad Basilicae Minoris dignitatem evehitur.
incipit_latin: Intra fines Nolanae dioecesis in oppido « Visciano » Sanctuarium clarum exstat vulgo nuncupatum « Madonna Consolatrice del Carpinello »
notes: Basilica Minor elevation act stating 'quam Vaticanum Capitulum die xx mensis Aprilis anno MDCCCLXXXVI sollemni ritu coronavit'. The rubric spells 'Carpinelle', the body 'Carpinello'. Country inferred from Nola/Visciano.

citation: BAV, ACSP, Madonne coronate, tomo IV, ff. 122r–141r

Trinità, copied 3 Oct 1856 by Alessandro D'Achille), other (instrumentum coronationis — notarial act of the crowning of 12 Nov 1715 with consignment of the crowns to the Prior, authenticated by Card. legate: Canonico Pietro Francesco Bussi, canon of St Peter's, 'Viterbiensis Patritius'
deputy: Canonico Pietro Francesco Bussi, canon of St Peter's, 'Viterbiensis Patritius'

rubric_latin: Unicae Et Vetustissimae Viterbiensium Spei Ac Liberatrici Deiparae Mariae Virgini In Hac Vera Archetypi Sui Vultus Imagine Non Sine Prodigio Depictae
notes: Crowns: two (Virgin and Child) — 'due Corone d'oro, una grande, et una piccola', made by Giovanni Giardini, argentiere, Rome, total 169.76½ scudi. Petitioner: Città / Magistrato di Viterbo (Comunità di Viterbo; letter of Bernardino Baroni, 25 May 1712). Letter of Bernardino Baroni (margin: 'Belardino Peroni', secretary of the Comunità di Viterbo), Viterbo 25 May 1712, about the city's failed plans to fund a solemn coronation and leaving it to the friars. Margin f. 123v labels it as concerning 'la Madonna S.ma della Quercia' - contradicting the letter's 'della Trinità' and f. 124r's 'Chiesa de Padri Agostiniani della Città di Viterbo'; probably an archivist's slip or OCR. Margin f. 123v: 'Decrevere 28 Maii 1696'. f. 124r: payment order of 27 Sept 1715 signed 'Moreno Vaiani Econ.o Dep.to'. No relazione or instrument in range and f. 124v is the last page, so the dossier likely continues. | The letter on f.122r (Bernardino Baroni, Viterbo 25 May 1712) opens mid-text with no salutation, so the dossier probably begins on the preceding leaf (outside this range). Concession date taken from the margin note 'Decrevere 28 Maii 1696' on f.123v; the same note reads the image as 'Madonna S.ma della Quercia' (OCR) whereas the letter itself and all other documents say 'della Trinità' / 'Liberatrice' — treat 'Quercia' as an OCR or archivist slip. The Latin instrument on f.128r reads 'die duodecima Mensis Iulii' (OCR), but the Breve Notizia, the pastoral letter, the inscriptions ('Idibus Novembris') and the archivist's note all give 12 November 1715. The pastoral letter (Card. Michelangelo Conti, bishop of Viterbo e Toscanella, Rome 1 Nov 1715, printed Viterbo 1715) and the Breve Notizia both survive in two copies (ff.127r, 130r–136r). Margin note on f.122r 'Sacra mad.na dal R.m... Ab.te d'Orvieto: Andrea Ricci al R.mo Cap.lo di S. Pietro' is obscure and may belong to another letter. f.136v.02 (pb 328) carries a stray list of Genoese-looking names (Martinengo, Giustiniani, Manganaro) with a marginal '181', unrelated to the coronation. The silversmith's account is dated 28 Sept / 9 Nov 1715; the first payment order is dated 27 Sept 1715 (Moreno Vaiani, Economo Deputato). | Only the last leaf of a dossier: a transcription of a votive inscription set up by S.P.Q.V. (Viterbo) on the Nones of May 1703 (Clement XI) thanking the Virgin for preserving the city from the earthquakes of that year; placed 'a parte Epistolae Maioris Altaris' (church not named). Copied 3 Oct 1856 by Alessandro D'Achille. f.140v-141r blank. No coronation data visible in this range; the dossier proper must precede f.140r.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS AC PRIVILEGIIS CUMULATUR CATHEDRALIS ECCLESIA VOLATERRANA, B. MARIAE V. IN CAELUM ASSUMPTAE CONSECRATA.
incipit_latin: Volaterrae, urbs Etruriae, cum rerum gestarum memoria obscuraeque antiquitatis vestigiis insignes sunt tum Templo principe, Deiparae sideribus receptae sacro, nobilitantur
notes: Recorded inside a Basilica Minor act: « simulacrum Beatae Mariae Virginis ... quod Pius PP. IX ... aureo diademate redimivit », and again « ob revolutum saeculum ab Imagine illa Beatae Mariae Virginis per Pium PP. IX aurea corona honestata Volaterris indicta sunt ». Pius IX crowned it personally. Exact year not given; since the centenary celebrations were being announced in an act dated 30 Nov 1957, the crowning was c. 1857 — not stated in the text, so left null.

legate: Marius S. R. E. Cardinalis Nasalli Rocca di Corneliano, Missus Extraordinarius
rubric_latin: Ad E.mum P. D. Marium S. R. E. Cardinalem Nasalli Rocca di Corneliano, quem Missum Extraordinarium eligit ut celebritatibus praesideat in aede sacra B. M. V. ab Arcu appellatae apud urbem Neapolim, primo volvente saeculo ex quo eadem Deiparae imago aureo diademate redimita fuit.
incipit_latin: Quemadmodum accepimus, die VIII mensis Septembris hoc anno, quo saeculum implebitur ex quo Beatae Mariae Virginis imago, quae in aede, eidem Deiparae ab Arcu appellatae apud urbem Neapolim sacra, piis obsequiis colitur, aureo diademate fuit redimita, peculiaria sollemnia ibidem agentur.
notes: Not a coronation act: the Pope sends a Missus Extraordinarius to preside at the centenary of the image's golden crowning. Coronation year derived from 'primo volvente saeculo' with the celebration on 8 September 1974, so the crowning was in 1874 (very likely 8 September 1874) - verify the exact day. Country Italy inferred from 'apud urbem Neapolim' (Naples); no diocese named in the act. Vernacular title rendered from the Latin 'ab Arcu appellatae'. The act also recalls that Pius IX visited the sanctuary and venerated the image. Confirmed by the volume indices at pp. 759, 788, 792.

rubric_latin: Pretioso diademate imago B. M. V. Deiparae redimitur, quae intra fines dioecesis Kaisiadorensis asservatur in paroeciali aede sacra loci « Pivasiünai » pieque excolitur.
incipit_latin: Ut Ecclesiae Kaisiadorensis memoriae proditum est, satis de peculiari venerationis cultu cognoscitur
notes: Retrieved from txt for the AAS 80 index entry 'Pivasiünai ... 1398'. Apostolic Administrator: Vincentas Sladkevičius. Country explicit ('e regionibus Lituaniae').

legate: Alexius Henricus Maria S. R. E. Card. Lépicier, tit. Sanctae Susannae
rubric_latin: EMUS P. D. ALEXIUS HENRICUS M. TIT. SANCTAE SUSANNAE S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALIS LÉPICIER DEPUTATUR AD AUREA CORONA ORNANDUM SIMULACRUM B. MARIAE V. « TA PINU » NUNCUPATAE IN EIUSDEM BASILICA DIOECESIS GAUDISIENSIS.
incipit_latin: Marianum exstat Sanctuarium insigne Gaudisiensis dioecesis intra fines, quod iam Basilicae Minoris titulo privilegiisque Nos ipsi Litteris Apostolicis Nostris
notes: Cardinal Lépicier, already Legate to the Regional Council of Malta, is charged 'ut arbitrio eius eligendo die ... aureum diadema Nostro nomine et auctoritate imponat' — day left to the legate, so no coronation date. The painting is described as by Stephanus Amedeus de Perusia, 1619. The act itself recalls that the sanctuary was made a minor basilica by Litterae Apostolicae of 31 Aug. 1932. No town named (the shrine is at Għarb); country inferred from the diocese of Gozo and the reference to the neighbouring diocese of Malta.

legate: Dominicus Card. Ferrata
rubric_latin: AD V. E. DOMINICUM CARD. FERRATA, ARCHIPRESBYTERUM LATERANENSEM, QUEM RENUNTIAT LEGATUM SUUM AD CONVENTUM EUCHARISTICUM MELITENSEM.
incipit_latin: Inter publicas illustrioresque significationes Fidei, quas hoc anno per saecularia Constantiniana daturum est catholicum nomen
notes: Letter naming Ferrata Legate to the Malta Eucharistic Congress; it recalls in passing that Pius X had earlier sent him to Malta to crown a Marian image: 'ea ipsa loca non ita pridem, missus item a Nobis, adivisti, ut sacerrimo Virginis Deiparae simulacro quod Conspicuae colitur, auream coronam imponeres'. 'Conspicuae' is a locative and is read as Cospicua (Bormla), Malta - identification inferred, hence medium confidence. No date is given for the crowning ('non ita pridem'). The diocese (Melitensis) is inferred from the Maltese setting, not stated for the image.

legate: Michael Gonzi, Archiepiscopus Melitensis (deputed to impose the crown 'Nostro nomine et auctoritate')
rubric_latin: Facultas conceditur diademate cingendi excultam Mostae, in Melitensi insula, imaginem Virginis Mariae in caelum Assumptae.
incipit_latin: Paroeciale templum, quod Mostae, in Melitensi insula, exstat, venerabile quidem ob antiquitatem artisque maiestatem merito habetur
notes: Coronation day left to the archbishop's choice. Confirmed in the volume's chronological index (p. 757) under 12 Dec. 1973.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA NATIVITATIS BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS IN CIVITATE SENGLEA, INSULAE MELITENSIS, IN BASILICAM MINOREM ERIGITUR.
incipit_latin: Ad perennandam memoriam gloriosae victoriae contra exercitum Turcarum, anno MDLXV latae, et in gratiarum actionem ob civitatem ab extremo discrimine servatam
notes: The Basilica minor petition was made « auspicata occasione coronationis sacri simulacri Mariae Infantis, ut aiunt, «Maria Bambina», quod religiosissime ipso in templo colitur », i.e. on the occasion of the (then forthcoming) coronation. The act itself neither grants the coronation nor gives its date, so evidence is a passing attestation only; no date stated in the passage. The volume index (p. 190 entry, seen at AAS-13-1921 pp. 625-626) records 'B. M. V. Infantis (« Maria Bambina ») simulacrum coronatum, 190' and lists it among 'imagines B. M. V. Capituli auctoritate diademate donatae, 8, 190, 492, 305 s.' — suggesting the Vatican Chapter authorised it; a checker should verify.

citation: BAV, ACSP, Madonne coronate, tomo IV, ff. 75r–76v
rubric_latin: concedere La Corona alla Madonna S.ma delle Gratie in Malta esistente nello Chiesa Parochiale della Terra Zabar
notes: Crowns: one requested ('concedere La Corona'). Petitioner: Francesco Pace, Maltese priest ('Fran.co Pace Sacerdote Maltese'), recommended by the Auditor Acquaviva ('raccommandato dall'Aud.re Acquaviva'). Undated supplica; it cites as witnesses to the image's veneration the former Inquisitors and Apostolic Ministers of Malta: Cardinals Marescotti, Acquaviva, Ruffo, Pallavicino, and Mons. Passionei, Spinola, Caracciolo. ff. 75v-76r are blank; f. 76v is the docket ('Per Il Sacerdote Fran.co Pace Maltese p.r l'incoronatione di Una Madonna Miracolosa'). The range ends here, so any decree, instrument or relazione for Żabbar would lie beyond f. 76v and is not visible. | Petition only. Archivist's docket on f.76v: 'Per Il Sacerdote Fran.co Pace Maltese p.r l'incoronatione di Una Madonna Miracolosa — Non si trova concessa' (no concession found). Supplica cites Cardinals Marescotti, Acquaviva, Russo, Pallavicino and Mons. Passionei, Spinola, Caracciolo as former Inquisitors who venerated the image. 'other' = the archivist's docket note.

rubric_latin: Imago « Dominae nostrae ab Assumptione », in dioecesi de Aguas Calientes, sacro diademate coronatur.
incipit_latin: Quanta demum pietate ac fide quantoque honore ac studio universa ecclesialis communitas de Aguas Calientes in Mexico amplectatur
notes: Faculty granted to Bp Salvator Quezada Limón to crown the image in the Pope's name in his cathedral. Country explicit ('de Aguas Calientes in Mexico'). Act recalls that Pius XII raised the cathedral to Basilica Minor and that the same title is the diocese's patroness.

rubric_latin: Imago B. M. V. a Rosario, quae ab Ecclesia Verae Crucis colitur et in paroeciali sacello loci vulgo « Alvarado » asservatur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Memoriae plane proditum est praeclarum B. M. V. a Rosario simulacrum, quod in paroeciali sacra aede loci « Alvarado » vulgo dicti pie asservatur
notes: Faculty granted to Bp Iosephus Guadalupe Padilla Lozano of Veracruz to impose the crown in the Pope's name. Act says the image has been venerated since the 17th century. Country supported by 'ceteris Mexicanis Praesulibus'; vernacular title is the obvious rendering of 'B. M. V. a Rosario', not given verbatim.

rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS HONORIBUS PRIVILEGIISQUE DECORATUR ECCLESIA B. MARIAE V. PERDOLENTIS, VULGO « NUESTRA SEÑORA DE LA SOLEDAD » APPELLATAE, IN URBE ET ARCHIDIOECESI ANTEQUERENSI EXSTANS.
incipit_latin: Religionis domicilium praeclarum esse perhibetur templum Beatae Mariae Virgini « a Solitudine », quae dicitur, sacrum in urbe et archidioecesi Antequerensi
notes: Clause: « Sanctus Pius PP. X, Decessor Noster imm. mem., concessit, ut idem simulacrum suo nomine et auctoritate aurea redimiretur corona; quod sollemne die xviii mensis Ianuarii, anno MDCCCCIX, inter plaudentis populi vota, sacrorum Antistitum e Mexicana dicione astante coetu, peractum est ».

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Nuestra Señora del Carmen » invocatae, quae pie servatur in Sanctuario eidem dicato in Mexicana urbe « Catemaco », pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Christifideles Mexicani dioecesis Sancti Andreae de Tuxtla finitimarumque Ecclesiarum singulari pietate colunt decoram imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis
notes: Bishop Guillermo Ranzahuer González (OCR 'Villelmus Ranzhauer González') of San Andrés Tuxtla is commissioned to crown in the Pope's name; his petition is dated 22 November 1991.

legate: Marcianus Tinajero y Estrada, Episcopus Queretarensis (acting 'Nostro nomine et auctoritate')
rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V. « DEL PUEBLITO » CIVITATIS QUERETARI, IN MEXICO, PATRONA CAELESTIS AEQUE PRINCIPALIS AC SANCTUS IACOBUS MAIOR APOSTOLUS CONFIRMATUR.
incipit_latin: Maximo Nos afficimur gaudio quotiescumque comperimus Beatissimam semperque Virginem Dei Genetricem Mariam, in Qua, post Deum inter tot quibus premimur undique angustiis, plenam ponimus spem ac fidem Nostram
notes: Patron-confirmation act reporting in detail the coronation of 17 October 1946, carried out by the Bishop of Querétaro in the Pope's name and authority under Litterae Apostolicae given sub anulo Piscatoris on 7 October 1943 ('die VII mensis Octobris anno MCMXXXXIII datarum'). Present at the rite: Abp Aloysius Martínez of Mexico, Chargé d'Affaires. The act's own Datum line is cut off in the passage ('Datum ex Arce Gand...') so act_date is null. The act begins on printed page 806 (passage indexed at 807), verified against the page markers in txt/AAS-44-1952-ocr.txt.

legate: Marius Pius Gaspari, Archiepiscopus titulo Numidensis, in Mexico Apostolicus Delegatus (deputed to crown 'nomine et auctoritate Nostra')
rubric_latin: Simulacrum B. M. Virginis a Caritate, in urbe vulgo Huatlanta, pretioso diademate coronari sinitur.
incipit_latin: Quandoquidem beatissima Virgo Maria Christi mater est, Filii Dei adorandi et caelestis populi christiani patrona
notes: Locality printed/OCR'd as 'Huatlanta'; best reading is Huamantla, the town of the diocese of Tlaxcala where 'Nuestra Señora de la Caridad' is venerated - verify. Text gives the vernacular title as 'de la Caridad'. Datum reads 'anno MDCCCCLXXXIV' (= 1984), which is impossible: 'Pontificatus Nostri decimo secundo' and the volume's chronological index (p. 757, under 1974 Iul. 25) fix the date as 25 July 1974; an extra X in the printed/OCR'd numeral. Country secure from 'in Mexico Apostolico Delegato'. No church named. Coronation day left to the Delegate's choice.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, vulgo « de Izamal » appellata, praecipua caelestis Patrona archidioecesis Yucatanensis declaratur.
incipit_latin: Luce collustrans superna saeculum caliginosum, Beata Maria Virgo, Dei Parens augusta, gloria generis humani, utpote primae et alius cuiusvis labis immunis
notes: Clause: « Idcirco Pius Pp. XII, Decessor Noster fel. rec., concessit, ut praeclara eius Imago sua auctoritate, anno MCMXLIX, redimiretur diademate aureo ». Country confirmed within the act (« in tota dicione Mexicana », Apostolic Delegate in Mexico).

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Senora de la Luz (Madre Santisima de la Luz)
rubric_latin: CATHEDRALIS AEDES LEONENSIS DEIPARAE « MATRI LUMINUM » SACRA, IN REPUBLICA MEXICANA, TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Tot inter celeberrima templa, quae in honorem Deiparae Virginis exstructa sunt ubique terrarum, iure adnumeramus praeclaram
notes: Basilica Minor act; states that Leo XIII 'per similes Litteras die 20 martii anni 1901 Piscatoris annulo obsignatas, aurea corona eius imaginem praecingendam curavit' - i.e. the papal grant of coronation is dated 20 March 1901; the date of the crowning rite itself is not given, so coronation_date left null. Rubric OCR 'LBONENSIS'/'AUGETÜR' repaired. Act begins on printed page 437 (passage printed_page is 436).

rubric_latin: LEONENSIS. PAROECIALE TEMPLUM DOMINAE NOSTRAE DE GUANAJUATO, IN CIVITATE LEONENSI, AD GRADUM ET DIGNITATEM COLLEGIALIS AEDIS EVEHITUR.
incipit_latin: Cum venerabilis Frater Emmanuel Martin del Campo et Padilla, dioecesis Leonensis Episcopus, ab hac Apostolica Sede enixe poposcerit ut paroeciale templum Dominae Nostrae de Guanajuato
notes: The act assigns a choral feast « die uno et tricesimo mensis Maii, incidente die anniversario Coronationis Sacrae Imaginis Dominae Nostrae de Guanajuato », thus attesting the image was crowned on a 31 May; the year and the crowning authority are not stated. Country from « Apostolicum in Mexicana Ditione Delegatum » in the same act. Coronation clause on printed page 929; the constitution begins on printed page 928, cited here as aas_page.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo Lauretana totius dioecesis Tigiuanaënsis Patrona principalis renuntiatur.
incipit_latin: Lauretanae Virgini prope singulariter consecrata, ob impensum in eam studium fidelium, videtur esse terra Tigiuanaënsis, in qua Nosmetipsi ... Vicariatum Apostolicum ad gradum dignitatemque dioecesis proveximus
notes: Patronage act; coronation attested in passing: 'a Decessore Nostro imm. rec. Pio Pp. XII facultatem eiusdem imaginis coronandae libenter esse datam ... novimus etiam miro spectaculo fidei sollemnia id temporis in honorem Reginae Lauretanae esse peracta' - no date given for either grant or crowning. The image is kept in a village called Loreto within the then diocese of Tijuana. Country inferred from Tijuana / 'utraque California' - not stated in the act.

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis « de Guadalupe » imago, quae paroeciali in templo urbis « Puerto de Manzanillo » asservatur, nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis coronatur.
incipit_latin: Progredientibus quidem temporibus omnium ordinum fideles ad Virginem Mariam fidenti animo decurrerunt, pro comperto habentes superna se beneficia indulgenter accepturos.
notes: The act speaks of the devotion « apud Mexicanas gentes »; petition of Bishop Gilberto Valbuena Sánchez of Colima. The volume's alphabetical index cites p. 943, the chronological index and the act itself p. 942.

rubric_latin: Templum paroeciale Sancti Ioseph et Dominae Nostrae a Sacro Corde Iesu, quod in urbe Mexicopoli exstat, ad Basilicae Minoris gradum dignitatemque evehitur.
incipit_latin: Mexicopoli, in celebri atque amplissima urbe, exstat templum paroeciale Sancti Ioseph et Dominae Nostrae a Sacro Corde Iesu miris artis operibus clarum
notes: Coronation attested in passing in a Basilica Minor elevation: the image 'die xxvi mensis Septembris anno MCMXLVIII nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis Pii Pp. XII ... aureo diademate coronata est'. The crowning was therefore under Pius XII; the act here is by John Paul II. No vernacular title is given in the text.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. RODRIGUUM S. R. E. CARD. VILLENEUVE, ARCHIEPISCOPUM QUEBECENSEM, QUEM LEGATUM MITTIT AD CONVENTUM MARIALEM AD SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE VIRGINIS GUADALUPENSIS MEXICOPOLI CELEBRANDUM.
incipit_latin: Mater spei et gratiae Deipara Virgo cum ubique terrarum sacraria, ubi perpeti benignitate filiis alumnisque suis cuiuslibet generis solamina largitur
notes: Letter deputing Card. Villeneuve as Legate to the Marian Congress (NOT to a coronation); it attests the earlier coronation in passing: 'cum quinquagesimus feliciter plenus annus decurrat, ex quo B. Virginis Mariae effigies aureo serto redimita est'. Coronation year 1895 is computed from the fiftieth year running in 1945, not stated verbatim; day/month not given. Legate field left null because the deputation is for the congress, not the crowning. Passage printed_page 255; letter opens on p. 254.

rubric_latin: CHRISTIFIDELIBUS DATUS DIE XII MENSIS OCTOBRIS A. MCMXLV, OB MARIALEM CONVENTUM AD SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE V. GUADALUPENSI MEXICOPOLI COADUNATIS
incipit_latin: Venerables Hermanos y amados hijos que, reunidos en torno a la persona de Nuestro dignisimo Cardenal Legado, conmemorais los cincuenta anos de la coronacion canonica de la Virgen de Guadalupe
notes: Radio message for the Marian congress marking the fiftieth anniversary of the canonical coronation of the Virgin of Guadalupe: 'conmemorais los cincuenta anos de la coronacion canonica de la Virgen de Guadalupe' and 'Hace hoy cincuenta anos ... cuando sobre aquella frente angelical resplandecio la aurea corona'. Coronation date derived from 'today fifty years ago' relative to the act date 12 October 1945. Body is in Spanish, so incipit_latin holds the Spanish opening verbatim (accents lost in OCR). The Cardinal Legate is not named in the text. The act begins on this page (264); the same act continues to p. 267, where a further papal act is recorded separately.

rubric_latin: CHRISTIFIDELIBUS DATUS DIE XII MENSIS OCTOBRIS A. MCMXLV, OB MARIALEM CONVENTUM AD SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE V. GUADALUPENSI MEXICOPOLI COADUNATIS
notes: Same act as AAS-37-1945-ocr#g264 (act begins on p. 264; this passage carries pp. 266-268). Pius XII, speaking in the first person to the congress gathered round his Cardinal Legate, says: 'Nos, a quien la admirable disposicion de la Divina Providencia confio ... el sagrado tesoro de la divina sabiduria en la tierra ... Nos colocamos hoy de nuevo sobre tus sienes la corona, que pone para siempre bajo tu poderoso patrocinio la pureza y la integridad de la santa fe en Mejico y en todo el continente americano'. This is a re-crowning (a new crown placed 'de nuevo') declared by the Pope by radio while an unnamed Cardinal Legate presided in person, not a first canonical coronation and not a coronation performed by the Pope's own hand; classified papal_personal_coronation because the Pope himself states he places the crown. The source never uses a word for 'image', naming only the devotional title.

rubric_latin: Rosa Aurea Basilicae Beatae Mariae Virginis a Guadalupe, intra fines archidioecesis Mexicanae positae, tribuitur asservanda.
incipit_latin: Flores edens et spargens, sive olim, uti ferunt, cum prodigialem praesentiam suam testatam voluit, sive continenter, cum caelestia munera ... supplicibus dilargitur
notes: Golden Rose act; coronation attested in passing: 'Leonem Pp. XIII concessisse, ut venusta imago, qua Deipara, appellatione illa insignis, exprimitur, suo nomine et auctoritate aureo diademate redimiretur'. Year of the coronation not given here (see AAS 62 (1970) 681, 75th anniversary in 1970). Address form: 'Venerabili Fratri Michaeli Dario Miranda et Gómez, Archiepiscopo Mexicano'; the Golden Rose was to be delivered by Card. Carlo Confalonieri (bearer, not a coronation legate).

rubric_latin: Universis Mexicanae Nationis christifidelibus, septuagesimo quinto exacto anno ex quo imago B. Mariae Virginis a Guadalupe aureo diademate redimita est.
notes: Radio-television message of Paul VI for the 75th anniversary of the crowning of Our Lady of Guadalupe; the message body is in Spanish ('En el setenta y cinco aniversario de la Coronación de Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe...'), hence incipit_latin is null. Coronation year 1895 computed from the rubric ('septuagesimo quinto exacto anno') and the message date 12 October 1970 - not stated as such in the text; verify. The same event is listed in the volume indexes at pp. 876-877 and 911.

rubric_latin: Mane diei 27 m. ianuarii, Polonorum civium coloniam in Mexico degentium coram admisit, antequam e Delegationis Apostolicae aedibus templum B. M. V. a Guadalupe peteret. ... Inde profectus, ad sacram aedem pervenit, sacris litaturus atque Plenario Coetui Episcoporum Latinorum Americanorum, intercedente Beatissima Dei Genetrice, initium daturus. Quae inter sacra, hanc homiliam habuit
notes: Found by extending the search over the surrounding pages of the same journey, as instructed; this page is NOT one of the 26 passages of batch G07 (the id follows the batch id convention for AAS-71-1979-ocr, page 177). Homily/prayer of John Paul II at the shrine of Guadalupe, 27 January 1979, at the Mass opening the III General Conference of the Latin American Episcopate. Spanish sentence, verbatim: 'Finalmente, oh Madre, recordando y confirmando el gesto de mis Predecesores Benedicto XIV y Pío X, quienes Te proclamaron Patrona de México y de toda la América Latina, Te presento una diadema en nombre de todos tus hijos mexicanos y latinoamericanos, para que los conserves bajo tu protección, guardes su concordia en la fe y su fidelidad a Cristo, Tu Hijo.' Same pattern as the Altagracia passage: the Pope presents a diadem to a devotion named by title; no formal coronation rite is described, and the words are addressed to the Virgin, not to an image (the image is mentioned separately on p. 175: 'Tu imagen en el Santuario de Guadalupe'). The homily begins on printed page 171; the diadem sentence is on p. 177. Locality 'Mexico City' is inferred — AAS names only the 'Santuario de Guadalupe' / 'templum B. M. V. a Guadalupe' in Mexico (Tepeyac is named on p. 173) — hence medium confidence. Body is in Spanish, so no Latin incipit; rubric_latin is the Latin editorial narrative of p. 171 (ellipsis marks omitted text).

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum II die decimo mensis Maii anno MCMXC in urbe Monterreyensi imaginem coronavisse Immaculatae Conceptionis Mariae, « Virgen Chiquita » appellatam.
incipit_latin: Imo ex pectore laetamur cum occasio Nobis datur ad Nostram pietatem in Beatissimam Virginem Mariam significandam
notes: The candidate passage is the volume's chronological index (printed page 1658), which points to the act at page 1512; per spec rule 5 the act's START page 1512 is used as aas_page. Full act text verified in txt/AAS-82-1990-ocr.txt at [[PDFPAGE 1512]]-1513: « ... aureo diademate, benedictione sacrato, sollemni redimiimus ritu ». No section roman numeral precedes the heading LITTERAE APOSTOLICAE, so act_number is null. Church name not stated in the act.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Immaculatae, quae sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de Monterrey » in ecclesia cathedrali Monterreyensi pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Primi Americae continentis evangelizatores Beatae Virginis Mariae cultum ubique propagaverunt, pro certo habentes sane caelestem Reginam sibi auxilium praebituram.
notes: Requested by Adolfo Antonio Card. Suárez Rivera, Archbishop of Monterrey (letters of 14 March 1996); the image is said to have been venerated there for 400 years. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

legate: Philippus a Iesu Cueto, Episcopus Tlalnepantlanus (deputed to impose the crown 'Nostro nomine et auctoritate')
rubric_latin: Simulacrum B. M. Virginis vulgo « de los Remedios » in templo Naucalpanensi, in Mexico, excultum, pretioso diademate cingi sinitur.
incipit_latin: Quo sanctius atque Christi fidelibus utilius imago illa Beatae Mariae Virginis coleretur, quae in sacra aede Naucalpanensis civitatis servatur
notes: 'in Mexico' explicit in the rubric. The act notes the tenth anniversary of the erection of the diocese of Tlalnepantla as the occasion; coronation day left to the bishop's choice.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO SUB TITULO DE «OCOTLAN» TOTIUS ARCHIDIOECESIS ANGELORUM, MEXICANA IN DITIONE, PATRONA COELESTIS CONFIRMATUR.
incipit_latin: Mexicana in ditione archidioecesis Angelorum intra fines exstat Sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis de «Ocotlan» nuncupatae, quam christifideles regionis impense devoteque colunt.
notes: Patron confirmation. Attestation: 'iam rec. mem. Decessorem Nostrum Pium Pp. X aureo diademate decrevisse Sacram Imaginem Beatae Mariae Immaculatae in sanctuario de Ocotlan servatae coronari' - so the coronation was decreed by Pius X (1903-1914); no date given. The act was issued on the occasion of the 4th centenary of the finding of the image, to be commemorated in 1941.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA COLLEGIALIS « NOSTRAE DOMINAE DE OCOTLAN » APUD TLAXCALLENSEM CIVITATEM, INTRA ANGELORUM ARCHIDIOECESIS FINES IN MEXICO, TITULO BASILICAE MINORIS ORNATUR.
incipit_latin: Quo Christifidelium pietatem impensius exacueret et amplificaret, Romanus Pontifex excultoribus Templis magisque religiosis ac frequentioribus decus addere solebat
notes: Only an indirect mention: « Quinquagesimi vero anni a Canonicorum Collegio constituto nec non a peracta ipsius Marialis Imaginis coronatione faustam nactus occasionem ». The act is dated 22 Nov 1957, so the crowning fell c. 1907, but no year, authority or minister is stated in the text. aas_page = 558, where the act begins (the batch passage is paginated 559); confirmed by the volume index.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo praecipua Patrona dioecesis Papantlensis eligitur.
incipit_latin: Peculiari studio pietatis excoli perhibetur a Christifidelibus dioecesis Papantlensis Beata Maria Virgo de Monte Carmelo, cuius praeclara imago, in ipsa episcopali sede proposita
notes: Patron declaration stating 'Quod simulacrum ... anno MDCCCCXXXXVIII, auctoritate Pii PP. XII, Decessoris Nostri imm. mem., aureo diademate fuit redimitum' (MDCCCCXXXXVIII = 1948). Country Mexico inferred from the see name Papantlensis; not stated in the passage. Vernacular title supplied as the usual rendering of 'de Monte Carmelo'.

rubric_latin: TITULUS BASILICAE MINORIS CONFERTUR ECCLESIAE CONLEGIATAE B. M. V. A SALUTE, IN CIVITATE PAZCUARO, ARCHIDIOECESIS MECHOACANENSIS.
incipit_latin: Ecclesia conlegiata Deo dicata in honorem Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Salutis, in civitate Pazcuaro, archidioecesis Mechoacanensis intra fines sita
notes: 'atque anno MDCCCLXXXXIX, auctoritate Leonis PP. XIII rec. me. Praedecessoris Nostri, aureo diademate, sollemni ritu, coronata fuit'. Sixteenth-century sculpture made under Bishop Vasco de Quiroga; the act itself gives the vernacular form 'de la Salud'.

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora de San Juan de los Lagos
rubric_latin: ECCLESIA COLLEGIALIS B. MARIAE V., VULGO DICTA « DE SAN JUAN DE LOS LAGOS », INTRA FINES ARCHIDIOECESIS GUADALAJARENSIS, HONORIBUS BASILICAE MINORIS INSIGNITUR.
incipit_latin: De historia Ecclesiae Collegialis B. Mariae Virginis vulgo dictae « de San Juan de los Lagos », de nobili eius structurae genere, pulchritudine, maiestate
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'Diademate pretiosissimo ipsa Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis « de San Juan » benigna concessione rec. mem. Decessoris Nostri Pii Pp. X, per Decretum Capituli Vaticani, redimita fuit'. No year is given for the coronation. Country ('Mexicanae ditionis Praesulum') from the act itself.

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora de San Juan de los Lagos
rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO IMMACULATA, SUB TITULO « DE SAN JUAN DE LOS LAGOS » PRAECIPUA CAELESTIS PATRONA TOTIUS ARCHIDIOECESIS GUADALAIARENSIS, IN MEXICANA NATIONE, CONSTITUITUR.
incipit_latin: Ad peculiari studio conspiciendam Christifidelium maximam devotionem summumque amorem in Genitricem Dei Nos impellit flagrans religio
notes: Patron-declaration act states in passing: « quos inter Sanctus Pius X pontificiam Iconi coronae impositionem benigne concessit. Simulacri caput tribus fuit redimitum coronis, quarum prima pluribus fulget adamantibus ». Year of the crowning not stated. aas_page = 302, where the act (rubric + incipit) begins; the batch passage is paginated 303. Text as printed says the collegiate title was obtained « anno MCCCCXXIII » from Pius XI — an obvious OCR/print error for 1923.

rubric_latin: B. MARIAE V. IN URBE SANCTAE FIDEI DE GUANAJUATO, INTRA DIOECESIS LEONENSIS FINES, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AC DIGNITATE AFFICITUR.
incipit_latin: Eximiis laudibus praedicatur Templum paroeciale, Almae Deiparae sacrum, quo urbi Mexicanae, quae Sancta Fides de Guanajuato appellatur, non modicum accrescit decoris atque ornamenti.
notes: Basilica Minor elevation; attests 'Sanctus Pius PP. X, Decessor Noster, imm. me., concessit ut Simulacrum aurea corona redimiretur' - a coronation granted by St Pius X (1903-1914), with no year given, in the same act by which he named the Virgin, together with St Ignatius Loyola, principal Patron of the city. Country explicit ('urbi Mexicanae'). Act begins on printed page 1002.

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Talpa
rubric_latin: AD TITULUM AC DIGNITATEM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR TEMPLUM B. MARIAE V. A SACRATISSIMO ROSARIO IN URBE « TALPA », DIOECESIS TEPICENSIS, EXSTANS
incipit_latin: Mirum in modum conspicitur, in loco eminens perexcelso atque edito, in parva urbe « Talpa » vulgo nuncupata, Tepicensis intra fines dioecesis, pulcherrimum Deo in honorem Beatissimae Virginis Mariae a Sacratissimo Rosario dicatum Sanctuarium
notes: Basilica Minor elevation that attests the crowning in passing: 'Re vera ipsa Deiparae Virginis Imago, pretiosissima in Templo gemma, aureo fulgens diademate, quo sollemniter anno MCMXXIII per Capituli Vaticani decretum redimita est'. The act begins on printed p. 362 (this passage's printed_page is 364, the middle of a three-page window); the diadem sentence stands on p. 363. Rubric OCR read 'TEMPLUMR. MARIAE V.'; repaired to 'TEMPLUM B. MARIAE V.'. The vernacular title (Nuestra Senora del Rosario de Talpa) is not given in the text, so the field is left null. Country inferred from the diocese of Tepic and the intervention of Aloisius Maria Martinez, Archiepiscopus Mexicanus, both named in the act.

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora del Rosario de Talpa
rubric_latin: AD TITULUM AC DIGNITATEM BASILICAE MINORIS EVEHITUR TEMPLUM B. MARIAE V. A SACRATISSIMO ROSARIO IN URBE « TALPA », DIOECESIS TEPICENSIS, EXSTANS.
incipit_latin: Mirum in modum conspicitur, in loco eminens perexcelso atque edito, in parva urbe « Talpa » vulgo nuncupata, Tepicensis intra fines dioecesis
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'ipsa Deiparae Virginis Imago ... aureo fulgens diademate, quo sollemniter anno MCMXXIII per Capituli Vaticani decretum redimita est'. Country inferred from the diocese of Tepic and the commendation of the Archbishop of Mexico ('Archiepiscopi Mexicani'). Vernacular title is the Spanish form of the Latin title; the act gives only 'Talpa' and the Latin title.

rubric_latin: B.M.V. imago quae in oppido colitur Tecomán Colimensis dioecesis quamque vocant atque indigenae usurpant « Virgen de la Candelaria » Summi Pontificis nomine pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Principis Apostolorum obtinentes locum, erga Virginem Mariam cultum et filialem dilectionem in universo christiano populo excitare confirmareque nunquam destitimus
notes: Act begins on printed p. 825 (passage printed_page is 824). Country Mexico inferred from the see of Colima and the town of Tecomán; not named in the act. Bishop José Fernández Arteaga of Colima, or his delegate, is commissioned to crown in the Pope's name.

rubric_latin: Sanctuarium Tlalnepantlanae archidioecesis, quod est dicatum beatae Mariae Virgini titulo « Nuestra Señora de los Remedios » invocatae, ad Basilicae minoris gradum dignitatemque evehitur.
incipit_latin: Sacras inter aedes Tlalnepantlanae archidioecesis merito celebratur sanctuarium beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Nuestra Señora del los Remedios », cuius antiqua ac prodigialis imago ibidem servata atque anno MCMLXXIV « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis » coronata.
notes: Coronation mentioned in passing in a Basilica Minor elevation: the ancient image kept there was crowned in 1974 'nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis' as Queen of the diocesan clergy. The AAS act (or its OCR) prints « Nuestra Señora del los Remedios » in the body and « de los Remedios » in the rubric. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

image_title_vernacular: Sterre der Zee (Star of the Sea)
rubric_latin: TITULO ET HONORIBUS BASILICAE MINORIS AUGETUR TEMPLUM B. M. V. SIDERIBUS RECEPTAE, QUOD EXSTAT TRAIECTI IN DIOECESI RUREMONDENSI.
incipit_latin: Ruremondensis dioecesis intra fines, Traiecti in civitate, templum exstat paroeciale Beatae Mariae Virginis in caelum Assumptae in honorem Deo dicatum
notes: Basilica Minor act; 'statua servatur Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Stellae Maris », quae iam ab anno MDCCCCXII, auctoritate Apostolica, aurea corona sollemniter redimita est'. 'Traiectum' here = Maastricht (diocese of Roermond); locality and country inferred, not spelled out. OCR renders the diocese as 'Euremondensis'/'Buremondensium'. Act begins on printed p. 242; coronation clause on p. 243.

image_title_vernacular: La Virgen del Viejo (Nuestra Señora de El Viejo)
rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis vulgo « La Virgen del Viejo » appellatae simulacrum, quod intra fines dioecesis Leonensis in Nicaragua excolitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Quod est Ecclesiae Leonensis in Nicaragua memoriae proditum certisque comprobatur Curiae documentis, de peculiari venerationis cultu dubitari nequit
notes: Source passage is the AAS 81 analytical index (p. 1429, s.v. 'Imagines B.M.V.'); act retrieved from txt and cited at its own page 824. Bishop: Julián Luis Barni.

image_title_vernacular: La Virgen del Viejo (Nuestra Señora de El Viejo)
rubric_latin: Sanctuarium nationale Nicaraguanum, quod beatae Mariae Virgini immaculate Conceptae dicatum, in urbe « El Viejo » intra fines dioecesis Leonensis in Nicaragua exstat, ad Basilicae Minoris gradum dignitatemque evehitur.
incipit_latin: Inter insignes sacras aedes dilectae Nicaraguanae Nationis merito recensetur templum beatae Mariae Virgini immaculate Conceptae dicatum, quod in urbe « El Viejo »...
notes: Basilica Minor elevation which states in passing that the image, brought in 1565, was solemnly crowned in 1747 ('volvente anno MDCCXLVII inter iubilantes cives sollemni ritu coronata est'). The act does NOT say by whose authority the 1747 crowning was done. Vernacular title supplied from the Latin.

legate: Managuensis Ordinarius (Michael Obando Bravo, Archiepiscopus Managuensis, was the petitioner and is charged to impose the crown 'Nostro nomine et auctoritate')
rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis vulgo « Nuestra Señora de la Asunción » appellatae, in paroecia S. Mariae Magdalenae urbis « Monimbò » archidioecesis Managuensis exstans, pretioso sinitur diademate redimiri.
incipit_latin: In paroecia S. Mariae Magdalenae urbis « Monimbò » intra fines Ecclesiae Managuensis praeclara exstat Beatae Mariae Virginis imago
notes: Country not stated in the act; inferred from the archdiocese of Managua (Nicaragua). Monimbó is an indigenous quarter of Masaya, not named as such in the act. Coronation day left to the Ordinary's choice. Confirmed in the volume indices at pp. 1287 and 1312.

rubric_latin: NUNTIUS RADIOPHONICUS A BEATISSIMO PATRE, DIE XXXI MENSIS OCTOBRIS ANNO MCMXXXXIII, IN FESTO D. N. IESU CHRISTI REGIS, CHRISTIFIDELIBUS DATUS, OB III CONVENTUM EUCHARISTICUM E TOTA PERUVIANA NATIONE IN URBE TRUXILLENSI COADUNATIS
notes: Radio message of Pius XII closing the 3rd Peruvian National Eucharistic Congress at Trujillo. Spanish original, p. 356: 'para que Tu, Virgen de la Puerta, solemnemente coronada el pasado miercoles'; Italian version, p. 359 (this passage): 'Tu, Vergine della Puerta, incoronata solennemente lo scorso mercoledi'. The source names only the devotional title, never an image, and does not state under whose authority the crowning took place; it is the Pope himself who acknowledges it, and the Congress was presided by his Legate. The act begins on p. 353 (Spanish) with the Italian version beginning p. 357; the rubric above is transcribed from p. 353, not from this passage. 'Last Wednesday' relative to the stated act date (31 October 1943, a Sunday) would be 27 October 1943, but the passage does not give a date, so only the year is recorded. Also greeted in the same sentence is 'Nuestra Senora del Socorro' of Huanchaco, of whom no crowning is said.

image_title_vernacular: La Virgen de la Candelaria de Chapi
rubric_latin: Simulacrum B. M. V. sub titulo « la Virgen de la Candelaria » excultae, quod intra fines archidioecesis Arequipensis in sacra aede oppidi « Chapi » asservatur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Ex historia ipsius Ecclesiae Arequipensis satis de venerationis cultu cognoscitur, quo complures quidem Peruviani fideles inde a saec. xviii simulacrum
notes: Assigned passage is the Index rerum analyticus (printed p. 1219): 'B. M. V. sub titulo «La virgen de la Candelaria» in sacra aede oppidi «Chapi» intra fines archidioecesis Arequipensis pretioso diademate redimitur, nomine et auctoritate S. P., 465'. Record built on the act itself at printed p. 465, used as aas_page. John Paul II crowned it in person during his pastoral visit: 'libentissime die II huius ipsius mensis Februarii pretioso diademate redimire vi et auctoritate Nostra Apostolica voluimus'. Act is numbered III in the OCR although the following act is numbered VI — numbering may be defective.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS DE MERCEDE, IN CIVITATE LIMANA, TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Limana in civitate quoddam, Beatae Mariae Virgini sub titulo de Mercede dicatum, templum exstat, quod, uti traditur, anno MDXXXIV
notes: Clause: « prodigiosa Beatae Mariae Virginis de Mercede colitur imago, quae die XXIV mensis septembris anno MDCCXXI pretioso diademate, sollemni ritu, redimita est ». Same act notes she is Patrona ac Regina of the Peruvian nation. The act does not state under whose authority the 1721 crowning took place.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo titulo « Nuestra Señora de la Evangelización » invocata, Patrona apud Deum archidioecesis Limanae confirmatur.
incipit_latin: Antiquissimus sane et impensus ac praeclarissimus est quidem cultus quo Peruviani Christifideles, praesertim incolae Limani, prosequuntur Deiparam Virginem Mariam
notes: Patron-declaration act stating in passing that the Pope himself crowned the image: 'cuius veneratam imaginem - quinto decimo saeculo ab Imperatore Carolo V dono datam - Nos ipsi per primum Apostolicum Iter in eam Civitatem sollemni ritu coronavimus'. No coronation date given (the first papal visit to Peru was in Feb 1985), hence coronation_date null.

rubric_latin: De coronatione Imaginis B. M. V. « dei Carmen » quae in paroeciali templo oppiduli Paucartambo, in archidioecesi Cuschensi, colitur, a Summo Pontifice facta, intexitur historia.
incipit_latin: Per litteras, die altero Septembris, superiore anno datas, Venerabilis Frater Alcides Mendoza Castro, Archiepiscopus Cuschensis, de bono gregis
notes: Assigned passage is the Index rerum analyticus (printed p. 1219): 'B. M. V. «dei Carmen» in oppidulo Paucartambo in archidioecesi Cuschensi, a S. P. coronatur, 707'. Record built on the act at printed p. 707, used as aas_page. The crowning itself was performed by John Paul II at Cuzco, not at Paucartambo: 'die III Februarii, hoc anno, petita gessimus, quando Cuzci ... pretiosa corona redimiimus'. Requested by Archbishop Alcides Mendoza Castro.

rubric_latin: CHRISTIFIDELIBUS INSULARUM PHILIPPINARUM OB CONVENTUM MARIALEM IN MANILENSI URBE COADUNATIS.
incipit_latin: Venerables Hermanos y amados hijos que, en la ciudad de Manila, clausuráis el II Congreso Mariano Nacional de las Islas Filipinas
notes: Papal radio message to the Philippine national Marian congress: « esa preciosa corona, que ceñiréis a sus sienes en el mismo día centenario de la Definición dogmática » — i.e. 8 Dec 1954, the centenary of Ineffabilis Deus. OCR reads « Nuestra Señora de Oaysasay »; best reading is Caysasay. The message does not state that the coronation was granted by papal authority, so evidence_type is a passing attestation only. Coronation clause on printed page 721; the radio message begins on printed page 718, cited here as aas_page. Date is from the footnote « Datus die 5 Decembris mensis a. 1954 ».

legate: Hildebrandus Antoniutti, S.R.E. Cardinalis, Praefectus Sacri Consilii Religiosis Ordinibus Sodalitatibusque praepositi
rubric_latin: Ad Em.mum P. D. Hildebrandum tit. S. Sebastiani ad Catacumbas S. R. E. Presb. Cardinalem Antoniutti, Sacri Consilii Religiosis Ordinibus Sodalitatibusque praepositi Praefectum, quem Legatum mittit, ut Caebuae celebritatibus praesideat, quarto saeculo volvente ex quo Evangelium in Insulis Philippinis primum est annuntiatum.
incipit_latin: Aurora, praenuntia felicis successus, ante quattuor saecula Ecclesiae in Insulis Philippinis illuxit, cum Evangelium ibi primum est annuntiatum.
notes: The letter lists among the fourth-centenary celebrations at Cebu 'Eucharisticus e tota Natione Conventus et coronatio statuae Iesu Infantis, in anteriore quadam expeditione eum in locum allatae', and deputes Card. Antoniutti as Legate 'ut Nostram veluti gerens personam, piis coetibus aliisque caerimoniis praesideas'. The text does NOT explicitly commission him to perform the coronation — he is sent to preside over the celebrations of which it forms part; a checker should verify. Coronation year 1965 taken from the celebration year (letter dated 25 March 1965); no date is given in the text. Sanctuary not named (the Augustinian church at Cebu is implied by 'sacram aedem, quasi matricem ceterarum'). Archbishop of Cebu named: Iulius Rosales. Vernacular title (Santo Niño) not in the text.

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis Immaculatae imago, quae in ecclesia paroeciali in oppido Malabon colitur, in Insularum Philippinarum finibus, diademate redimiri sinitur.
incipit_latin: Cum Nos sollicito studio Ipsi Beatissimam Virginem Mariam prosequimur, tum etiam, quotiescumque de gloria atque eiusdem laude agitur apud Christifideles augenda, operam esse dandam arbitramur
notes: Act begins on printed page 17 (passage printed_page is 15). The Pope commits to Jaime L. Card. Sin, Archbishop of Manila, the task of imposing the crown in his name, in person or through another; no coronation date given. Petition dated 25 June 1986, supported by Ricardo Card. Vidal of Cebu. Country explicit ('in Insularum Philippinarum finibus').

rubric_latin: « Our lady of Mt. Carmel » imago quae in paroeciali basilica Manilensi Sancti Sebastiani servatur, sacro diademate coronatur.
incipit_latin: Philippinis in Insulis magno sane cum gaudio Beatam Virginem valde coli percipimus, quae autem res ad fidem confirmandam multum iuvat
notes: Card. Jaime Sin, Abp of Manila, or his delegate, is commissioned to crown the image in the Pope's name. The act notes the statue was brought to the Philippines from abroad.

rubric_latin: B. M. V. imago quam incolae « Our Lady of the abandoned » quamque in ecclesia Manilensi Sanctae Annae veneramur Summi Pontificis nomine coronatur.
incipit_latin: Abhinc complures annos catholica fides in Philippinas insulas feliciter est invecta, quae tempore progrediente succrevit et ubere effloruit
notes: Located via the chronological index of AAS 83 (1991) at printed p. 1102; full text of the act read in the volume at p. 383. Card. Jaime Sin, Abp of Manila, or his delegate, is given the faculty of crowning the image.

rubric_latin: Imago B. Mariae Virginis in templo loci vulgo dicti « Paco » archidioecesis Manilensis servata, pretioso diademate coronatur.
incipit_latin: Qua veneratione Beatissima Virgo Maria a Philippino populo observetur luculenter patefaciunt sacrae imagines hic atque illic collocatae, sive in templis sive in viis
notes: The Pope commits to Jaime L. Card. Sin, Archbishop of Manila, the task of imposing the crown in his name ('partes committimus ... pretiosam coronam Nostro nomine imponendi'); no coronation date given. OCR of the vernacular title is damaged ('Our Lady of Penafrañcia', 'Penaf rancia'). Country explicit ('a Philippino populo', 'in Insulis Philippinis').

image_title_vernacular: Our Lady of the Most Holy Rosary
rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Sanctissimi Rosarii », pie servata in ecclesia loco vulgo dicto Ubanon in dioecesi Calbayogana, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis »
incipit_latin: Sacra illa aedes quae loco vulgo dicto Ubanon in dioecesi Calbayogana exstat, gratiosam imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Sanctissimi Rosarii » servat
notes: Country Philippines inferred from the diocese of Calbayog (Samar); not stated in the act. Place name « Ubanon » as printed (possibly Obando/Ubanon — verify). Bishop Maximino T. Cruz deputed to impose the crown.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Mater Misericordiae » invocatae, quae pie servatur in sacello cathedralis templi Bialostocensis, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Christifideles Bialostocenses singulari pietate colunt gratiosam imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Mater Misericordiae » invocatae
notes: Country Poland inferred from Białystok; not named in the act. The image is a copy of Our Lady of Vilnius (Ostra Brama); the Pope recalls consecrating the Białystok cathedral himself on 27 November 1977 as Archbishop of Kraków. The Archbishop of Białystok is commissioned to crown it on a day of his choosing, in the Pope's name; his petition is dated 12 December 1992. The act does not name him. Polish vernacular title supplied.
