legate: Petrus Golebiowski, Episcopus titulo Panitanus, Administrator Apostolicus dioecesis Sandomiriensis (deputed to impose the crown 'Nostro nomine et auctoritate')
rubric_latin: Imago B. M. Virginis, in Sandomiriensi dioecesi exculta, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur.
incipit_latin: Perantiquum paroeciale templum, quod Blotnicae in Sandomiriensis dioecesis finibus, in Polonia, exstat, artis quidem maiestate merito prae aliis haud paucis excellit
notes: 'in Polonia' explicit in the text. Coronation day left to the deputed bishop's choice ('die suo arbitrio eligendo'), so no coronation date. Datum reads 'anno MCMIJXXIII' in the OCR = MCMLXXIII (1973); the volume's chronological index (p. 757) confirms 4 Dec. 1973. Latin locality 'Blotnicae' = Blotnica (modern Polish Blotnica / Stara Blotnica).

image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej z Brdowa (Our Lady of Brdów)
rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis quae in paroeciali templo loci « Brdów » dioecesis Vladislaviensis exstat, pretioso sinitur diademate redimiri « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Probe novimus in templo paroeciali loci « Brdów » intra fines Ecclesiae Vladislaviensis Beatae Mariae Virginis imaginem ab antiquis temporibus devotissime excoli
notes: Retrieved from txt for the index entry 'Probe novimus ... 678' in the AAS 74 index passage. Country inferred (Polish diocese and place; act does not name Poland). Bishop: Ioannes Zaręba. The same image was crowned by John Paul II himself at Częstochowa on 19 June 1983 (see AAS 75, p. 935).

image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej z Brdowa (Our Lady of Brdów)
rubric_latin: Cestochoviae, occasione oblata coronationis quattuor Imaginum Beatae Mariae Virginis.
notes: One of four images crowned personally by John Paul II at Jasna Góra, Częstochowa, on 19 June 1983 ('obrazie z Brdowa w Diecezji Włocławskiej'). Bishop Jan Zaręba of Włocławek is greeted. Latin diocesan name not given in the (Polish) text. Image detail on printed page 938; act begins on p. 935.

rubric_latin: Conceditur Episcopo Tarnoviensi facultas coronandi imaginem B. M. V. Nivalis et Divini Infantis, quae in Abbatia de Ciricio exstat.
incipit_latin: Polonus populus per saeculorum decursum Beatissimam Virginem Dei genetricem summo excoluit honore summaque veneratione
notes: Faculty granted to Bp Georgius Ablewicz of Tarnów to impose the crown in the Pope's name; the act recalls that John Paul II blessed the image during his visit to Poland. DATE DISCREPANCY: body reads 'die xvi mensis Aprilis', volume index (p. 1111) lists the act (incipit 'Polonus populus') under 26 April 1984 — verify. Odd phrase in the operative clause: 'quae in Ciricio et Lezajsk colitur' (so in the text; Leżajsk is not in Tarnów diocese) — verify against the printed page. 'Abbatia de Ciricio' = the Cistercian abbey of Szczyrzyc (identification not in the text). Country explicit ('Polonus populus', 'Polona terra').

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae pie servatur in sanctuario loci v.d. « Czarna » in dioecesi Radomensi, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Vitae christianae incrementum varia ratione foventes, magnopere curamus ut pietatem erga Beatam Mariam Virginem, quae praecellit inter humiles et pauperes Domini, incitemus.
notes: Bp Edward Materski of Radom is deputed to impose the crown in the Pope's name. Vernacular title is a rendering of the Latin « Educatricis » — verify. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis Scapularis seu de Monte Carmelo imago quae in oppido « Czerna » colitur, in archidioecesis Cracoviensis finibus, sacro diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Dei Matris dilectionem et cultum quotiens profecto licet excitare in fidelium communitatibus et augere, Nos ardenti sane studio ac magna quadam laetitia perfundimur
notes: Act begins on printed page 1447 (passage printed_page is 1446); confirmed by the volume index. Faculty granted to Franciscus Card. Macharski, Archbishop of Kraków, petition dated 22 Aug. 1987, to crown the image in the Pope's name in person or through another; no coronation date given. The rubric spells 'Scapularia', the body 'Scapularis'. Church not named (Carmelite shrine at Czerna). Country not named: inferred from Czerna / archdiocese of Kraków. No vernacular title in the act; the Latin has 'B. M. V. Scapularis seu de Monte Carmelo'.

rubric_latin: In occasione CCC anniversariae memoriae diei quo imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Claromontanae diadema incoronata est.
notes: Video message for the 300th anniversary of the papal coronation of the Jasna Góra image: 'trecento anni fa il Papa concesse di porre le corone papali sull'immagine della Madonna di Jasna Gora'. Message is in Italian, so no Latin incipit; the rubric is the Latin heading. The 1717 coronation itself is not documented here beyond the anniversary. Two further batch passages (2017_aas-indice2017#14 and #73) are index entries pointing to this same page 928. Diocese not named in the text; inferred.

rubric_latin: Imago B. M. V. quae in ecclesia Sanctissimae Trinitatis in oppido « Gliwice » asservatur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur.
incipit_latin: Nostri Pontificatus ab initio Virginis Mariae cultum atque amorem continenter in universo christiano populo excitare et augere satagimus
notes: Act begins on printed page 514 (passage printed_page is 513); the volume index also cites it at p. 514. The task of crowning is committed to Iosephus Card. Glemp, Archbishop of Gniezno-Warsaw and President of the Polish Bishops' Conference, or a delegate; petition dated 16 Feb. 1987; no coronation date given. Country not named directly: inferred from 'Coetus Episcoporum Poloniae' and Gliwice/Opole. This act was re-printed at AAS 79 (1987) 833. No vernacular title in the act; the image is named from the place 'Lysiec' (Łysiec).

rubric_latin: Imago B. M. V. quae in ecclesia Sanctissimae Trinitatis in oppido « Gliwice » asservatur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur.
incipit_latin: Nostri Pontificatus ab initio Virginis Mariae cultum atque amorem continenter in universo christiano populo excitare et augere satagimus
notes: Second printing of the same act already published at AAS 79 (1987) 514: it opens fasc. N. 7 (8 July 1987) under the heading LITTERAE APOSTOLICAE with no act number, and spells the date 'die sexto et vigesimo mensis Martii' where p. 514 has 'die xxvi mensis Martii'. Duplicate of the record for p. 514. Country inferred as above. No vernacular title in the act; the image is named from the place 'Lysiec' (Łysiec).

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Matris Consolationis », pie servata Gnesnae in ecclesia dicata Beatae Mariae Virgini in caelum Assumptae, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Mater Iesu, in historiam salutis intime ingressa, maxima fidei placita in se quodammodo unit et reverberat, dum praedicatur et colitur.
notes: Abp Henryk Muszyński of Gniezno is deputed to impose the crown in the Pope's name. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Imago Matris Dei Dolorosae, quae pie servatur in paroeciali templo loci « Halcnów » intra fines Bielscensis-Zyviecensis dioecesis in Polonia, pretioso diademate sinitur redimiri « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Probe novimus in dilecta Polonica Natione Christifideles Bielscensis-Zyviecensis dioecesis finitimarumque regionum singulari pietate venerari antiquam et gratiosam imaginem Matris Dei Dolorosae
notes: Bishop Tadeusz Rakoczy is commissioned to crown the image on a day of his choosing, in the Pope's name; his petition is dated 5 August 1992. The act notes both Polish and German faithful venerate the image. Polish vernacular title supplied as the standard rendering of 'Mater Dei Dolorosa'; not given in the act.

rubric_latin: Imago B. Mariae Virginis Nivalis, quae in monte « Iglizna », intra fines archidioecesis Vratislaviensis, custoditur, pretioso diademate coronatur.
incipit_latin: Quanta Beatae Virginis Nivalis imago colatur pietate, quae in monte « Iglizna » seu Acuum custoditur
notes: Faculty granted to Abp Henricus Gulbinowicz of Wrocław to impose the crown in the Pope's name. Act notes the church there was dedicated to the Virgin in 1782. Country inferred from archidioecesis Vratislaviensis / Miedzygórze (Międzygórze); not named in the act. Vernacular title supplied as the standard rendering of 'B. M. V. Nivalis', not verbatim.

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum PP. II occasione Audientiae generalis in area quae respicit Basilicam Vaticanam die III mensis Iulii anno MCMXCVIII coronavisse gratiosam imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo Matka Niezawodnej Nadziei, quae pie colitur in oratorio loci v.d. Jamna, in dioecesi Tarnoviensi.
incipit_latin: Firma spe restituta in pago v.d. Jamna, ubi tempore belli militum crudelitas locum fecit desolationis, nunc iuvenes una cum ferventi suo moderatore dilecto Filio Ioanne Gòra, OP
notes: The batch passage is the volume index (printed page 1207), which cites the act at printed page 1032; rubric, incipit and dates were read from the full act text in txt/AAS-91-1999-ocr.txt at [[PDFPAGE 1032]]. The Pope placed a golden crown ('auream imposuimus coronam') on the image at the general audience in St Peter's Square, 3 July 1998; recently painted image, at the youth prayer/formation centre founded by Fr Jan Góra OP. Requested by Bishop Wiktor Skworc of Tarnów. Country (Poland) inferred from the Tarnów diocese and the Polish title; not stated in the text.

image_title_vernacular: Matka Boża Łaskawa z Janowa Lubelskiego
rubric_latin: Sinitur Episcopus Lublinensis imaginem B. M. V. titulo « Amabilis », seu « a Rosario », in loco Janów Lubelski veneratam, diademate redimire nomine atque auctoritate Summi Pontificis.
incipit_latin: Libenti semper animo id agere consuevimus, quod in beatissimae Virginis Mariae honorem cedit : praeterquam quod enim est Illa Redemptoris Nostri Mater amabilis
notes: Assigned passage is the Index rerum analyticus (printed p. 1219): 'B. M. V. titulo «Amabilis». Episcopo Lublinensi fit facultas coronandi eiusdem imaginem, 708'. Record built on the act at printed p. 708, used as aas_page. Faculty to Bishop Boleslaus (Bolesław) Pylak to impose the diadem 'sive per se sive per alium'. Country inferred from the diocese/place name (not stated in the act), hence medium; vernacular title is a rendering, not quoted in the text — a checker should verify it.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris templo oppidi Iaroslaviae, Beatae Mariae Virgini Dolorosae sacro, attribuuntur.
incipit_latin: Clarissimum dederunt nomen Iaroslaviae, quod est oppidum Polonorum in finibus dioecesis Premisliensis, effigies et ecclesia
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation attested in passing: 'Eadem iam praeterita aetate a sacrorum Antistite perpulchro pretiosoque diademate fuit redimita: cuius rei memoria, duobus exactis saeculis, magna coram multitudine nuper est celebrata'. CHECKER NOTE: the text says the image was crowned by 'a sacrorum Antistite' (the bishop) and does NOT state papal or Vatican Chapter authority; included because it documents a solemnly crowned sacred image whose bicentenary of coronation had recently been celebrated (hence c. 1755-1766 — left null as not explicitly stated). Latin toponym 'Iaroslavia' = Jarosław; the text explicitly calls it 'oppidum Polonorum'.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Porta Misericordiae », quae in templo Transfigurationis Domini Iaroslaviae colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Dei Genetrix Maria « ea quidem est quae divinae misericordiae interius percipit mysterium » (Dives in misericordia, 9)
notes: Country Poland inferred from Jarosław and the Ukrainian Byzantine-rite eparchy of Przemyśl; not stated in the act. Bishop Ioannes (Jan) Martyniak permitted to crown the image in the Pope's name; his letters of 28 Nov. 1994.

rubric_latin: Imago Sacrae Familiae, in basilica Assumptionis intra fines dioecesis Vladislaviensis sita, pretioso diademate coronatur.
incipit_latin: Surreptis misere nuper impieque pretiosis corollis, quibus videlicet Sacrae Familiae Nazarethanae enitebat simulacrum in Basilica ipsa Assumptionis
notes: Re-crowning: the previous precious crowns had just been stolen ('sacrilegum furtum'), and Bp Ioannes Zareba obtained the faculty to impose new ones in the Pope's name. DATE DISCREPANCY: body reads 'die II mensis Martii', volume index (p. 1111) lists the act (incipit 'Surreptis misere') under 11 March 1984 — verify. Country inferred from Kalisz / dioecesis Vladislaviensis; not named in the act.

image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej Kalwaryjskiej (Our Lady of Kalwaria)
rubric_latin: Ex urbe Cracovia, mane, Summus Pontifex sacram aedem adiit B. M. V., quae per vulgus « Kalwaria Zebrzydowska » appellatur, et hanc allocutionem ante templum fecit
notes: 'obraz Matki Bożej Kalwaryjskiej, ukoronowany 15 sierpnia 1887 r. przez kard. Albina Dunajewskiego, biskupa krakowskiego, koronami papieża Leona XIII' — crowned 15 Aug 1887 by Cardinal Albin Dunajewski, Bishop of Kraków, with crowns of Pope Leo XIII. In the same allocution John Paul II grants the sanctuary the title of minor basilica. Act begins on printed page 839; attestation on p. 840. Body in Polish, no Latin incipit.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Episcopus Lublinensis imaginem B. M. V. coronare, quae in loco Kazimierz, in finibus Poloniae, pie a fidelibus colitur.
incipit_latin: Quotiescumque de gloria atque laude beatae Mariae Virginis agitur hic in terris augenda, aequissimo semper animo ac serenissimo gaudio
notes: Source passage is the AAS 78 chronological index (p. 1334); the act was retrieved from txt and is cited at its own page 143 (index OCR of the place reads 'Kasimierz'). Bishop: Bolesław Pylak.

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis « Reginae Familiarum » imago, quae paroeciali in templo oppidi « Koscierzyna » asservatur, nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis coronatur.
incipit_latin: Ab antiquis iam temporibus omnium ordinum fideles ad Virginem Mariam fidenti animo decurrerunt, pro comperto habentes superna se beneficia indulgenter accepturos.
notes: Requested by Bp Jan Szlaga of Pelplin. The diocese is not named in the rubric but is identified from the petitioner ('Episcopi Pelplinensis'). OCR interleaves this act with the preceding one (Basilica of St Lambert, Hengelo) because of the two-column scan. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA SANCTISSIMAE TRINITATIS IN URBE ET ARCHIDIOECESI CRACOVIENSI TITULO BASILICAE MINORIS EXORNATUR.
incipit_latin: Sanctorum terra vere appellanda videtur Polonia, Petrianae Cathedrae addictissima atque contra ethnicos et Crucis inimicos firmissimum munimentum
notes: « Decursu temporis ipsa Virginis Effigies pluries aurea fuit redimita corona: novissime autem, anno MCMXXI, astantibus Poloniae Primate nec non Archiepiscopis, Episcopis et Abbatibus fidelibusque prudentibus, bo. me. Adamus Stephanus Sapieha, tunc temporis Archiepiscopus Cracoviensis ac postea a Nobis inter Purpuratos Patres ascitus, eam pretioso diademate sollemni ritu coronavit. » Crowned more than once; the 1921 rite was performed by Abp (later Cardinal) Adam Stefan Sapieha. Papal authority is not expressly stated for the 1921 rite. Polish vernacular title supplied by me, not in the text.

rubric_latin: Imago Deiparae Virginis de Fatima, quae pie servatur in templo paroeciali Beatae Mariae Virgini, Reginae Poloniae, dicato intra fines urbis Cracoviae regionis « Nowa Huta Bienczyce » appellatae, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Obversatur saepe ante Nostros oculos Deipara Virgo de Fatima, quam Christifideles urbis Cracoviae regionis « Nowa Huta Bienczyce » appellatae
notes: The Pope recalls having consecrated this parish church himself on 15 May 1977 as Archbishop of Kraków. Card. Franciszek Macharski is empowered to crown in the Pope's name; his petition is dated 20 February 1992.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de Perpetuo Succursu, pie servata in ecclesia paroeciali Sanctissimo Redemptori dicata, loco Podgórze, Cracoviae in regione, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Sacra illa paroecialis aedes Sanctissimo Redemptori dicata loco Podgórze, Cracoviae in regione, gratiosam imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis de Perpetuo Succursu servat
notes: Country Poland inferred from Kraków; not stated in the act. Cardinal Franciszek Macharski deputed to impose the crown in the Pope's name.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Imago B. M. V. quae est in pago Krypno, archidioecesis Vilnensis in Białystok, coronari.
incipit_latin: Mariam Virginem, castissimam Christi Matrem atque florem convallium pulcherrimum, fuisse ubique tot per saecula summa religione veneratam
notes: Act begins on printed p. 608 (running head in context); passage indexed at p. 606. Faculty granted to Bp Eduardus Kisiel, titular of Limata and Apostolic Administrator, or his delegate. Country explicit ('in Polonia'). Painted image ('in illo imagine picta').

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Gratiarum, quae sub titulo « Matki Bozej Laskawej » in sanctuario loci v.d. Krzeszów pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Silesiae antiquissima Deiparae Virginis suavis imago, quae a multis iam saeculis in ecclesia loci v.d. Krzeszów custoditur, populi renovata devotione volumus cumuletur.
notes: Granted at the request of Bp Thaddaeus (Tadeusz) Rybak of Legnica, whose letters are dated 12 Feb 1996. OCR splits the title as « Matki Bozej Laska-wej ». Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

image_title_vernacular: Matka Boża Pocieszenia (Our Lady of Leżajsk)
rubric_latin: BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO AUGETUR ECCLESIA B. M. V. AB ANGELO SALUTATAE, IN SUBURBIO LEZAJEK DIOECESIS PREMISLIENSIS LAT.
incipit_latin: Constat apprime templum ab Annuntiatione B. Mariae Virginis Deiparae, quod in suburbio Lezajelc dioecesis Premisliensis Latinorum situm
notes: Basilica Minor act; states the miraculous image in the right-hand chapel, together with the Divine Child, was crowned 'aureo ac pretioso diademate celeberrima pompa' on 8 Sept 1752 by Bishop Venceslaus comes Sierakowski 'de Apostolica autoritate, ac de mandato Benedicti PP. XIV'. OCR gives the place as 'Lezajek'/'Lezajelc' (= Leżajsk). Country from the text's own 'universa Polonia'. Vernacular title supplied from the shrine's identity, not from the text. Act begins on printed p. 351 (passage flagged at p. 352, where the coronation clause falls).

image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej z Lubaczowa (Matka Boża Łaskawa, image of the vows of King John Casimir)
rubric_latin: Cestochoviae, occasione oblata coronationis quattuor Imaginum Beatae Mariae Virginis.
notes: One of four images crowned personally by John Paul II at Jasna Góra, Częstochowa, on 19 June 1983 ('Mam włożyć papieskie korony na skronie Jezusa i Maryi w obrazie z Lubaczowa'). Described as the image that witnessed the vows of John Casimir in the Lviv cathedral in 1656 and before which the Mother of God was first called Queen of the Polish Crown. Bishop Marian Rechowicz, Apostolic Administrator in Lubaczów, is greeted. Image detail on printed page 938; act begins on p. 935. Body in Polish, no Latin incipit.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Gratiarum, quae sub titulo « Matris Consolationis » in ecclesia paroeciali loci v.d. Lubiszewo, in dioecesi Pelplinensi, pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: « Vivens est Maria verbum consolationis ipsi Ecclesiae in proelio contra mortem » (Evangelium vitae, 105).
notes: Requested by Bp Jan Bernard Szlaga of Pelplin (letters of 25 Sept 1996). Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Episcopus Lublinensis coronandi simulacrum B. M. V. « Dominae Nostrae Plorantis », quae pie servatur in cathedrali aede S. Ioannis.
incipit_latin: Complura inter sacella illa ac monumenta Marialia, quibus et merito Nostra patria Polonia catholica gloriatur
notes: Passage printed_page is 967 but the act begins on p. 966 (rubric IV there, confirmed in txt and in the AAS 80 index); aas_page set to the act's start page. Bishop: Bolesław Pylak.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae sub titulo « Consolatrix Afflictorum » in ecclesia paroeciali loci v. d. Miedzna in dioecesi Drohiczinensi pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Lucis Matrem fecundam et Virginem purissimam omnis populus christianus firmiter confitetur Reginam caelestem, ad quam sane constanter in omnibus necessitatibus confugit.
notes: These Letters commemorate a faculty already granted on 27 July 1996 ('concessimus die xxvii superioris mensis Iulii') at the request of Bp Antoni Pacyfik Dydycz, and the solemn coronation that followed; the exact coronation date is not given. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae pie servatur in ecclesia paroeciali B.M.V. a Sancto Rosario et Sancti Stanislai, episcopi et martyris, loco Myszków-Mrzyglód in archidioecesi Czestochoviensi, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Imago illa Beatae Mariae Virginis « Assumptae in Caelum Reginae Sancti Rosarii », quae exornat ecclesiam paroecialem Beatae Mariae Virgini a Sancto Rosario et Sancto Stanislao
notes: Country Poland inferred from the archdiocese of Częstochowa; not stated in the act. OCR renders the place as « Myszkòw-Mrzyglòd ». Archbishop Stanisław Nowak deputed to impose the crown.

rubric_latin: Conceditur facultas coronandi Imaginis B. M. V. quae colitur in cathedrali templo Opoliensi, in Polonia.
incipit_latin: Quanta religione et amore Polonus populus, ducibus Episcopis, Mariam, Christi Matrem castissimam, per aetates prosecutus sit ac prosequatur
notes: Petition of Bp Alfonsus Nossol of Opole; the image is to be crowned in the Pope's name and authority. Country explicit (rubric 'in Polonia'). Datum line gives no pontifical year but 'Sanctissimae Redemptionis Nostrae Iubilaeo'.

image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej z katedry opolskiej (Our Lady of Opole)
rubric_latin: In templo Sanctuario S. Annae apud Opolium habita.
notes: 'Na pamiątkę mej obecności na tej ziemi pragnę za chwilę dokonać koronacji czcigodnego obrazu Matki Bożej z katedry opolskiej' — the Pope announces he is about to crown the venerable image of the Mother of God from the Opole cathedral, during the allocution at the sanctuary of St Anne (Góra Świętej Anny), 21 June 1983. Bishop Alfons Nossol of Opole is greeted. Act begins on printed page 974; announcement on p. 979. Body in Polish, no Latin incipit.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae in Ecclesia paroeciali vulgo dicta « Ostrowąs » observatur, « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis » pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Quo in honore Beatissima Virgo Maria sit habita per saeculorum decursum et qua veneratione exculta a populo Polonico
notes: Retrieved from txt for the index entry 'Quo in honore ... 679'. OCR of the place name in the index reads 'Ostrowgs'/'Ostrowas'; the act body reads « Ostrowas » (i.e. Ostrowąs). Bishop: Ioannes Zaręba.

rubric_latin: Imago B. M. V., quae in dioecesi Pinskensi pie colitur necnon in paroeciali templo loci vulgo « Ostrozany » asservatur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Ex historia loci « Ostrozany », qui dioecesis Pinskensis est paroecia, certo cognoscitur clarum templum illic anno MCCCCL primum effectum esse
notes: Act begins on printed page 13 (passage printed_page is 12). Faculty granted at the petition of Ladislaus Jedruszuk, titular Bishop of Clysma and Apostolic Administrator of Pinsk, with the Polish Bishops' Conference concurring; no coronation date given. Country not stated: inferred from the reference to the former province of Podlachia and the 'Plenaria Episcoporum Poloniae Conferentia' - Ostrożany lies in Poland. Image dates from the 17th cent.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « a Consolatione » invocatae, quae in ecclesia paroeciali pagi vulgo Pasierbiec appellati colitur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis.
incipit_latin: Notum est Christifideles Polonici dioecesis Tarnoviensis ac propinquarum Ecclesiarum multa cum pietate colere imaginem Beatae Virginis Mariae
notes: Bishop Józef Życiński of Tarnów is permitted to impose the crown in the Pope's name; his petition is dated 7 May 1992. Polish vernacular title supplied as the usual rendering of 'a Consolatione' - the act itself gives no vernacular form.

act_type: Decretum super virtutibus (Congregatio de Causis Sanctorum)
rubric_latin: VARSAVIENSIS. Beatificationis et Canonizationis Servi Dei Augusti Iosephi Hlond, e Societate S. Francisci Salesii, S.R.E. Cardinalis Archiepiscopi Gnesnensis et Varsaviensis ac Fundatoris Societatis Christi pro Emigrantibus Polonis (1881-1948). DECRETUM SUPER VIRTUTIBUS
incipit_latin: Antiquissimam imaginem marianam, per saecula veneratam in loco Piekary in Alta Silesia, coronavit.
notes: WEAK / needs human check. Decree on the heroic virtues of August Hlond states that he crowned the ancient Marian image at Piekary in Upper Silesia while Apostolic Administrator. The decree opens on printed p. 1342; the coronation clause falls on p. 1343 — aas_page is the act's start page as instructed. Papal authority for the crowning is NOT stated in the passage, and no date is given (the decree's own Datum is not in the retrieved excerpt). Vernacular title and country are supplied from context ('in Polonia', Alta Silesia).

rubric_latin: Ecclesia paroecialis urbis v. d. « Piekary » ad dignitatem Basilicae Minoris evehitur.
incipit_latin: Augustissimis Poloniae templis iure meritoque videtur esse accensenda ecclesia paroecialis, quae in urbe v. Piekary, intra Silesiae fines, exsurgit
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating 'Nostra demum aetate, Pii Pp. XI permissu ... imago, quam diximus, aureo diademate est redimita'. No year given; only that it was by permission of Pius XI (1922-1939). The act also recalls King John Sobieski praying before the image on his way to Vienna.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Mirowskiej » invocatae quae in templo Ordinis Fratrum Minorum loci « Pinczow » intra fines Kielcensis dioecesis pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Constat intra fines Kielcensis dioecesis in templo Ordinis Fratrum Minorum loci « Pinczow » inde a xvi saeculo Christifideles peculiari pietate venerari claram imaginem
notes: Title given in the Latin text as « Mirowskiej » (Polish oblique form); vernacular nominative supplied. The image is a copy of Salus Populi Romani. Bishop Stanisław Szymecki of Kielce is empowered to crown in the Pope's name. The AAS 83 index (p. 1103) wrongly summarises this act as a basilica minor elevation.

rubric_latin: Archiepiscopo Cracoviensi conceditur ut possit imaginem B. M. V. coronare pretioso diademate, in loco Ploki, in finibus propriae archidioecesis honoratam.
incipit_latin: Beatam ac semper Virginem Mariam, Christi Matrem sanctissimam eandemque hominum decorem ac praesidium, ab omnibus honorari et coli laudeque praedicari
notes: Faculty granted to Card. Franciscus Macharski, Archbishop of Kraków, to crown the image in the Pope's name during Mass. Country explicit ('Polono populo').

image_title_vernacular: Matka Boża Tęskniąca (Matka Boza Teskniaca), Powsin
rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae pie servatur in ecclesia paroeciali loco v.d. « Powsin » in archidioecesi Varsaviensi, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Christifideles incolentes locum v.d. « Powsin » ipsique proximi archidioecesi Varsaviensi, sacram imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Matka Boza Teskniaca » tribus abhinc saeculis peculiari veneratione prosequuntur.
notes: Józef Card. Glemp, Archbishop of Warsaw, is deputed to impose the crown in the Pope's name. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

legate: Deusdedit Marianus Vincentius Sikorski, Episcopus Plocensis (deputed to impose the crown 'Nostro nomine et auctoritate')
rubric_latin: Imago Deiparae Virginis Immaculatae in sacello loci qui dicitur vulgo « Przasnysz » dioecesis Plocensis aureo redimitur serto.
incipit_latin: Quo sanctius atque utilius a Christifidelibus excoleretur imago Deiparae Virginis Mariae Immaculatae, quae in sacello curae concredito Sodalium Religiosorum a Passione Iesu Christi conservatur religioseque observatur
notes: The batch passage is the volume's chronological index (printed p. 757), which lists this act; the full act was read at printed p. 380 of txt/AAS-66-1974-ocr.txt, and aas_page is set to 380 accordingly. The image is a painting ('perantiqua pictura'). 'in oppido Poloniae Przasnysz dicto' explicit. Occasion: the approaching 900th anniversary of the diocese of Plock. Also listed in the analytic index at p. 792. The bishop's Latin forename 'Deusdedit' renders the Polish Bogdan (Bogdan Marian Sikorski).

rubric_latin: CATHEDRALIS ECCLESIA PREMISLIENSIS LATINORUM BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO HONORIBUSQUE AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Romanorum Pontificum beneficio solet templis, quae religione, structurae genere, artificiosis operibus valde commendantur, peculiaris honor adiungi.
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating 'signum Dei Genetricis, aureo diademate anno MDCCLXVI ornatum'. Crowning authority not named. Country Poland inferred from the see name Premisliensis Latinorum (Przemyśl) and the title 'Regina Poloniae'.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Episcopus Lomzensis imaginem B. Virginis Mariae, quae in sacello paroeciae Pionka Koscielna excolitur, diademate coronare nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis.
incipit_latin: Nemo ferme illis in locis invenitur quin ipse noverit non modo quantum erga Sanctisimam Iesu Christi Matrem amorem cultumque praestare consueverit
notes: Second act inside the same passage; the act opens on printed p. 286 (the passage's printed_page is 285). Rubric OCR reads 'Pionka Koscielna'; the body has both 'Plonka Kascielna' and 'Plonka Koscielna' — correct form Płonka Kościelna. Faculty to Bishop Iulius (Juliusz) Paetz of Łomża. Country inferred from the diocese/place name (not stated), hence medium. Vernacular title supplied as a rendering, not quoted. Also indexed at p. 1219.

rubric_latin: Fit facultas Episcopo Gorzoviensi sacram coronandi imaginem B. M. V. « Dominae patientis auditionis », quae in paroecia Rokitno eiusdem dioecesis pie colitur.
incipit_latin: Quam iucunda omnino cum animi recordatione, quam suavi simul cum pietatis adiectione ad locum simulacrum cultum revolvimur hodie
notes: Retrieved from txt for the AAS 80 index entry 'Dominae patientis auditionis ... 965'. The rubric reads 'patientis auditionis', the body 'patientis exauditionis'. Bishop: Józef Michalik.

rubric_latin: Templum Visitationis Beatae Mariae Virginis, in dioecesi Varmiensi situm, ad dignitatem Basilicae Minoris evehitur.
incipit_latin: Satis constat quanta pietate Polonica gens prosecuta sit praeteritis temporibus et adhuc prosequatur Beatam Mariam Virginem
notes: Basilica Minor act; states in passing that the image venerated there had recently been crowned ('etiam imaginem Beatae Virginis ibi cultam recenter esse diademate coronatam'), which was one motive for the elevation. No coronation date given. Act begins on printed p. 479 (running head '480 Acta Apostolicae Sedis' follows the opening); passage indexed at p. 480; volume index also cites p. 479. 'Sacra Tilia' is Święta Lipka (identification not in the text). Country from 'Polonica gens' + dioecesis Varmiensis.

legate: Bogdanus Sikorski, Episcopus Plocensis (granted the faculty to crown 'nomine Nostro')
rubric_latin: Episcopo Plocensi conceditur ut possit imaginem B. M. V. coronare pretioso diademate, in loco Sierpe, in finibus suae ipsius dioecesis veneratam.
incipit_latin: Beatam ac semper Virginem Mariam, Christi Matrem sanctissimam, eandemque hominum decus ac praesidium, ab omnibus honorari, coli, atque laude praedicari
notes: Locality given twice as 'Sierpe' in rubric and body; best reading is Sierpc in the diocese of Plock - verify. Country from 'Polono populo' in the body. Day and hour of the coronation left to the bishop's choice. Confirmed in the volume's chronological index (p. 1286) under 25 Apr. 1980.

rubric_latin: Imago B. Mariae Virginis Perdolentis, quae in loco dioecesis Coslinensis-Colubregani v. d. Skrzatusz veneratur, pretioso diademate coronatur.
incipit_latin: Polonus populus, sicut omnes noverunt, Beatissimam Virginem Mariam per saeculorum decursum peculiari veneratione est prosecutus
notes: Retrieved from txt for the index entry 'Polonus populus ... 977'. Bishop: Ignacy Jeż.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae pie servatur in ecclesia paroeciali loco v.d. « Skrzynsko » in dioecesi Radomensi, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Omnium Christifidelium spiritale curantes bonum, Beatae Mariae Virginis propagare volumus cultum, quae eminenter et singulariter tum virginis tum matris exemplar praebet.
notes: Image of the Virgin with the Infant Jesus ('imaginem Virginis cum Iesu Infante'). Bp Edward Materski of Radom is deputed to impose the crown. The place is printed « Skrzynsko » here and « Skrzyiisko » in the volume index (p. 1055). Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Dolorosae quae in ecclesia oppidi v.d. Skulsk colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: In dolorosae Christi Matris vitam « permultae et vehementes passiones confluxerunt in talem nexum et colligationem, ut non solum fidem eius inconcussam comprobarent »
notes: Country Poland inferred from the diocese of Włocławek and the place Skulsk; not stated in the act. OCR of the quotation reads « eolli-gationem » (colligationem). Bishop Bronisław Dembowski, letters of 2 Feb. 1996.

legate: Ludovicus Iacobini, Apostolicae Sedis Legatus
rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM B. M. V. IN CAELUM ASSUMPTAE, IN OPPIDO STARAVIEN, DIOECESIS PREMISLIEN. LAT., BASILICAE MINORIS PRIVILEGIIS AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Exstat intra fines dioecesis Premisliensis Latinorum, in oppido Stammen vulgo nuncupato, celeberrimum sanctuarium Deo sacrum in honorem B. Mariae Virginis Deiparae sideribus receptae
notes: Coronation attested: 'imago Virginis diademate aureo ab Apostolicae Sedis Legato Ludovico Iacobinio anno MDCCCLXXVII redimita'; the act is sought on the 50th anniversary 'ex quo supradicta Imago Virginis sollemni ritu corona praecincta fuit'. Place name OCR-mangled: rubric 'STARAVIEN', body 'in oppido Stammen vulgo nuncupato' and 'loci vulgo Star avien' = Starawieś. Country explicit ('in Polonia').

image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej ze Stoczka Warmińskiego (Matka Pokoju / Mother of Peace)
rubric_latin: Cestochoviae, occasione oblata coronationis quattuor Imaginum Beatae Mariae Virginis.
notes: One of four images crowned personally by John Paul II at Jasna Góra, Częstochowa, on 19 June 1983 ('obrazie z sanktuarium w Stoczku, Diecezji Warmińskiej'). The Pope gives thanks to 'Matka Pokoju' (Mother of Peace) for over three hundred years of protection over Warmia, and recalls that Stoczek was the place of Cardinal Wyszyński's internment 1953-1954. Bishop Jan Obłąk of Warmia is greeted. Image detail on printed pages 938-939; act begins on p. 935.

image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej ze Stoczka Warmińskiego (Matka Pokoju / Mother of Peace)
rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum II die undevicesimo mensis Iunii anno 1983 imaginem coronasse Beatae Mariae Virginis « Matris Pacis » in dioecesi Varmiensi.
incipit_latin: Maxima afficimur laetitia quotiescumque facultas Nobis contingit signum aliquod dandi Nostrae in Beatissimam Virginem Mariam pietatis
notes: Retrieved from txt for the AAS 81 index entry 'Matris Pacis, in dioec. Varmiensi, 827'. The Pope crowned the image at Jasna Góra, Częstochowa, on 19 June 1983 (one of the four images of the Częstochowa coronation address, AAS 75 p. 935). Bishop: Jan Obłąk.

rubric_latin: Statua B. M. V. de Fatima, quae Stettini in paroeciali asservatur templo Immaculato Cordi Mariae dedicato, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Cum in Ecclesia Sedinensi-Caminensi recens condita nullum adhuc ex sententia Sanctae Sedis sit simulacrum aliqua corona redimitum
notes: Retrieved from txt for the index entry 'Cum in ... 408'. Bishop: Kazimierz Majdański. Country inferred from the see and place name (act does not name Poland).

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Scapularis, quae pie servatur in ecclesia paroeciali Annuntiationis B.M.V., loco Tomaszów Lubelski in dioecesi Zamosciensi-Lubaczoviensi, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Imago illa Beatae Mariae Virginis Scapularis, quae exornat ecclesiam paroecialem Annuntiationis B.M.V, loco vulgo Tomaszów Lubelski
notes: Act names the region as Polish (« illius Polonicae regionis »). Bishop Jan Śrutwa deputed to impose the crown in the Pope's name.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis de Fatima, quae in ecclesia paroeciali oppidi v.d. Trzebinia in archidioecesi Cracoviensi colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: « Mater pulchrae dilectionis, christianis tertii millennii in magnum Iubilaeum procedentibus quoddam erit Sidus, quod firmiter gressus Domino obviam moderabitur » (Tertio millennio adveniente, 59).
notes: Requested by Franciszek Card. Macharski, Archbishop of Kraków (letters of 17 June 1996). The same act is also visible at the end of passage AAS-88-1996-ocr#910. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Auxiliatricis, quae pie servatur in ecclesia Sanctuarii B.M.V., loco Twardogóra in dioecesi Calissiensi, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: In ecclesia sanctuario loci vulgo dicti Twardogóra gratiosa colitur imago B. Mariae Virginis Auxiliatricis.
notes: Country Poland inferred from the diocese of Kalisz and the place name; not stated in the act. Bishop Stanisław Napierała deputed to impose the crown.

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis de Fatima simulacrum quod in templo servatur S. Petri Apostoli in urbe quam Wadowice vocant diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Cum Nos sollicito quidem studio Beatissimam Virginem Mariam usque prosequimur, tum etiam, quotiescumque de eiusdem gloria cultuque agitur apud fideles augendis
notes: The Pope states he crowned the statue himself ('sacro diademate Nos sollemniter coronavimus Ipsi') while at Wadowice during an apostolic journey to Poland; the act gives no date for the crowning, so coronation_date is null. Requested by Card. Franciszek Macharski. OCR runs words together in the incipit ('sollicitoquidem', 'Viginem'), silently repaired.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis Gratiarum, quae in ecclesia S. Francisci Assisiensis oppidi v.d. Wieliczka colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Merito invocatur a populo fideli Beata Virgo Maria, quae « mater nobis in ordine gratiae exstitit » (Lumen gentium, 61).
notes: Country Poland inferred from Wieliczka and the archdiocese of Kraków; not stated in the act. Petition of Cardinal Franciszek Macharski, letters of 15 Dec. 1993. The act notes the Pope himself had formerly venerated the image.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Episcopus Siedlcensis imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis redimire quam Polonus populus in templo « Wola Gulowska » in dioecesi Siedlcensi veneratur.
incipit_latin: Quo amore quaque veneratione in Deiparam Virginem Mariam filii feramur, sub cuius tutelam non modo primaevum sacerdotium
notes: Faculty granted to Bp Ioannes Mazur of Siedlce (or his delegate) to crown the image in the Pope's name; day of coronation left to him. Country explicit ('Polonus populus', 'Poloni fideles'). Modern place-name Wola Gułowska.

rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis divinae Gratiae imago, quae in templo paroeciali S. Caroli Borromaei asservatur, in urbe Wratislaviensi, nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis coronatur.
incipit_latin: Saeculorum quidem decursu omnium ordinum fideles ad Virginem Mariam fidenti animo decurrerunt, pro comperto habentes superna se beneficia indulgenter accepturos.
notes: Country Poland inferred from the see of Wrocław; not stated in the act. Petition of Cardinal Henryk Roman Gulbinowicz, Archbishop of Wrocław.

rubric_latin: Imago beatae Mariae Virginis « Matris Adorantis », quae in cathedrali templo metropolitanae Sedis Vratislaviensis pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Probe novimus Christifideles Vratislaviae civitatis totiusque archidioecesis singulari pietate colere imaginem beatae Mariae Virginis « Matris Adorantis »
notes: The act addresses « istis dilectis Polonicis filiis ». The image is said to have been given by Clement XI to Alexander Sobieski, son of King John III. Petition of Cardinal Henryk Roman Gulbinowicz, letters of 10 Feb. 1996.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Victricis, quae Vratislaviae in Poloniae urbe pie colitur ibique in templo B.M.V. « in Arena » dedicato asservatur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Magno quidem honore dignissima existimanda videtur imago Beatae Mariae Victricis a saeculo XVI repetita
notes: Retrieved from txt for the AAS 80 index entry 'B.M.V. Victricis ... 1101'. Petitioner: Card. Henryk Gulbinowicz.

rubric_latin: B. M. V. de Consolatione imago quae in ecclesia paroeciali vulgo « Wlodawa-Orchówek », in Poloniae finibus, colitur, diademate « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis » redimitur.
incipit_latin: Saepe Nos memoria repetentes innumera beneficia in catholicam Ecclesiam indesinenter a B. V. Maria collata, pietatem nimirum erga tantam tamque munificam fidelium omnium matrem patronamque confirmari
notes: Faculty granted to Ioannes Mazur, Bishop of Siedlce, to crown the image in the Pope's name on a feast day, in person or through another; no coronation date given. Country explicit in the rubric ('in Poloniae finibus'). No vernacular title in the act; the Latin has 'B. M. V. de Consolatione'.

rubric_latin: B. M. V. signum quod in ecclesia paroeciali loci v. d. Zakopane-Krzeptówki colitur ab Ipso Summo Pontifice pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Nemini quidem latet quanta dilectione quantoque filiali amore Nos ab ineunte aetate Beatam Mariam Virginem colamus
notes: Retrieved from txt for the AAS 80 index entry 'Ab ipso S. P. coronatur quae in loco Zakopane-Krzeptówki colitur, 1739'. The Pope crowned it himself in St Peter's Square: 'in Foro Petriano ... hoc ipso die, pridie IX anniversarii diei ab initio Pontificatus Nostri, simulacrum ... pretioso diademate coronavimus'. Coronation date taken as the Datum date (11 Oct 1987); the phrase 'pridie IX anniversarii' does not fit 11 October and should be checked. The image is a Fatima statue given by the Bishop of Leiria-Fátima to Card. Wyszyński. Petitioner: Card. Franciszek Macharski; country/diocese inferred from the Cracow archdiocese.

image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej z Zielenic (zieleniecki obraz Bogarodzicy)
rubric_latin: Cestochoviae, occasione oblata coronationis quattuor Imaginum Beatae Mariae Virginis.
notes: One of four images crowned personally by John Paul II at Jasna Góra, Częstochowa, on 19 June 1983 ('obrazie z sanktuarium w Zielenicach, Diecezji Kieleckiej'), tied to the centenary of the diocese of Kielce. Bishop Stanisław Szymecki of Kielce is greeted. Image detail on printed pages 939-940; act begins on p. 935.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. EMMANUELEM TIT. SANCTORUM MARCELLINI ET PETRI S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM GONÇALVES CEREJEIRA, PATRIARCHAM LISBONENSEM, QUEM LEGATUM DELIGIT AD CONGRESSUM MARIALEM E TOTA LUSITANIA, AUGUSTAE BRACARUM AD SANCTUARIUM « MONTE DO SAMEIRO » CELEBRANDUM.
incipit_latin: Iucundo admodum animo accepimus, proximo Iunio mense, Augustae Bracarum, in perillustri et prisca Lusitaniae septemtrionalis civitate, ad Sanctuarium celeberrimum « Monte do Sameiro »
notes: Legate letter for the Portuguese national Marian Congress; the Legate (Card. Gonçalves Cerejeira) is deputed to preside at the Congress, NOT to crown, so this is a retrospective attestation only: 'praeclarumque Deiparae Immaculatae simulacrum ... Romae egregia arte confectum et a Pio Pp. IX ... sacro ritu lustratum, quinquaginta abhinc annos aurea corona ... est feliciter redimitum'. Coronation year 1904 is computed from 'quinquaginta abhinc annos' relative to the act date (1954); not stated verbatim. The statue was made in Rome and blessed by Pius IX. OCR of the rubric in the passage reads 'MONTE DO SAMURO' and 'CONCALVES CERKJEIRA'; corrected from the body text ('Monte do Sameiro') and standard spelling.

rubric_latin: NUNTIUS RADIOPHONICUS A BEATISSIMO PATRE, DIE XIII MENSIS MAII A. MCMXLVI, LUSITANIAE CHRISTIFIDELIBUS DATUS, SOLLEMNIA CELEBRANTIBUS AD SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE V. A FATIMA, AUREA CORONA NOMINE SUMMI PONTIFICIS REDIMITAE.
notes: Assigned passage is the volume index (printed p. 461); the document itself is the radio message at printed p. 264, used as aas_page. Body is Portuguese: 'por mäo do Nosso Cardeal Legado, acabamos de coroar a Imagem taumaturga' — the Pope crowned the image through an unnamed Cardinal Legate, so legate left null. Country explicit ('Lusitaniae christifidelibus'). Classified retrospective_attestation because the document is a homiletic radio message attesting the coronation just performed, not the deputation act itself.

legate: Benedictus S. R. E. Cardinalis Aloisi Masella
rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. BENEDICTUM TIT. SANCTAE MARIAE IN VALLICELLA S. R. E. PRESBYTERUM CARDINALEM ALOISI MASELLA, QUEM LEGATUM MITTIT AD CORONAM APPONENDAM SIMULACRO B. MARIAE V. DE FATIMA.
incipit_latin: Celeberrima sollemnia, quae abhinc annos quattuor flagrantissima animorum pietate in honorem Beatae Mariae Virginis de Fatima a Lusitaniae fidelibus peracta sunt
notes: Reached from the back-of-volume index passage (p. 494: 'Coronatio: ... simulacri B. Mariae V. de Fatima, 267, 376'); the act itself is the Epistula on p. 376: 'perinsignem imaginem Nostrae Dominae de Fatima sollemni ritu coronandam censuimus ... Legatum Nostrum deligimus ac renuntiamus, ut in Sanctuario de Fatima inditam Beatae Mariae Imaginem nomine Nostro Nostraque auctoritate aureo diademate exornes'. The coronation itself is recorded in the papal radio message of 13 May 1946, AAS 38 (1946) pp. 264-267, rubric 'NUNTIUS RADIOPHONICUS ... SOLLEMNIA CELEBRANTIBUS AD SANCTUARIUM B. MARIAE V. A FATIMA, AUREA CORONA NOMINE SUMMI PONTIFICIS REDIMITAE' ('por mão do Nosso Cardeal Legado, acabamos de coroar a Imagem taumaturga'). Diocese (Leiria) not named in either text.

rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. FRIDERICUM, EPISCOPUM TUSCULANUM, S. R. E. CARDINALEM TEDESCHINI, PATRIARCHALIS BASILICAE VATICANAE ARCHIPRESBYTERUM, SACRI CONSILII PETRIANAE FABRICAE PRAEFECTUM EUNDEMQUE SUMMI PONTIFICIS DATARIUM, LEGATUM DELECTUM AD SACRA SOLLEMNIA IN LUSITANIA AD SIMULACRUM B. VIRGINIS MARIAE DE FATIMA CELEBRANDA.
incipit_latin: Proximo Octobri mense, postquam Congressus Marialis ex omnibus nationibus Ulyssipone in Lusitania habitus fuerit, Anno Sacro, quem ad universum catholicum orbem extendimus
notes: Letter deputing Card. Federico Tedeschini as Legate for the closing solemnities of the Holy Year at Fatima — NOT for a coronation; the crowning is mentioned retrospectively on printed p. 781: « quique eandem sollemni ritu quinque abhinc annos coronandam quoque decrevimus ». 'quinque abhinc annos' from the Datum (24 Sept 1951) gives 1946; the year is not stated outright. `legate` left null because Tedeschini was deputed for the solemnities, not to crown. Diocese not named in the act; Leiria supplied from the place name — verify. The candidate passage is keyed to printed p. 781; the act begins on p. 780, which is cited here.

legate: Benedictus S. R. E. Cardinalis Aloisi Masella
rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. BENEDICTUM EPISCOPUM PRAENESTINUM S. R. E. CARDINALEM ALOISI MASELLA, PATRIARCHALIS BASILICAE LATERANENSIS ARCHIPRESBYTERUM, SACRAE CONGREGATIONIS DE DISCIPLINA SACRAMENTORUM PRO-PRAEFECTUM, QUINQUAGESIMUM SACERDOTII ANNUM IMPLETURUM.
incipit_latin: Persuavi animi iucunditate accepimus, praenobilis sedis istius Praenestinae clerum fidelemque populum, egregio praeeunte Episcopo suffraganeo, concordi studere consilio
notes: Jubilee letter to Card. Aloisi Masella; the coronation is mentioned only retrospectively on printed p. 467: « Peculiarem quoque benevolentiam Nos tibi significavimus, quum ad coronam simulacro Beatae Mariae Virginis de Fatima apponendam Legatum Nostrum renuntiavimus ». No date given for the crowning. The Datum on p. 468 is OCR-corrupt ('die xviii mensis Maii, anno MDCCCCIII'); the pontifical year ('quarto decimo') fixes it as 1952, so 1952-05-18 — verify. Country inferred from 'de Fatima'.

rubric_latin: AD VENERABILES FRATRES PATRIARCHAS, ARCHIEPISCOPOS, EPISCOPOS ALIOSQUE LOCORUM ORDINARIOS PACEM ET COMMUNIONEM CUM APOSTOLICA SEDE HABENTES: DE REGALI BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS DIGNITATE EIUSQUE FESTO INSTITUENDO.
incipit_latin: Ad Caeli Reginam, inde a primis Catholicae Ecclesiae saeculis, supplices preces ac laudis pietatisque cantus christianus populus adhibuit
notes: Encyclical 'Ad caeli Reginam'. The act opens on printed p. 625; the coronation clause falls on p. 627, so aas_page is the act's start page (which here also equals the passage's printed_page). Clause: '...radiophonicum nuntium, quem ad Lusitanorum populum transmisimus, cum prodigialis Mariae Virginis imago, quae Fatimae colitur, aureo diademate redimita fuit' (OCR renders 'colitur' as 'eolito'). Footnote 3 cites A.A.S. 38 (1946) p. 264 — the radio message accompanying the 1946 crowning at Fátima — but this passage states no date, so coronation_date is null. Country inferred from 'ad Lusitanorum populum' + 'Fatimae'; no diocese or sanctuary named.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA PRINCIPALIS B. MARIAE V. A SACRATISSIMO ROSARIO, IN LOCO FATIMA LEIRIENSIS DIOECESIS POSITA, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO HONORIBUSQUE DECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Luce superna caliginosum saeculum illustranti, Beatae Mariae Virgini sacra est augusta Aedes Fatimae, in Lusitanorum finibus, ubi eadem Deipara, e Rosarii nomine nuncupata, olim se dedit conspiciendam.
notes: Basilica Minor elevation act; states in passing 'sive cum Imago Deiparae aureo diademate, Nostro nomine et auctoritate, anno scilicet MCMXLVI, redimiretur' - crowned 1946 in the Pope's name and by his authority; the crowning Legate is not named in the act. Country explicit ('in Lusitanorum finibus'). The act rubric and body begin on printed page 210.

rubric_latin: Ad universos Episcopos pacem et communionem cum Apostolica Sede habentes: de Beata Virgine Maria, Matre Ecclesiae omniumque virtutum exemplari, veneranda atque imitanda.
incipit_latin: SIGNUM MAGNUM, quod sanctus Ioannes Apostolus in caelo suspexit, Mulierem videlicet amictam sole, non immerito de beatissima Maria Virgine ... interpretatur
notes: Not an act about a coronation: the attestation is in footnote 6 of the Apostolic Exhortation Signum magnum - 'Nuntius Radiophonicus a Pio XII, die 13 mensis Maii anno 1946, Lusitaniae christifidelibus datus, sollemnia celebrantibus ad templum B. Mariae Fatimensis, aurea corona nomine Summi Pontificis redimitae: A. A. S. 38 (1946) p. 264'. Coronation date taken as the day of those solemnities (13 May 1946) - verify. The exhortation begins on p. 465 (rubric and incipit taken from there); the footnote is on p. 466. Locality 'Fátima' inferred from 'Fatimensis'; country explicit (Lusitania).

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de Monserrate » in sacrario eiusdem nominis pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Omnibus manifestum est a primordiis evangelizationis Americae Beatam Virginem Mariam vehementer ibi auxiliari, qua de causa a populo fideli prolixe colitur.
notes: Retrieved from the act itself; the batch passage is the back-of-volume 'Index rerum analyticus' (p. 1071) which points here. Petitioner: Ulixes Aurelius Casiano Vargas, Episcopus Maiaguezensis. Country explicit ('totius Portus Divitis Nationis'). Locality NOT given in the act — 'Hormigueros' is supplied from outside knowledge of this shrine and should be verified or dropped.

rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris ecclesia Beatae Mariae Virginis Septem Dolorum in oppido v. « Sastin », intra Tyrnaviensis Administrationis Apostolicae fines, decoratur.
incipit_latin: Quam pulchra, immortalis, frugifera ac triumphis assuefacta Fides, a Christo Domino nobis indita, sit, per varie tentatos ac vexatos populos clare comprobatur.
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation grant attested: 'Anno praesertim MDCCCLXIV, trecentesimo ab ipsa condita ecclesia, Servus Dei Pius Pp. IX, Decessor Noster, praeter nonnullas Indulgentias, Marialis simulacri coronationem concessit et largitus est' — Pius IX granted the coronation in 1864 (the year the grant was made; the ceremony's date is not given). OCR forms: 'MDCCCLX i v' = MDCCCLXIV; place 'Sassinii'/'Sassinio', vulgo 'Sastinkse Straze' = Šaštínske Stráže (Šaštín-Stráže). Incipit OCR 'triumphis assuefa Fides' repaired to 'assuefacta'. Act begins on printed p. 457; passage printed_page is 458. Country explicit ('Slovachiae'); vernacular title supplied, verify.

rubric_latin: Ecclesia B. Mariae Virginis Gratiarum in Monte Sancto ad dignitatem Basilicae minoris evehitur.
incipit_latin: In sublimi Beati Petri Cathedra, ad quam licet immerentes evecti sumus, nihil potius habemus, quam sacrarum aedium honor et cultus magis magisque in dies augeatur.
notes: Brief elevating the church to a minor basilica; the coronation is mentioned in passing: 'venerata Deiparae Virginis Imago quae summa religione ibidem colitur iam inde ab anno MDCCXVII ex decreto Capituli Vaticani aureo diademate ornata sit' — i.e. crowned with a golden diadem in 1717 by decree of the Vatican Chapter. The act begins on printed p. 19 (rubric + 'AD PERPETUAM REI MEMORIAM'); the coronation sentence itself falls on p. 20, which is the passage's printed_page. Datum line reads 'die XIX Novembris MCMVI, Pontificatus Nostri anno quarto' = 1906-11-19, one year earlier than the volume year (ASS 40 = 1907); trusted the act. The text places the shrine 'prope Urbem Goritiensem' in 'Austriacae Ditionis' (Austrian Littoral, county of Gorizia, 1907); the modern country is inferred — Sveta Gora / Monte Santo lies today in Slovenia, above Nova Gorica, just across the Italian border — hence confidence lowered to medium. Raw OCR: 'celebérrimas' for 'celeberrimas'. No vernacular title given in the text.

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora de la Peña de Francia
rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « Peña de Francia » vulgo appellata, principalis caelestis Patrona civilis provinciae Salmantinae eligitur.
incipit_latin: Singulari pietate excoli perhibetur Beata Maria Virgo, cuius, adiecto vulgari nomine « Peña de Francia » appellatae, sedes praecipua finibus dioecesis Salmantinae continetur.
notes: Patronage act; coronation attested in passing: 'Effigies denique, Pio Pp. XII Catholicam Ecclesiam regente, aureo diademate fuit, anno MCMLII, sollemniter redimita'. aas_page set to 794 (the rubric stands before the running head '795' in the passage; the passage was indexed as printed_page 795). No town named - only that the shrine lies within the diocese of Salamanca. Country explicit (Hispania).

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis sub titulo « Nuestra Señora del Remedio », quae in Lucentina ecclesia concathedrali pie colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Praeclarum confert donum christifidelibus diligens Deiparae cultus.
notes: Granted to Bp Victorio Oliver Domingo of Orihuela-Alicante (letters of 23 Feb 1998). The volume index (p. 1055) prints the rubric verb as 'redimatur'. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: SANCTUARIUM B. M. V. DE ARANZAZU, DIOECESIS VICTORIENSIS, TITULO AC DIGNITATE BASILICAE MINORIS COHONESTATUR.
incipit_latin: In Cantabris montibus, dioecesis Victoriensis intra fines, haud procul ab « Onate », quod est provinciae Guipuzcoae oppidum
notes: Basilica Minor act stating 'eandemque anno MDCCCLXXXVI, clero populoque plaudente, a Victoriensi Episcopo aureo diademate redimitam' - crowned in 1886 by the Bishop of Vitoria; papal authority for that crowning is NOT stated in the passage, hence confidence medium. The same act recalls that Benedict XV himself declared the Virgin of Aranzazu principal patroness of the civil province of Guipuzcoa in 1918. Old stone image of the Virgin with the Infant Jesus. OCR gives 'Ofiate'/'Onate' for Onate (Onati).

image_title_vernacular: Mare de Déu de la Mercè / Nuestra Señora de la Merced
rubric_latin: TEMPLUM B. MARIAE VIRG. DE MERCEDE IN CIVITATE BARCINONENSI TITULO ET PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS DECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Conspicua templa in memoriam magni alicuius eventus erecta, quaeque non minus artis operibus quam et cultus splendore et potissimum fidelium pietate praestent
notes: 'dum Leo XIII tam insigne simulacrum aurea corona redimiendum sollemniter decrevit' - no year is given, so coronation_date is null; it falls within the pontificate of Leo XIII (1878-1903). The act begins on printed p. 435 (passage printed_page is 436).

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora de la Misericordia (Mare de Déu de la Misericòrdia), Burriana
rubric_latin: Beatae Mariae Virginis sub vocabulo « Nuestra Señora de la Misericordia » imago, quae in urbe Burriana colitur, nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis coronatur.
incipit_latin: Procedentibus christianae salutis temporibus omnium ordinum fideles ad Virginem Mariam fidenti animo decurrerunt, probe scientes superna se beneficia indulgenter accepturos.
notes: Requested by Bp Juan Antonio Reig Pla of Segorbe-Castellón. The church/sanctuary is not named in the act. OCR of the incipit reads 'Procendentibus'; the volume index (p. 1057) has 'Procedentibus'. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V. SUB NOMINE « NUESTRA SEÑORA DE LA MISERICORDIA » IN ECCLESIA PAROECIALI LOCI « CANET DE MAR » VENERATA, PATRONA CAELESTIS DECLARATUR UNIVERSAE REGIONIS, QUAE « COMARCA DEL MARESMA » APPELLATUR, INTRA FINES GERUNDENSIS DIOECESIS.
incipit_latin: Quae a Christianis « Mater Misericordiae » fidenti animo est appellata, numquam eorum fefellit spem, sed potius materni Cordis sui thesauros quam maxime ostendit.
notes: Patron-declaration act; attests 'aureo diademate, quod, sacrae Imagini anno MCMVII impositum, illius honori, eodem peracto bello, est reiectum' (crown imposed 1907, restored after the civil war), and mentions the 'quinquagesimi a peracta Marialis Iconis coronatione anniversarii' - the 1957 act marks the 50th anniversary of the coronation. Authority of the 1907 coronation is not stated in the act. Rubric OCR 'LICI' repaired to 'LOCI'; OCR 'Marialis leonis' read as 'Marialis Iconis'. Country explicit ('in Hispania').

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Nuestra Señora de la Fuensanta » invocatae, quae pie colitur in Hispaniae urbe Cordium, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Cordubae, in antiqua et insigni Hispaniae urbe, iam a saeculo xv a fidelibus loci totiusque dioecesis peculiari veneratione colitur decora imago
notes: Rubric as printed reads « in Hispaniae urbe Cordium »; the volume index and the body of the act read Corduba/Cordubae. Petition of Bishop José Antonio Infantes Florido, letters of 23 July 1993. Coronation to be performed in the Pope's name; no shrine church named in the passage.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO, SUB TITULO « DE URIBARRI », QUAE IN OPPIDO « DURANGO » VICTORIENSIS DIOECESIS VENERATUR, TOTIUS ARCHIPRESBYTERALIS REGIONIS DURANGUENSIS PATRONA COELESTIS DECLARATUR.
incipit_latin: Victoriensis dioecesis intra fines, in oppidi « Durango » nuncupati templo archipresbyterali, Imago quaedam Beatae Mariae Virginis religiosissime colitur sub populari titulo « de Uribarri »
notes: Patron declaration that also grants the coronation: 'ut Imaginem eandem corona Nomine Nostro redimiri decerneremus ... ipsi Venerabili Fratri Episcopo titulo Siandensi, Victoriensis dioecesis Apostolico Administratori, eas partes committimus ut Imaginem ... aureo diademate, nomine atque auctoritate Nostris, sollemniter redimiat'. The executor is the titular Bishop of 'Siandensis', Apostolic Administrator of Vitoria; his personal name is not given in the act, so legate left null. Date of coronation left to him ('die ab eodem statuendo'). Passage printed_page was 221; act begins on printed p. 220. Vernacular title supplied as the Spanish form of the Latin 'de Uribarri' (only the Latin form appears).

rubric_latin: B. M. V. imago populari sermone « Virgen de los desamparados » appellata, quae in Sanctuario loci v. d. « El Saliente » asservatur, sacro diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Ministerii Nostri pontificalis ab initio Virginis Mariae cultum apud Dei plebem excitandum atque adeo augendum curavimus
notes: Act begins on printed page 366 (passage printed_page is 365). Faculty granted to Emmanuel O. Hervás, Bishop of Almería (petition dated 8 Oct.), or a delegate, to crown the image in the Pope's name; no coronation date given. Country not named in the act: inferred from the diocese of Almería. OCR reads 'EI Saliente' for 'El Saliente'.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA B. MARIAE V. «DE GUADALUPE», INTRA FINES TOLETANAE ARCHIDIOECESIS EXSTANS, TITULO BASILICAE MINORIS EXORNATUR.
incipit_latin: Augusta Virgo Deipara, quam « de Guadalupe » vulgo appellant, religiosissima est, ut omnes norunt, apud Hispaniae gentes
notes: Basilica Minor act stating in passing that the Apostolic See 'anno MDCCCCXXVIII eius Imaginem aureo diademate, augusto Ecclesiae ritu, siverit redimiri'. The coronation clause falls on printed p. 492; the act opens on printed p. 491, which is used as aas_page. This is the Spanish Guadalupe in Extremadura (archdiocese of Toledo), not the Mexican one.

rubric_latin: Simulacrum Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae in dioecesi Onubensi pie sub titulo « Nuestra Señora de la Cinta » excolitur, merito diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: Satis compertum habetur Christifideles Onubenses iam dudum certo venerationis cultu Beatam Mariam Virginem, vulgo « Nuestra Señora de la Cinta » appellatam, prosequi consuevisse
notes: Country Spain inferred from the see of Huelva (Onubensis); not named in the act. The act recalls that Paul VI declared her Patroness of the city of Huelva by the Letters « Praeclara Dei Genetrix » of 30 June 1964. Bishop Rafael González Moralejo is empowered to crown in the Pope's name. No church or sanctuary is named.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V., « DE LA CABEZA » VULGO APPELLATA, PRAECIPUA APUD DEUM PATRONA UNA CUM S. EUPHRASIO, EP. ET CONF., UNIVERSAE DIOECESIS GIENNENSIS CONSTITUITUR.
incipit_latin: Studium et cultus Beatae Mariae Virginis, quae « de la Cabeza » Hispanico appellatur sermone, a multo iam tempore animos tenent Illiturgitanorum
notes: Patron declaration that recalls in passing that the Chapter of St Peter's ('Petrianae Basilicae Canonicorum Collegium'), at the request of Bishop Juan Manuel Laguarda Fenollera and in the time of St Pius X, granted 'ut ... Mariale simulacrum aurea corona redimiretur'; no coronation year given. The image, found in 1227 ('anno MCCXXVII') on the mountain, lost its diadem in the Spanish Civil War and a more precious crown was prepared to replace it. Act begins on printed page 383 (passage page-marker is 384). Datum reads 'die XXVII mensis Novembris, anno MDCCCCLVHII' — read as MDCCCCLVIIII = 1959, confirmed by 'Pontificatus Nostri secundo'. Locality Illiturgis = Andújar (identification supplied).

legate: Iosephus Eguino Trecu, Episcopus Santanderiensis (Santanderiensis Ordinarius)
rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO VULGO APPELLATA « NUESTRA SEÑORA DE EL SOTO » IN PRAECIPUAM PATRONAM REGIONIS « DE TORANZO » ELIGITUR ET EIUSDEM IMAGO CORONA REDIMITUR.
incipit_latin: Potiora inter pietatis domicilia dioecesis Santanderiensis locum obtinet templum Beatae Mariae Virgini, Dominae Nostrae a nemore, sacrum
notes: Coronation grant: « Santanderiensi Ordinario ... eas partes committimus, ut die suo arbitrio deligendo, post Missarum sollemnia, iuxta ritum formulamque praescriptam, imagini eiusdem Deiparae Virginis ... auream coronam, Nostro nomine et auctoritate imponat. » Date of the coronation itself left to the Ordinary, so not stated. Rubric prints the vernacular title twice inconsistently (« de El Soto » / « del El Soto »). Act date and page confirmed by the volume index (incipit « Potiora inter », 1959 Maii 23, p. 805 — same batch, AAS-51-1959-ocr#940).

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris ecclesiae conventuali, B. Mariae Virgini de Monte Carmelo in urbe Xeretio dicatae, attribuuntur.
incipit_latin: Actuosae pietatis domicilium sane licet appellari Carmelitarum Fratrum templum, quod in urbe Xeretio, intra Hispalensis archidioecesis fines, exsurgit
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'Marialis enim imago summae est omnibus venerationi, eademque anno MCMXXV, Patriarchalis Vaticani Canonicorum Collegii auctoritate, sollemni ritu coronata est'. Vernacular title 'Nuestra Señora del Carmen' is verbatim in the text. Locality: Latin 'urbs Xeretium', identified as Jerez de la Frontera (Carmelite friary in the archdiocese of Seville, Baetican province) — inference. Country inferred. The act opens on printed page 1119; the coronation clause falls on page 1120.

image_title_vernacular: Mare de Déu de Paret Delgada
rubric_latin: Imago beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Mare de Déu de Paret-Delgada », quae pie colitur in Sanctuario eiusdem nominis in civitate « La Selva del Camp » intra fines Tarraconensis archidioecesis, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Antiqua quidem et singulari pietate colitur imago beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Mare de Déu de Paret-Delgada » invocatae
notes: The act addresses « istis dilectis Hispaniae filiis ». Petition of Archbishop Ramón Torrella Cascante, letters of 9 Feb. 1996.

rubric_latin: Imago Nostrae Dominae « de Indejo » quae in ecclesia oppidi v.d. Las Fraguas colitur, pretioso diademate redimitur.
incipit_latin: « Dominus natus est ex Maria, humani generis in se peccata suscipiens, remissionem tribuit omnium delictorum » (S. Ambrosius, Expositio ev. sec. Lucam, VIII, 23).
notes: Both the act and the volume index print the title as « de Indejo »; the shrine at Las Fraguas (Soria) is normally called Nuestra Señora de Inodejo, so the printed form is probably a misreading — verify. Bp Francisco Pérez González is deputed to impose the crown in the Pope's name (letters of 2 July 1996); the act mentions the 14th centenary of the diocese. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: Titulus ac privilegia Basilicae Minoris Sanctuario B. Mariae Virg. « de Lluch », in Maioricensis dioecesis finibus, conferuntur.
incipit_latin: Gloria et praesidium Balearum Insularum merito praedicatur Beata Maria Virgo « de Lluch », cuius venusta imago in Maioricensi templo, saeculo XIII eius honori exstructo, perpetuis impensisque obsequiis colitur.
notes: Basilica Minor act; the coronation is mentioned in passing: 'Leo Pp. XIII, qui inditam imaginem illam per Legatum aureo diademate redimivit' (OCR 'redimi vit'; 'inditam' probably for 'inclitam'). No coronation year and no Legate name given; Leo XIII reigned 1878-1903. Locality 'Lluc' taken from the sanctuary's own epithet; country inferred from 'Balearum Insularum' / dioecesis Maioricensis, not stated in the act. Vernacular form of the title not given beyond « de Lluch ».

rubric_latin: PAROECIALIS ECCLESIA DEO IN HONOREM BEATAE MARIAE VIRGINIS IN CAELUM ASSUMPTAE CONSECRATA IN URBE « MORELLA », DERTOSENSIS DIOECESIS, BASILICAE MINORIS TITULO HONORIBUSQUE AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Pietatis monumentum singularis opusque factum arte eximia templum esse perhibetur Augustae Deiparae sideribus receptae sacrum, quo urbs « Morella », intra fines posita Dertosensis dioecesis, insignitur
notes: Only: « Eodem in templo piissime excolitur, praesertim statis temporibus, imago miraculis illustris ac diademate redimita Deiparae, quae vulgo a 'Vallivana' appellatur. » The text says the image is crowned but does NOT state papal authority, date or minister — needs human verification before being counted as a papal coronation. Spain is explicit (« in publicis monumentis nationis Hispanicae »).

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum Pp. II per Apostolicam visitationem in Hispania die XIV mensis Iunii anno MCMXCIII pretioso diademate coronavisse imaginem beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Nuestra Señora de los Milagros », quae in franciscali monasterio « de la Rábida » nuncupato pie colitur.
incipit_latin: Inter Apostolicam Nostram Visitationem in Hispania hoc anno die xiv huiusce mensis Iunii perquam libenter excipientes preces
notes: John Paul II crowned the image himself during his apostolic visit to Spain; the act is the commemorative record. Petition of Bishop Rafael González Moralejo of Huelva, letters of 11 Jan. 1991.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA V., VULGO « DE LA ENCINA » APPELLATA, PRAECIPUA PATRONA CAELESTIS RENUNTIATUR OPPIDI « PONFERRADA » ET TOTIUS REGIONIS « EL BIERZO », IN ASTURICENSI DIOECESI.
incipit_latin: Haud aliter ac multae in Hispania regiones, illa quoque « El Bierzo » vulgo nuncupata atque intra Asturicensis dioecesis fines posita, suum celebre religioneque frequens Mariale possidet Sanctuarium
notes: « Anno insuper MCMVIII, quo Marialis ipsa Imago aurea fuit redimita corona, idem Patrocinium supra totam Bergidensem regionem ab omnibus vel publice est renuntiatum »; the act was occasioned by the 50th anniversary of that solemn rite. Rubric prints « PONPERRADA » (OCR/print error for Ponferrada). Crowning authority/minister not named.

rubric_latin: BEATA MARIA VIRGO SUB TITULO «DEL CORO», CORONA REDIMITA, CIVITATIS SANCTI SEBASTIANI IN DIOECESI HISPANIAE VICTORIENSI PATRONA DECLARATUR.
incipit_latin: Urbis Sancti Sebastiani intra fines Victoriensis dioecesis in ecclesia paroeciali matrici Sanctae Mariae iam ab annis multis religiosissime asservatur imago Beatae Virginis Mariae vulgo «Virgen del Coro» nuncupata
notes: Combined patron-declaration and coronation grant: the Bishop of Vitoria is charged to crown the image in the Pope's name on a day of his own choosing - 'Venerabili Fratri Victoriensium Episcopo eas partes committimus, ut arbitrio suo eligendo die ... Imaginem Beatae Virginis a Choro praedictam per se ipsum vel per ecclesiasticum virum in dignitate constitutum, et ab eodem deputandum, iuxta ritum formulamque praescripta aureo diademate, servatis servandis, Nostro nomine et auctoritate, post Missarum sollemnia, redimiat'. No legate is named (the ordinary or his delegate). Incipit ('Urbis Sancti Sebastiani') confirmed by the volume index on p. 583.

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora de la Esperanza (Esperanza de Triana)
rubric_latin: Ad E.mum P. D. Iosephum Mariam Sanctae Romanae Ecclesiae Presb. Cardinalem Bueno Monreal, Archiepiscopum Hispalensem, cum effigies B. Mariae Virg., vulgo « de Nuestra Señora de la Esperanza Macarena », ea in urbe aureo diademate fuit redimita.
notes: Papal written message sent for the coronation day ('Hoy fiesta de María Reina ... se adorna con corona de oro y pedrería la imagen'); rubric confirms 'aureo diademate fuit redimita'. Act begins on printed page 598; the passage's printed_page is 599. Body in Spanish, no Latin incipit.

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora de la Esperanza (Esperanza de Triana)
legate: Iosephus M. S. R. E. Cardinalis Bueno Monreal, olim Archiepiscopus Hispalensis
rubric_latin: Sinitur Imago B. M. V. vulgo « Nuestra Señora de la Esperanza » in aede S. Annae de Triana dioecesis Hispalensis, redimiri.
incipit_latin: Qui semper castissimam Virginem Mariam, Christi Matrem amabilem, toto corde dileximus, aequo semper animo ea coepta aut inimus aut ineunda probamus
notes: Act begins on printed p. 607 (running head in context); passage indexed at p. 606. Petition by Abp Carolus Amigo Vallejo of Seville that the crowning be performed, in the Pope's name and authority, by Card. Bueno Monreal, emeritus archbishop. Country inferred from 'in urbe Hispali' (Seville); not named in the act.

rubric_latin: AD EM.UM P. D. HENRICUM TIT. S. PETRI IN MONTE AUREO S. R. E. PRESB. CARD. REIG Y CASANOVA, ARCHIEPISCOPUM TOLETANUM, DE CONGRESSU EUCHARISTICO EX TOTA HISPANIA.
incipit_latin: Sacras inter aedes, quas catholicae Hispaniae filii, media aetate, excitarunt, principem videtur obtinere locum, cum ob molis amplitudinem
notes: Act I begins on printed p. 52 (the passage page marker is 53). The Pope commends, but does not himself grant, the plan of the Archbishop of Toledo: 'itemque quam vos singulari cultu caelestem Patronam veneramini Virginem a Sacrario, eius effigiem aurea corona redimiendi. Utrumque autem, quod iam in eo es ut perficias, propositum ...'. Prospective, not retrospective, and not the coronation grant itself - classified as retrospective_attestation for want of a better category. No date is given for the crowning (letter dated 4 October 1926, coronation imminent).

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora de los Desamparados / Mare de Déu dels Desamparats
rubric_latin: TEMPLUM IN HONOREM B. MARIAE VIRGINIS, MATRIS DESERTORUM, DEO VALENTIAE IN HISPANIA DICATUM, PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS HONESTATUR.
incipit_latin: Valentiam, quae ceteras inter Hesperiae civitates pulchra est appellata, pulcherrimum excolit templum, in honorem Beatae Mariae Virginis, titulo Matris Desertorum, aedificatum
notes: Basilica Minor act; coronation attested in passing: 'Anno denique mcmxxiii Imago veneranda, maximo universi populi gaudio, ex indulto Pii PP. XI aurea corona canonice redimita est'; the act also notes the Archbishop's plan to consecrate the church in the coming May on the 25th anniversary of the crowning. Country explicit in the rubric ('Valentiae in Hispania'). Vernacular titles supplied as the Spanish/Valencian forms of 'Mater Desertorum'.

image_title_vernacular: Unsere Liebe Frau von Einsiedeln (Our Lady of the Hermits)
legate: Alafridus Ildefonsus S. R. E. Card. Schuster, Archiepiscopus Mediolanensis
rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. ALAFRIDUM ILDEFONSUM TIT. SS. SILVESTRI ET MARTINI IN MONTIBUS S. R. E. PRESBYTERUM CARDINALEM SCHUSTER, MEDIOLANENSIUM ARCHIEPISCOPUM: QUEM MITTIT LEGATUM AD SOLEMNIA DECIES SAECULARIA ABBATIAE EINSIDLENSIS.
incipit_latin: Non levi animi delectatione nuper intelleximus de sollemnibus decies saecularibus, quae Einsidlenses monachi in honorem Deiparae « eremitarum Dominae » appellatae summo studio apparare contendunt
notes: Letter deputing Cardinal Schuster as Legate: '... et prodigiosum « eremitarum Dominae » simulacrum, tanta populi veneratione excultum, nomine Nostro Nostraque auctoritate sollemni coronae impositione exornes.' No coronation date stated; the rites were to take place 'proxime' during the 1934 millenary celebrations of the abbey. Country and locality inferred from 'Einsidlensis' (Einsiedeln); the letter names no diocese. OCR 'mtelleximus' repaired to 'intelleximus'.

rubric_latin: TITULO PRIVILEGIISQUE MINORIS BASILICAE INSIGNITUR TEMPLUM CONLEGIALE B. M. V. IN CIVITATE FRIBURGENSI HELVETIORUM.
incipit_latin: A venerabili fratre Lausannensium, Genevensium et Friburgensium Episcopo edocemur Friburgi in Helvetia antiquum et celebre titulo Nostrae Dominae conlegiale templum exstare
notes: Basilica Minor act; 'in quo Beatae Mariae Virginis simulacrum, iam nomine atque auctoritate rec. mem. Decessoris Nostri Leonis Pp. XIII aureo diademate coronatum, servatur et colitur'. Coronation date not given (under Leo XIII, 1878-1903). Country explicit in the text ('in Helvetia').

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM DEO IN HONOREM B. MARIAE V. IMMACULATAE GENEVAE CONSECRATUM HONORIBUS BASILICAE MINORIS INSIGNITUR.
incipit_latin: Nominis Catholici in urbe Geneva revigescentis signum perhibetur esse Templum, quod paulo post sollemniter pronunciatum dogma Immaculati Beatae Mariae Virginis Conceptus exstructum fuit
notes: Clause: « Quod Simulacrum ... anno millesimo nongentesimo trigesimo septimo, Episcoporum, Sacerdotum e prioribus, populi fidelis astante corona, auro diademate, Nostro nomine et auctoritate, fuit redimitum ». The statue is the one Pius IX kept in his apartment and donated to this church. « Nostro nomine et auctoritate » is written by Pius XII of a 1937 event (reigning pope then Pius XI): read as ‘in the name and by the authority of this Apostolic See’.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM LOCARNENSE B. M. VIRGINIS A SAXO, IN DIOECESI LUGANENSI, TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS HONESTATUR.
incipit_latin: Locarni, intra fines Luganensis dioecesis, antiquum exstat percelebre templum Deo in honorem B. Mariae Virg. a Saxo dicatum
notes: The image was crowned twice: 'semel iterumque aureo diademate redimitum fuit, primo quidem a Legato Apostolico apud Helvetios anno MDCXVII; secundo autem decreto Vaticani Capituli anno MDCCCLXXX, scilicet quarto redeunte centenario a mirifica Deiparae Virginis apparitione'. coronation_date records the second (Vatican Chapter) crowning of 1880; the first was in 1617 by the Apostolic Legate to Switzerland.

rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo « a Miraculis » praecipua caelestis Patrona oppidi v. « Morbio Inferiore », Luganensis dioecesis, declaratur.
incipit_latin: Deiparam Virginem Mariam maternum auxilium suis fidelibus saepenumero ostendisse, omnibus constat.
notes: Patronage act; the coronation is mentioned in passing: the faithful had a golden crown made 'quae postea amplissimi Petriani Canonicorum Collegii Decreto, anno MCMXXVII, Mariae Virginis capiti fuit sollemniter imposita' — i.e. crowned by decree of the Vatican Chapter in 1927. The coronation clause falls on printed page 771; the act opens on page 770, which is cited here as aas_page. Country (Switzerland) inferred from the diocese of Lugano; not stated in the text. Vernacular title not given in the passage.

image_title_vernacular: Our Lady Queen of Africa, Lodonga
rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris ecclesia dicata Beatae Mariae Virgini, Omnium Gratiarum Conciliatrici, Sultanae Africae, in oppido « Lodonga », Aruaensis dioecesis, condecoratur.
incipit_latin: Beatissimam Virginem Mariam cunctas haereses interemisse in universo mundo iure meritoque canit Ecclesia: quod quidem iis omnibus qui ad Regnum Christi in dissitas regiones dilatandum forti animo decertant
notes: Basilica Minor elevation stating 'cuius simulacrum aurea corona, a Pio Pp. XII, fel. rec., proximo Decessore Nostro, pie lustrata, fuit redimitum' — the golden crown was blessed by Pius XII; the year of the crowning is not given (the church was consecrated 'anno MCMLIV').
