Church served by the Comboni Missionaries ('Congregatio Filiorum S. Cordis Iesu'). Vernacular title is a rendering of 'Sultana seu Domina Africae'; verify local usage.

rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis pie servata in Sanctuario loci v. d. « Berdicev », ipsi Beatae Mariae Virgini de Monte Carmelo dicato, dioecesi in Zytomeriensi, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Deipara Virgo, in historiam salutis ingressa, maxima fidei placita in se quodammodo unit et reverberat dum praedicatur et colitur.
notes: Bp Jan Purwiński of Zhytomyr is deputed to impose the crown in the Pope's name. The same act also appears at the end of passage AAS-89-1997-ocr#530. Country not stated in the act; inferred from the Latin diocese/place name.

rubric_latin: ECCLESIA METROPOLITANA LEOPOLIENSIS LATINORUM TITULO BASILICAE MINORIS DECORATUR.
incipit_latin: Constat apprime Cathedralem Leopoliensem Latinorum Ecclesiam, anno MCCCLXX sub titulo Deiparae Virginis Sideribus receptae aedificatam
notes: Crowning attested in passing: 'vetustissimam Deiparae Imaginem veneraturi, quae ex decreto Capituli Vaticani iam inde ab anno MDCCLXII aureo diademate redimita fuit'. The text names only 'Provincia Galiciae'; the modern country (Ukraine) is inferred from the identification of Leopolis with Lviv - confidence lowered to medium on that account.

image_title_vernacular: Obraz Matki Bożej Łaskawej, Pani Lwowa (Our Lady of Grace, Lady of Lviv; « Śliczna Gwiazda miasta Lwowa »)
rubric_latin: Leopoli in beatificatione servorum Dei Iosephi Bilczewski et Sigismundi Gorazdowski.
notes: 'Za chwilę dokonam koronacji łaskami słynącego obrazu Matki Bożej Łaskawej Pani Lwowa' (p. 850) and, earlier in the same homily, 'Maryi, Matki Bożej Łaskawej, od wieków czczonej przez was w wizerunku, który dzisiaj z radością ukoronuję ... obrazem, pamiętającym śluby króla Jana Kazimierza' (p. 849). Homily at the beatification of Józef Bilczewski and Zygmunt Gorazdowski, Lviv, 26 June 2001. Act begins on printed page 844; the passage's printed_page is 850. The text links this image to the vows of King John Casimir, as it does the Lubaczów image crowned in 1983 (AAS 75, p. 935) — a checker should verify the relation between the two. Body in Polish, no Latin incipit.

image_title_vernacular: la Virgen de los Treinta y Tres
rubric_latin: Beata Maria Virgo, « la Virgen de los Treinta y Tres » vulgo appellata, principalis Patrona eligitur Reipublicae Uruquarianae.
incipit_latin: Nobilis Uruquarianorum terra, pratorum viriditate collibusque molliter sinuatis peramoena, de antiqua gloriatur marianae sede pietatis
notes: Act declaring the image Patron of Uruguay; it attests the papal coronation grant in passing: 'utpote qui, facta anno superiore licentia idem simulacrum aurea corona redimiendi' — the faculty was given 'the previous year', i.e. 1961 relative to this 1962 act; no explicit date, so coronation_date left null. Rubric and act start (p. 946) confirmed from the volume text.

image_title_vernacular: la Virgen de los Treinta y Tres
rubric_latin: Titulo ac privilegiis Basilicae Minoris cathedralis ecclesia Floridensis honestatur.
incipit_latin: Floridense templum princeps sedes pietatis praedicatur totius dioecesis incolarum, quin etiam Uruquarianae nationis, siquidem ibi asservatur atque excolitur imago Beatae Mariae Virginis, a « Triginta Tribus viris » appellatae
notes: Basilica Minor act. Coronation attested: 'hoc non ita pridem, Nostra auctoritate, fuit aureo diademate redimitum' (by John XXIII's authority, 'not long ago' - no date given). Same image as the 1962 patronage act at AAS 55 (1963) 946. Act begins on printed p. 956; passage printed_page is 957.

image_title_vernacular: L'Immacolata Concezione (mosaic in the Cappella del Coro)
rubric_latin: In Basilica Liberiana habita christifidelibus Urbis, in festo Immaculatae Conceptionis Beatae Mariae Virginis.
notes: John XXIII recalls that Pius IX himself crowned this mosaic image ('il Pontefice Pio IX, con incomparabile solennità, incoronò l'8 dicembre 1869') at the opening of Vatican Council I, and that Pius X renewed the act with a richer crown on 8 December 1904, which the future John XXIII witnessed as a young priest. Act is an allocution delivered in the Liberian Basilica (St Mary Major) on 8 Dec 1960 but the crowned image described is the St Peter's Cappella del Coro mosaic. Act begins on printed page 30; attestation on p. 34. Body in Italian, no Latin incipit.

rubric_latin: Sinitur Archiepiscopus Caracensis Imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis « de la Soledad », quae in urbe Caracis colitur, coronare.
incipit_latin: Quandoquidem beata Maria Virgo est Christi Mater castissima, e qua per Filium salus nostra manavit; et exemplar et imago ipsa virtutum
notes: Faculty granted to Iosephus Ali Card. Lebrun Moratinos, Archbishop of Caracas, or a man delegated by him, to crown the image in the Pope's name during Mass on a day of his choosing; no coronation date given. Country not named in the act: inferred from Caracas / archdiocese Caracensis. Datum 'anno MDCCCCLXXXVII' = 1987.

image_title_vernacular: Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe de El Carrizal
rubric_latin: Imago Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe de El Carrizal » invocatae, Patronae caelestis Corensis dioecesis, pretioso diademate redimiri sinitur « nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis ».
incipit_latin: Novimus clerum populumque Corensis dioecesis singulari colere pietate decoram imaginem Beatae Mariae Virginis titulo « Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe de El Carrizal » invocatae
notes: The act records that she was made heavenly Patroness of the diocese of Coro in 1928. Bishop Roberto Ovidio Pérez Morales (OCR 'Raimundus Ovidius') is commissioned to crown the image on a day of his choosing, in the Pope's name; his petition is dated 13 May 1992. Venezuela named indirectly ('tam dilectis Venetiolanis filiis'). No church named.

legate: Manuel Arteaga y Betancourt, Cardinal, Archbishop of San Cristóbal de La Habana
rubric_latin: AD EMUM P. D. EMMANUELEM TIT. SANCTI LAURENTII IN LUCINA S. R. E. PRESB. CARDINALEM ARTEAGA Y BETANCOURT, ARCHIEPISCOPUM SANCTI CHRISTOPHORI DE HABANA, QUEM LEGATUM RENUNTIAT AD IMAGINEM NOSTRAE DOMINAE DE COROMOTO CORONA EXORNANDAM.
incipit_latin: Intra fines dioecesis Barquisimetensis, in Venezuelana Republica sitae, celebre admodum exstat Sanctuarium Beatae Mariae Virginis sub populari titulo « de Coromoto »
notes: The batch passage itself is the volume's chronological index on printed p. 906, which points to the act on p. 722 ('quem Legatum renuntiat ad imaginem Nostrae Dominae de Coromoto corona exornandam 722'); the same act is indexed again at p. 942. aas_page is therefore the act's page (722), not the index page. Rubric, incipit, Datum and details taken from the act text at AAS 44 (1952) 722-723 in the full volume file. Act: '...perinsignem illam imaginem sollemni ritu proximo Septembri mense coronandam per Legatum Nostrum censuimus... ut in Sanctuario de Guanare venerandam imaginem Nostrae Dominae de Coromoto veluti manibus Nostris sacra exornes corona.' coronation_date = September 1952 ('proximo Septembri mense'); the volume also records a papal radio message of 12 Sept 1952 to the Venezuelans celebrating the coronation (p. 739). OCR of the act gives 'Guanare de los Oospes' (= Guanare de los Cospes) and 'Berquisimetensis' alongside 'Barquisimetensis'. Spanish form of the title taken from the radio message text at p. 739 ('Nuestra Señora de Coromoto').

rubric_latin: NUNTIUS RADIOPHONICUS CHRISTIFIDELIBUS VENEZUELAE DATUS, SOLLEMNIA IN HONOREM B. MARIAE VIRGINIS DE COROMOTO CELEBRANTIBUS.
incipit_latin: Venerables Hermanos y amados hijos, católicos venezolanos, que en la linda Guanare asistís conmovidos a la solemne coronación de vuestra Excelsa Patrona, Nuestra Señora de Coromoto
notes: Radio message of Pius XII broadcast to Venezuela on the day of the coronation; the footnote reads 'Habita die 12 Septembris mensis a. 1952', which is the delivery date (there is no Datum line) and also the date of the ceremony. The text never uses a word for 'image': it speaks of the devotional title, the people 'colocándole en las sienes una preciosa corona' at 'la solemne coronación de vuestra Excelsa Patrona, Nuestra Señora de Coromoto'. It is not itself the granting act: the papal Legate was deputed by the Litterae at AAS 44 (1952) 722 ('AD IMAGINEM NOSTRAE DOMINAE DE COROMOTO CORONA EXORNANDAM', dated 30 July 1952, Card. Emmanuel Arteaga y Betancourt, Archbishop of Havana), hence retrospective_attestation. The message names the Legate only as 'Nuestro dignísimo Legado', so legate is left null; church_or_sanctuary, diocese_latin and diocese_modern are taken from that companion act at p. 722 (this passage says only 'el gran Santuario Nacional' at Guanare, Venezuela). Rubric OCR reads 'VENEZUELAS' for 'VENEZUELAE'. Incipit is the Spanish salutation, the act having no Latin body.

rubric_latin: Memoriae proditur Summum Pontificem Ioannem Paulum II die septimo et vicesimo Ianuarii, hoc anno, coronasse imaginem B. V. M. de Coromoto, in dioecesi Guanarensi.
incipit_latin: Sedi Nostrae beati Petri apostoli redditis, post peregrinationem in Americam Latinam, quanta subeunt, quae in tam longo itinere
notes: Assigned passage is the Index rerum analyticus (printed p. 1219, which OCRs the diocese as 'Guaranensi'); record built on the act itself at printed p. 466, used as aas_page. 'beatissimam Virginem Mariam de Coromoto sollemnissima caerimonia coronavimus, pretioso diademate imposito ... die septimo et vicesimo mensis Ianuarii proxime elapsi'. Bishop of Guanare then Angelus Adolfus Polachini (Ángel Adolfo Polachini). Sanctuary not named in the act.

rubric_latin: Caracae, ad Christifideles congregatos habita.
notes: 'Hoy el Papa, Obispo de Roma, rodeado de sus hermanos los Obispos de Venezuela, va a llevar a cabo la coronación canónica de la imagen de Nuestra Señora de Coromoto, que será venerada en su nueva Basílica' (p. 832); the same act announces 'el acto solemne de coronación de la venerada imagen de Nuestra Señora de Coromoto, Patrona de todos los venezolanos' (p. 830, passage AAS-77-1985-ocr#v830). Act begins on printed page 828. Note this is a second coronation, the image having already been crowned at Guanare in 1952 (AAS 44, p. 739). Body in Spanish, no Latin incipit.

rubric_latin: TEMPLUM PAROCHIALE SANCTI IOANNIS DE DEO, IN CIVITATE MACARAIBO, DIOECESIS ZULIENSIS, TITULO AC PRIVILEGIIS BASILICAE MINORIS AUGETUR.
incipit_latin: Exstat in civitate episcopali Macaraibo, dioecesis Zuliensis, intra fines Reipublicae de Venezuela, Americae meridionalis, ecclesia parochialis

rubric_latin: Pii PP. X circa coronationem simulacri S. Cordis Iesu.
incipit_latin: Me taedet preces tuas exaudire non posse eo quod S. Rituum Congregatio ultimis hisce diebus incongruum declaravit imaginibus divini Cordis Iesu coronas imponere
notes: NEGATIVE norm, not a grant: Pius X tells Léon Gauthey, Bishop of Nevers, that he cannot grant his petition because the S. Congregation of Rites has just declared it 'incongruum' to impose crowns on images of the Sacred Heart of Jesus, permitting only that a crown be laid at the feet of the statue ('corona ad simulacri pedes deponatur'), which the bishop may do in the Pope's name. Emitted as `norms` per SPEC (general legislation about crowning images) with image fields null, though the letter arises from one concrete case: a simulacrum of the Sacred Heart in the diocese of Nevers (Nivernensis), France, for which no coronation was in fact permitted. Retained because it is the governing rule of the period on crowning Sacred Heart images and explains later refusals. Datum: 'Ex aedibus Vaticanis, die 9 Iulii 1908'. OCR: 'exaudiré' -> 'exaudire'. The letter is indexed at ASS 41, p. 621 ('Epistola Pii X circa coronationem simulacri S. Cordis Iesu ... 621').

rubric_latin: NORMAE CIRCA PATRONOS CONSTITUENDOS ET IMAGINES B. M. VIRGINIS CORONANDAS — II. De Coronatione Imaginis Beatae Mariae Virginis
incipit_latin: Pluries decursu temporis factum est ut populus christianus, filiali devotione permotus, ardenter peteret et obtineret coronationem alicuius Imaginis B. Mariae Virginis.
notes: General legislation, not a specific image. Issued by the Sacra Congregatio pro Cultu Divino 'de mandato Summi Pontificis' (Paul VI reigning); signed Arturus Card. Tabera, Praefectus, and H. Bugnini, a Secretis. The document heading is on printed page 276; Part I (De Patronis constituendis) runs 276-279 and is dated 19 March 1973; Part II (De Coronatione Imaginis Beatae Mariae Virginis) runs 280-281 and is dated 25 March 1973 — that is the act_date given here. Key provisions: only images of the BVM (painted or sculpted) may be crowned; if Christ is shown with her, both must be crowned; the rite is normally performed by the local Bishop per the Pontificale Romanum; coronation 'nomine et auctoritate Summi Pontificis' by a Pontifical Delegate requires that the image be of real importance to the Church, nation or region, and 'facultas coronandi conceditur per Decretum praedictae Congregationis ac per Litteras Apostolicas in forma Brevis expediendas'. Passages AAS-65-1973-ocr#738 and #739 are back-of-volume index entries pointing to this same act at page 276 and were not emitted separately. Document spans pp. 276-280+.
